articles.title: The Avalanches Set 2027 Tour of Australia
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: The Avalanches will rumble down under in early 2027 for a live tour that includes a date at the Sydney Opera House Forecourt.
paras.zh: Avalanches 乐队将于 2​​027 年初隆隆作响，进行现场巡演，其中包括在悉尼歌剧院前院举行的演出。

paras.en: Led by Robbie Chater, Tony Di Blasi and Andy Szekeres, the electronic music pioneers will play six concerts across Australia next February and March.
paras.zh: 在 Robbie Chater、Tony Di Blasi 和 Andy Szekeres 的带领下，电子音乐先驱们将于明年二月和三月在澳大利亚举办六场音乐会。

paras.en: Presented by Takumi, the jaunt gets underway with two shows at Perth Festival, then heads east to Adelaide’s Hindley St Music Hall; the group’s hometown, Melbourne, for Live At The Gardens; On The Banks in Brisbane, and wraps up at the iconic Sydney Opera House.
paras.zh: 在 Takumi 的主持下，这次旅行在珀斯音乐节上进行了两场演出，然后向东前往阿德莱德的 Hindley St 音乐厅；乐队的家乡墨尔本，Live At The Gardens；在布里斯班的河岸上，最后在标志性的悉尼歌剧院结束。

paras.en: “The chaotic virtuosity and charm of The Avalanches have brought unmatched joy to ears and feet around the world for more than 25 years,” remarks Sydney Opera House head of contemporary music Ben Marshall. “After hosting them at Vivid LIVE in the Studio in 2011 and on the Northern Broadwalk in 2017, it’s a thrill to finally hand them the keys to the Sydney Opera House Forecourt.”
paras.zh: “25 年来，《雪崩》混乱的精湛技艺和魅力为世界各地的耳朵和脚带来了无与伦比的欢乐，”悉尼歌剧院当代音乐总监本·马歇尔 (Ben Marshall) 说道。 “继 2011 年在工作室 Vivid LIVE 和 2017 年在北大道 (Northern Broadwalk) 接待他们之后，最终将悉尼歌剧院前院的钥匙交给他们真是令人兴奋。”

paras.en: From the very start, The Avalanches “have continually reconstructed the DNA of electronic music with a generous cast of brilliantly curated, visionary guests,” Marshall enthuses. “Experiencing their kaleidoscopic, deeply human storytelling on the grandest stage our city can offer will be an extraordinary summer moment – and a hell of a lot of fun.”
paras.zh: 马歇尔兴奋地说，从一开始，雪崩乐队就“不断重建电子音乐的 DNA，拥有大量精心策划、富有远见的嘉宾”。 “在我们城市所能提供的最宏伟的舞台上体验他们千变万化、深刻的人性化故事，将是一个非凡的夏日时刻——而且充满乐趣。”

paras.en: Joining The Avalanches on those final east coast shows (Melbourne, Brisbane, Sydney) is HAAi, the Australia-born, London-based electronic music artist, whose new 10-track collection, DIGITiSE, drops Oct. 9 via Mute Records.
paras.zh: 出生于澳大利亚、现居伦敦的电子音乐艺术家 HAAi 将与 The Avalanches 一起参加东海岸最后的演出（墨尔本、布里斯班、悉尼），他的全新 10 首曲目合集 DIGITiSE 将于 10 月 9 日通过 Mute Records 发售。

paras.en: The Avalanches are gearing up for the release of their own, fourth studio album, No Bad Memories (via Modular Recordings), due out Oct. 16.
paras.zh: Avalanches 正在准备发行他们自己的第四张录音室专辑《No Bad Memories》（通过 Modular Recordings），将于 10 月 16 日发行。

paras.en: With their debut 2000 album Since I Left You, The Avalanches created an instant classic. Its genius, slivers of thousands of vinyl samples from the likes of Françoise Hardy, Sérgio Mendes, Raekwon, Wayne and Shuster, and even Madonna, painstakingly, surgically woven into a musical patchwork.
paras.zh: The Avalanches 于 2000 年凭借首张专辑《Since I Left You》创造了经典。它的天才之处在于，将来自 Françoise Hardy、Sérgio Mendes、Raekwon、Wayne 和 Shuster，甚至 Madonna 等人的数千张黑胶唱片样本片段，精心地、外科手术般地编织成音乐拼凑而成。

paras.en: The result, which included the title track and “Frontier Psychiatrist,” was a collection that was both timeless, and immediate. Or, as a statement from the band’s reps suggests, “a global footprint for collaborative sampology in the 21st century.”
paras.zh: 结果，包括主打歌和“Frontier Psychiatrist”，是一个既永恒又直接的集合。或者，正如乐队代表的一份声明所暗示的那样，“21 世纪合作萨姆学的全球足迹。”

paras.en: Its followup was 16 years in the making. Many thought it would never see the light of day. When it did arrive, Wildflower immediately went to No. 1 on the ARIA Albums Chart. A third album travelled at comparative warp-speed in 2020, We Will Always Love You, and later scooped the coveted Australian Music Prize, for the best album of the year.
paras.zh: 其后续作品的制作耗时16年。许多人认为它永远不会见到曙光。当它到达时，《Wildflower》立即在 ARIA 专辑排行榜上名列第一。 2020 年，第三张专辑《We Will Always Love You》以相对惊人的速度发行，随后荣获了令人垂涎的澳大利亚音乐奖年度最佳专辑。

paras.en: The new project, Chater explains, began with “rhythmic experiments using the sonic leftovers and hallmarks of the technologies we grew up with,” with recordings of hard drives, computer hardware and forgotten technologies becoming part of the album’s sonic palette.
paras.zh: 查特解释说，这个新项目始于“利用我们成长过程中所留下的声音和技术特征进行节奏实验”，硬盘、计算机硬件和被遗忘的技术的录音成为专辑声音调色板的一部分。

paras.en: No Bad Memories includes the previously released cuts “Together” with Nikki Nair, Jessy Lanza and Prentiss; “Every Single Weekend” with Jamie xx; “Blue Shadows” with Karen O; “Can’t Get Over Losing You” with Portraits of Tracy; and most recently “Far Away” with John Glacier and Khadija Al Hanafi.
paras.zh: 《No Bad Memories》包括之前与 Nikki Nair、Jessy Lanza 和 Prentiss 一起发布的剪辑版《Together》；与 Jamie xx 合作的《Every Single Weekend》；与凯伦·欧 (Karen O) 合作的《蓝色阴影》； 《无法忘记失去你》与特蕾西的肖像；以及最近与 John Glacier 和 Khadija Al Hanafi 合作的《Far Away》。

paras.en: The general onsale for the 2027 Australia tour starts Tuesday, Oct. 6 at 9am local time. Click here for tickets and information. The artist pre-sale opens earlier.
paras.zh: 2027 年澳大利亚巡演的全面预售将于当地时间 10 月 6 日星期二上午 9 点开始。单击此处获取门票和信息。艺术家预售提前开始。

paras.en: Before heading home, The Avalanches will complete a run of dates across Continental Europe and the United Kingdom, including a sold-out show Nov. 27 at The Roundhouse in London.
paras.zh: 在回国之前，The Avalanches 将完成在欧洲大陆和英国的一系列演出，其中包括 11 月 27 日在伦敦 The Roundhouse 举行的一场门票全部售完的演出。

paras.en: “We’re crazy excited to be back on home soil playing these shows in Australia,” reads a statement from the act. “We can’t wait to be back in a room with people and seeing where the night takes us. We’ve got a lot of new music we’re excited to play, alongside some old favorites, and we can’t wait to spend a few nights making some beautiful noise and memories together.”
paras.zh: “我们非常高兴能够回到澳大利亚的家乡演出这些节目，”该剧团的一份声明中写道。 “我们迫不及待地想回到与人们一起的房间，看看夜晚会带我们去哪里。我们有很多我们很高兴能演奏的新音乐，还有一些旧的最爱，我们迫不及待地想花几个晚上一起制造一些美丽的噪音和回忆。”

paras.en: Saturday, Feb. 27 — Perth Festival, East Perth Power Station
paras.zh: 2 月 27 日星期六 — 珀斯节，东珀斯发电站

paras.zh: 2 月 28 日星期日——珀斯节，东珀斯发电站，珀斯（*已售完）

paras.en: Thursday, March 4 — Hindley St Music Hall, Adelaide
paras.zh: 3 月 4 日，星期四 — Hindley St 音乐厅，阿德莱德

paras.en: Friday, March 5 — Royal Botanic Gardens, Melbourne
paras.zh: 3 月 5 日星期五——墨尔本皇家植物园

paras.en: Saturday, March 6 — On The Banks, Brisbane
paras.zh: 3 月 6 日星期六——布里斯班河畔

articles.title: Aventura and Don Omar’s ‘Ella y Yo’ Enters YouTube’s Billion Views Club
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: More than 20 years after its release, Aventura and Don Omar’s “Ella y Yo” (“Her and I”) is granted entry to the club. YouTube’s Billion Views Club, no less.
paras.zh: 发行 20 多年后，Aventura 和 Don Omar 的“Ella y Yo”（“她和我”）获准进入该俱乐部。 YouTube 的十亿观看俱乐部，同样如此。

paras.en: Aventura, the New York Kings of Bachata, and Don Omar, the Puerto Rican reggaeton star, became regular collaborators after teaming up on the 2005 single, a slow-burning reggaeton-bachata number about a troubled love affair.
paras.zh: 纽约巴恰塔之王 Aventura 和波多黎各雷鬼明星唐·奥马尔 (Don Omar) 在 2005 年合作制作了这首单曲后成为了固定合作伙伴，这是一首缓慢燃烧的雷鬼巴恰塔歌曲，讲述了一段陷入困境的爱情。

paras.en: Although the song barely cracked the Billboard Hot 100 following its release, peaking at No. 97, the single did go to No. 2 on the Hot Latin Songs chart, led the Latin Rhythm Airplay and Tropical Airplay charts, and embarked on a journey that continues to this day.
paras.zh: 尽管这首歌在发行后勉强跻身 Billboard Hot 100，最高排名第 97 位，但它确实在热门拉丁歌曲排行榜上排名第二，在拉丁节奏 Airplay 和热带 Airplay 排行榜上名列前茅，并踏上了一直持续到今天的旅程。

paras.en: The following year, at the 2006 Latin Billboard Music Awards, the song earned a nomination (for Hot Latin Song of the Year by Vocal Duet or Collaboration).
paras.zh: 次年，在 2006 年拉丁公告牌音乐奖上，这首歌获得了提名（Vocal Duet 或 Collaboration 年度热门拉丁歌曲）。

paras.en: Its official music video, which was uploaded in 2019 and now clocks up one billion views, was shot in the style of a telenovela. Ulysses Terrero directed the clip, which captures Latin melodrama at its steamiest and is now a bonafide streaming hit.
paras.zh: 其官方音乐视频于 2019 年上传，目前观看次数已达 10 亿次，采用电视剧风格拍摄。尤利西斯·泰雷罗 (Ulysses Terrero) 执导了这段视频，捕捉了拉丁情节剧最火热的时刻，现已成为流媒体热门节目。

paras.en: “Ella y Yo” appeared on Aventura’s fourth studio album God’s Project from 2004, and on Don Omar’s compilation Da Hitman Presents Reggaetón Latino, released in 2005. In the years that followed, Aventura opened for Don Omar’s tour in support of his sophomore studio effort, King of Kings.
paras.zh: 《Ella y Yo》出现在 Aventura 2004 年的第四张录音室专辑《God's Project》中，以及 Don Omar 于 2005 年发行的合辑《Da Hitman Presents Reggaetón Latino》中。在接下来的几年里，Aventura 为 Don Omar 的巡演拉开了帷幕，以支持他的第二张工作室作品《King of Kings》。

paras.en: The duet still hits the mark with fans. At Aventura concerts, random concert goers are often brought to the stage to perform the Don Omar part. That happened when Aventura kicked off their Inmortal tour in Los Angeles in 2020, when Romeo Santos, Lenny Santos, Henry Santos and Max Agende Santos challenged a member of the crowd. It was a “spot-on performance,” Billboard’s Griselda Flores wrote at the time.
paras.zh: 这首二重唱至今仍深受歌迷喜爱。在 Aventura 音乐会上，随机的音乐会观众经常被带到舞台上表演唐·奥马尔的部分。这发生在 Aventura 于 2020 年在洛杉矶开始他们的 Inmortal 巡演时，当时罗密欧·桑托斯、莱尼·桑托斯、亨利·桑托斯和马克斯·阿根德·桑托斯向人群中的一名成员提出了挑战。 Billboard 的 Griselda Flores 当时写道，这是一场“恰到好处的表演”。

paras.en: The official video for “Ella y Yo” is Aventura’s first to hit the one billion streams milestone, and Omar’s third video as a lead, featured artist or collaborator to pass the mark.
paras.zh: 《Ella y Yo》的官方视频是 Aventura 首个突破 10 亿流媒体里程碑的视频，也是 Omar 作为主唱、特色艺术家或合作者第三个通过这一里程碑的视频。

paras.en: Watch the official music video below for “Ella y Yo” by Aventura featuring Don Omar.
paras.zh: 观看下面由 Aventura 与 Don Omar 合作的“Ella y Yo”的官方音乐视频。

articles.title: Kobalt Co-Founder Willard Ahdritz Launches Music & Media Tech Venture Firm
articles.author: Elizabeth Dilts Marshall

paras.en: Willard Ahdritz, the co-founder and longtime CEO of Kobalt Music Group, has launched a new music and media technology investment fund, Ahdritz Capital Partners, and named its second big hire: investment partner Isabel Keulen. The news was announced Thursday (Oct. 1).
paras.zh: Kobalt Music Group 联合创始人兼长期首席执行官 Willard Ahdritz 推出了新的音乐和媒体技术投资基金 Ahdritz Capital Partners，并任命了第二位重要员工：投资合伙人 Isabel Keulen。该消息于周四（10 月 1 日）宣布。

paras.en: Keulen was previously CEO of the Stockholm School of Economics’ startup incubator, SSE Business Lab, and its early-stage venture capital fund, SSE Ventures. Based in Sweden, the investment banking and tech venture veteran will work alongside Stephen Langer, who joined Ahdritz Capital earlier this year from Lazard’s Media, Entertainment & Sports group, where he helped build the group’s music M&A practice.
paras.zh: Keulen 曾担任斯德哥尔摩经济学院创业孵化器 SSE Business Lab 及其早期风险投资基金 SSE Ventures 的首席执行官。这位常驻瑞典的投资银行和科技风险资深人士将与 Stephen Langer 一起工作，后者于今年早些时候从 Lazard 的媒体、娱乐和体育集团加入 Ahdritz Capital，在那里他帮助建立了该集团的音乐并购业务。

paras.en: Over a multi-decade career in the music and fintech industries, including 20 years as Kobalt’s CEO, Ahdritz has managed $1.7 billion in music assets and facilitated $10-$12 billion in creator funds at Kobalt. Since stepping down from his role as chairman of Kobalt following its sale to Primary Wave in July, his goal with Ahdritz Capital has been to help international companies establish themselves in the United States and other key markets by helping with introductions, resources and hands-on support from Ahdritz’s New York headquarters.
paras.zh: 在音乐和金融科技行业数十年的职业生涯中，包括担任 Kobalt 首席执行官 20 年，Ahdritz 管理着 17 亿美元的音乐资产，并为 Kobalt 提供了 10-120 亿美元的创作者基金。自 7 月份 Kobalt 出售给 Primary Wave 后，他辞去了 Kobalt 董事长一职，自此，他在 Ahdritz Capital 的目标一直是通过 Ahdritz 纽约总部的介绍、资源和实际支持，帮助国际公司在美国和其他主要市场站稳脚跟。

paras.en: “Twice I have been out on the street in New York pitching my own start-up, so I know firsthand how hard it is to land on a new continent and build the operations and network from nothing,” said Ahdritz. “We will be hands-on with founders on the hard questions. To be big globally, you have to be big in the U.S.”
paras.zh: 阿德里茨说：“我曾两次在纽约街头推销自己的初创企业，因此我亲身体会到登陆新大陆并从无到有建立运营和网络是多么困难。” “我们将与创始人一起解决难题。要想在全球范围内做大，就必须在美国做大。”

paras.en: Ahdritz’s $20 million fund has made investments in New Dehli-based distributor Madverse Music Group and superfan music platform Even, in addition to Fever, Soundtrack, un:hurd music and other creator engagement platforms including Telly, Sweet, SCOR and Airspot.
paras.zh: Ahdritz 的 2000 万美元基金已投资于新德里的发行商 Madverse Music Group 和超级粉丝音乐平台 Even，此外还有 Fever、Soundtrack、un:hurd music 和其他创作者参与平台，包括 Telly、Sweet、SCOR 和 Airspot。

paras.en: Founded in 2023 by CEO Rohan Nesho Jain, Madverse provides digital distribution services to independent music clients for a monthly fee starting at $19.99, similar to TuneCore and DistroKid. It differs from those competitors in that it uses AI to enhance its publishing, administration, advertising and other services to keep pace with its rapid growth. Madverse has added around 100,000 users over the past 18 months for a total of 200,000 independent artist and label clients across more than 40 countries.
paras.zh: Madverse 由首席执行官 Rohan Nesho Jain 于 2023 年创立，为独立音乐客户提供数字发行服务，每月费用为 19.99 美元起，类似于 TuneCore 和 DistroKid。它与其他竞争对手的不同之处在于，它利用人工智能来增强其出版、管理、广告和其他服务，以跟上其快速增长的步伐。 Madverse 在过去 18 个月中增加了约 100,000 名用户，在 40 多个国家/地区总共拥有 200,000 名独立艺术家和唱片公司客户。

paras.en: The addition of Keulen will add to Ahdritz Capital’s eye for AI innovators, Ahdritz says. Before SSE, Keulen was a principal at Spintop Ventures backing early-stage technology companies.
paras.zh: Ahdritz 表示，Keulen 的加入将增强 Ahdritz Capital 对人工智能创新者的关注。在加入 SSE 之前，Keulen 是 Spintop Ventures 的负责人，为早期科技公司提供支持。

paras.en: “[Ahdritz] has spent 25 years proving that backing creators and founders on fair terms builds real, lasting companies, and he started before Sweden even had a unicorn,” Keulen said in a statement, referring to the business nickname for start-ups with valuations of more than $1 billion. “Today, Stockholm produces more unicorns per capita than any city outside of Silicon Valley, with several of the biggest tied to music and the creator economy.”
paras.zh: “[Ahdritz] 花了 25 年的时间证明，以公平的条件支持创造者和创始人可以建立真正、持久的公司，而且他在瑞典甚至还没有独角兽之前就开始创业了，”科伊伦在一份声明中说，他指的是估值超过 10 亿美元的初创企业的商业绰号。 “如今，斯德哥尔摩的人均独角兽数量比硅谷以外的任何城市都多，其中几家最大的独角兽与音乐和创作者经济有关。”

paras.en: Langer, who joined Ahdritz Capital in May, brings a decade of experience in entertainment and media finance, most recently at Lazard. Not only did Lazard serve as the exclusive financial advisor to Primary Wave on its acquisition of Kobalt from Francisco Partners, it was also the exclusive financial advisor to Searchlight Capital on its strategic investment into Chord Music Partners.
paras.zh: 兰格于 5 月加入 Ahdritz Capital，他在娱乐和媒体金融领域拥有十年的经验，最近在 Lazard 工作。 Lazard 不仅担任 Primary Wave 从 Francisco Partners 手中收购 Kobalt 的独家财务顾问，还担任 Searchlight Capital 对 Chord Music Partners 战略投资的独家财务顾问。

paras.en: “It’s been incredible to work alongside Willard, an innovator in our industry, and build ACP with him the last few months,” Langer said in a statement. “We have a great team in place to support the next wave of music and media technology companies.”
paras.zh: 兰格在一份声明中表示：“在过去的几个月里，与我们行业的创新者威拉德一起工作，并与他一起建立 ACP，真是令人难以置信。” “我们拥有一支优秀的团队来支持下一波音乐和媒体技术公司。”

articles.title: Miu Miu Popularized Double-Lace Shoes — These 10 Brands Are Following Suit
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Sometimes the most significant fashion trends are truly the least complicated. Exhibit A: the double-lace shoe. It’s exactly what it sounds like — doubling up contrasting laces on a single sneaker — and yet, it delivers a whole new color or textural element to a simple pair of trainers.
paras.zh: 有时，最重要的时尚趋势确实是最简单的。展品A：双鞋带鞋。正如它听起来的那样——在一双运动鞋上加倍对比色鞋带——然而，它为一双简单的运动鞋带来了全新的颜色或纹理元素。

paras.en: While New Balance x Miu Miu’s double-lace design wasn’t invented in a vacuum, the high-end, low-profile kicks can surely take some credit for popularizing the style. Cut to 2026: In addition to Miu Miu, which continues to implement this doubled up element, dozens of best-selling brands and premium labels are mirroring the look.
paras.zh: 虽然 New Balance x Miu Miu 的双鞋带设计并不是凭空发明的，但高端、低调的鞋款无疑为这种风格的普及做出了一些贡献。时间切至 2026 年：除了继续采用这种双重元素的 Miu Miu 之外，数十个畅销品牌和高端品牌也在效仿这一外观。

paras.en: Each season, Nordstrom curates a “What’s Hot Now” trend guide, breaking down the pieces, patterns and aesthetics dominating the fashion space. At the top of the list for fall 2026? Animal Prints, ’90s archival workwear and, of course, double-lace shoes.
paras.zh: 每一季，Nordstrom 都会策划一份“当下流行趋势”指南，详细分析主导时尚领域的单品、图案和美学。排在 2026 年秋季榜单的首位？动物印花、90 年代经典工装，当然还有双鞋带鞋。

paras.en: Below, 10 more top brands doing the trend right.
paras.zh: 下面是另外 10 个顺应潮流的顶级品牌。

articles.title: ‘South America’ Takes on the Literal Dicks of Big Tech Billionaires in New Episode
articles.author: Kevin Dolak

paras.en: The rift between the billionaire class’s old-money elites and their nouveau riche tech-world younger brethren is no match for Butters Stotch on this week’s South America (née South Park), as the new episode, “Billionaire Weenietown,” marks another return to form for the Comedy Central mainstay after two seasons spent in Trumpland.
paras.zh: 亿万富翁阶级的老钱精英和他们的暴发户科技世界的年轻兄弟之间的裂痕与巴特斯·斯多奇在本周的《南美》（原南方公园）中无法匹敌，因为新一集《亿万富翁威尼镇》标志着喜剧中心中流砥柱在特朗普乐园度过两季之后再次回归。

paras.en: Butters, the perpetual fifth wheel to the show’s four main characters at South Park Elementary, is belligerent as the episode opens. He treats a class assignment, a presentation on his “happy place,” as an opportunity to publicly rail against Weenietown, a new menace and legitimate threat to the quiet, podunk Colorado town we’ve followed for nearly three decades.
paras.zh: 巴特斯是南方公园小学四个主角的永远的第五轮，在剧集一开始就表现得好战。他把课堂作业、关于他“快乐的地方”的演讲当作公开批评威尼敦的机会，威尼敦是对我们近三十年来关注的安静、简陋的科罗拉多小镇的新威胁和合法威胁。

paras.en: Why is sweet Butters so irate? It’s the tech billionaires, of course, and the new data center in his backyard that keeps cutting into his peace, which is, of course, the soothing effect of watching episode after episode of Dr. Pimple Popper. The billionaires in question here are not the Elon Musks or Sam Altmans of the world. They are little anthropomorphized penises who can’t stop sharing their opinions on podcasts (“Who went on the Joe Rogan podcast last night?”), and watching these dicks deal with their infighting is a hoot.
paras.zh: 为什么甜蜜的巴特斯如此愤怒？当然，是科技亿万富翁和他后院的新数据中心不断打破他的平静，这当然是观看一集又一集的《粉刺波普尔博士》所带来的舒缓效果。这里讨论的亿万富翁不是世界上的埃隆·马斯克或萨姆·奥尔特曼。他们是拟人化的小阴茎，不停地在播客上分享自己的观点（“昨晚谁上了乔·罗根的播客？”），看着这些家伙处理他们的内讧是一件很有趣的事情。

paras.en: As the episode marches on, a B-plot has Butters’ parents blaming the MMR vaccine for turning their son into a “libtard” (who is also trans). The gag works at first, then grows a bit repetitive. Meanwhile, Butters teams up with a small but determined billionaire woman penis (somehow). A penis problem-solver, she negotiates a deal for Butters and all of Weenietown to get rid of the younger set in town. After the two find a way to jettison the problematic penises, the young boy learns that the young billionaire set really does suck.
paras.zh: 随着剧情的发展，巴特斯的父母指责 MMR 疫苗将他们的儿子变成了“libtard”（也是跨性别者）。这个恶作剧一开始是有效的，然后就变得有点重复了。与此同时，巴特斯与一位小而坚定的亿万富翁女性阴茎（不知何故）合作。作为阴茎问题的解决者，她为巴特斯和威尼镇所有人谈判达成一项协议，以摆脱镇上的年轻人。在两人找到了抛弃有问题的阴茎的方法后，小男孩得知年轻的亿万富翁确实很糟糕。

paras.en: If last week’s season debut of South America represented a return to form for the beloved, long-running show, this episode is the second half of a one-two punch. The show is now firmly grounded in its titular town and bringing back fully Butters-centric episodes, which are always welcome among the series’ superfans. But creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone had a final trick up their sleeve.
paras.zh: 如果说上周的《南美》季首秀代表着这部深受喜爱的长剧的回归，那么这一集就是一场二打一的后半段。该剧现已牢牢扎根于其同名小镇，并带回完全以巴特斯为中心的剧集，这些剧集始终受到该剧超级粉丝的欢迎。但创作者特雷·帕克和马特·斯通还有最后的绝招。

paras.en: As the credits ran, viewers saw the return of A.I. Donald Trump. Recall that Season 27 included a phony Trump campaign ad featuring a desperate, dehydrated Don walking through the desert, only to find his penis talking to him. Now that talking penis gets its own send-off after the episode follows the president into the bathroom, concluding with his penis finally finding freedom from a very confused president. The White House has not yet commented.
paras.zh: 随着片尾字幕的播放，观众们看到了人工智能的回归。唐纳德·特朗普。回想一下，第 27 季中有一个虚假的特朗普竞选广告，广告中绝望、脱水的唐走过沙漠，结果发现他的阴茎在和他说话。现在，在总统走进浴室的这一集之后，会说话的阴茎得到了自己的欢送，最后他的阴茎终于从一位非常困惑的总统那里找到了自由。白宫尚未发表评论。

articles.title: Disney+ Strikes Streaming Bundle and Content-Sharing Deal With Indonesia’s Vidio
articles.author: Patrick Brzeski

paras.en: Disney+ is joining forces with Indonesia’s leading streamer Vidio, creating a new local subscription bundle and content-sharing partnership that adds to the Hollywood giant’s expanding network of distribution alliances across Asia-Pacific.
paras.zh: Disney+ 正在与印度尼西亚领先的流媒体 Vidio 联手，创建新的本地订阅捆绑包和内容共享合作伙伴关系，从而增强这家好莱坞巨头在亚太地区不断扩大的发行联盟网络。

paras.en: Announced Thursday, the deal will create the Vidio Ultimate Disney+ All Screen Bundle, which combines access to the two companies’ content offerings under a single subscription. The package brings Disney’s films, global franchises and Asian originals together with Vidio’s Indonesian programming, live television and sports rights, including Premier League soccer, the UEFA Champions League and Indonesia’s BRI Super League.
paras.zh: 周四宣布，该交易将创建 Vidio Ultimate Disney+ All Screen Bundle，通过单一订阅即可访问两家公司的内容产品。该套餐将迪士尼电影、全球特许经营权和亚洲原创作品与 Vidio 的印尼节目、电视直播和体育赛事版权结合在一起，包括英超足球、欧洲冠军联赛和印尼“一带一路”超级联赛。

paras.en: The new partners did not disclose pricing for the new bundle, nor overall financial terms.
paras.zh: 新合作伙伴没有透露新捆绑包的定价，也没有透露总体财务条款。

paras.en: “By bringing Disney+’s beloved films and award-winning series together with Vidio’s local entertainment ecosystem, we’re elevating the streaming experience for fans and new audiences. Indonesia is an incredibly exciting market for Disney+, and we’re delighted to collaborate with Vidio,” said Tony Zameczkowski, Disney’s senior vp and general manager of direct-to-consumer, Asia-Pacific. “This announcement is part of our focus on accelerating collaborations to expand the reach, engagement and fandom of Disney+ in APAC.”
paras.zh: 迪士尼高级副总裁兼亚太区直接面向消费者业务总经理 Tony Zameczkowski 表示：“通过将 Disney+ 深受喜爱的电影和获奖剧集与 Vidio 的本地娱乐生态系统结合在一起，我们正在提升粉丝和新观众的流媒体体验。印度尼西亚对于 Disney+ 来说是一个非常令人兴奋的市场，我们很高兴与 Vidio 合作。” “这一公告是我们致力于加速合作以扩大 Disney+ 在亚太地区的影响力、参与度和粉丝群体的一部分。”

paras.en: The deal continues Disney’s recent strategy of expanding its reach and programming in Asia through partnerships with top local players. Similar arrangements are already in place with South Korea’s TVING and Hulu Japan, broadcasters SPOTV and Astro, and Japanese content company TBS.
paras.zh: 这笔交易延续了迪士尼近期通过与当地顶级企业合作扩大其在亚洲影响力和节目制作的战略。韩国的 TVING 和 Hulu Japan、广播公司 SPOTV 和 Astro 以及日本内容公司 TBS 也已经做出了类似的安排。

paras.en: The distribution push comes alongside a significant expansion of Disney’s own international production. The company plans to roughly triple Disney+’s annual output of international original series over the next three years, from around 60 to 70 shows this year. Asia-Pacific is a key part of that drive, with Disney building on Korean hits such as Perfect Crown and fortune-telling competition Battle of Fates, while expanding its Japanese programming and adding more romance to its regional slate.
paras.zh: 发行力度的同时，迪士尼自身的国际制作也大幅扩张。该公司计划在未来三年内将 Disney+ 的国际原创剧集年产量增加两倍，从今年的约 60 部增至 70 部。亚太地区是这一举措的关键部分，迪士尼以《完美王冠》和算命竞赛《命运之战》等韩国热门作品为基础，同时扩大了日本节目的制作范围，并为其该地区的节目增添了更多浪漫色彩。

paras.en: For Vidio, the deal brings premium content to an offering already anchored by local entertainment and live sports. The company says it has produced more than 110 original series. According to research from regional consultancy Media Partners Asia, Vidio has ranked first among Indonesia’s streaming platforms for viewership over the past four years.
paras.zh: 对于 Vidio 来说，这笔交易将为已经以本地娱乐和体育直播为主的产品带来优质内容。该公司表示已制作了超过 110 个原创系列。根据区域咨询公司 Media Partners Asia 的研究，过去四年来，Vidio 的收视率在印度尼西亚流媒体平台中排名第一。

paras.en: “Through our collaboration with Disney+, we’re bringing together two complementary entertainment experiences into one of Indonesia’s most complete premium entertainment offerings,” added Vidio CEO Sutanto Hartono. “As entertainment consumption continues to evolve, audiences are looking for greater choice and better value from their subscriptions. With the launch of ‘Vidio Ultimate Disney+ All Screen Bundle’, we’re making it easier than ever for Indonesian audiences to enjoy the best of local stories, global entertainment, and world-class sports through a single, more compelling subscription offering.”
paras.zh: Vidio 首席执行官 Sutanto Hartono 补充道：“通过与 Disney+ 的合作，我们将两种互补的娱乐体验整合到印度尼西亚最完整的优质娱乐产品之一中。” “随着娱乐消费的不断发展，观众正在从订阅中寻求更多的选择和更高的价值。随着‘Vidio Ultimate Disney+ All Screen Bundle’的推出，我们让印度尼西亚观众比以往任何时候都更容易通过单一、更具吸引力的订阅产品享受最好的当地故事、全球娱乐和世界级体育赛事。”
