articles.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham says Iran 'played a part' in British air base incident

paras.en: United Kingdom Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Iran was involved in the incident at the Royal Air Force base in Fairford on Sunday that led to the arrest of five men on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offences.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，伊朗参与了周日在费尔福德皇家空军基地发生的事件，导致五名男子因涉嫌爆炸罪和恐怖主义罪被捕。

paras.en: Speaking to the BBC Wednesday, Burnham said that "There are strong indications that Iran played a part in what happened over the weekend at RAF Fairford," without providing additional details. In response, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on X that Burnham was "barking up the wrong tree."
paras.zh: 伯纳姆周三在接受英国广播公司采访时表示，“有明显迹象表明伊朗参与了周末在英国皇家空军费尔福德发生的事件”，但他没有提供更多细节。作为回应，伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇在 X 上表示，伯纳姆“找错了对象”。

paras.en: RAF Fairford, located in Gloucestershire, has been used as the U.S. Air Force's command outpost for operations from Europe and for American strikes on Iranian missile sites.
paras.zh: 位于格洛斯特郡的英国皇家空军费尔福德基地一直被用作美国空军的前哨基地，负责从欧洲发起的行动以及美国对伊朗导弹基地的打击。

paras.en: London had initially denied the U.S. permission to use UK bases for its war on Iran, but former Prime Minister Keir Starmer had allowed it for "defensive strikes."
paras.zh: 伦敦最初拒绝美国使用英国基地对伊朗发动战争，但前首相基尔·斯塔默允许美国进行“防御性打击”。

paras.en: Burnham's BBC interview comes as U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Fox News on Monday that the incident at RAF Fairford "clearly involves the hands of a foreign actor," without giving any details or evidence.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆接受 BBC 采访之际，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一对福克斯新闻表示，皇家空军费尔福德发生的事件“显然涉及外国演员”，但没有提供任何细节或证据。

paras.en: The Iranian Embassy in London on Monday "categorically" rejected speculation linking the country to the alleged plot.
paras.zh: 伊朗驻伦敦大使馆周一“断然”否认了将该国与所谓阴谋联系起来的猜测。

paras.en: All the five arrested suspects are UK nationals aged between 23 and 25, and one reportedly called the police himself. They have been released on bail.
paras.zh: 被捕的五名嫌疑人均为英国公民，年龄在 23 至 25 岁之间，据报道其中一名嫌疑人亲自报警。他们已被保释。

paras.en: Separately, a U.S. official told MS NOW that Rubio "kicked out" the Iranian delegation as the United Nations General Assembly was over, saying that they had "overstayed their welcome."
paras.zh: 另外，一名美国官员告诉《MS NOW》，卢比奥在联合国大会结束后“踢出了”伊朗代表团，称他们“逗留得太久了”。

paras.en: The officials, including Aragachi, left on Monday morning U.S. time. "UNGA was over, so it was time for them to go," the official added.
paras.zh: 包括阿拉加奇在内的官员于美国时间周一上午离开。 “联合国大会结束了，所以他们该离开了，”这位官员补充道。

paras.en: Indirect negotiations between Washington and Tehran over Iran's nuclear program and the Strait of Hormuz failed to bear any fruit over the course of the U.N. General Assembly.
paras.zh: 华盛顿和德黑兰之间关于伊朗核计划和霍尔木兹海峡的间接谈判在联合国大会期间未能取得任何成果。

paras.en: Tehran had proposed a seven-day deal at the UNGA, under which the Strait of Hormuz would be opened and nuclear talks resumed with the U.S. if Washington returned to the terms of the Islamabad deal framework.
paras.zh: 德黑兰在联合国大会上提出了一项为期7天的协议，根据该协议，如果华盛顿返回伊斯兰堡协议框架的条款，则将开放霍尔木兹海峡并恢复与美国的核谈判。

paras.en: The Islamabad memorandum of understanding in June led to a ceasefire agreement between the U.S. and Iran that collapsed in early July. The Trump administration is unwilling to return to the terms of the June agreement, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal.
paras.zh: 六月的伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录促成了美国和伊朗之间的停火协议，但该协议于七月初破裂。据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普政府不愿回到六月协议的条款。

paras.en: President Donald Trump on Sunday called the latest Iranian proposal "unacceptable," telling reporters that Tehran wants a swift deal because of the economic pressure it is under.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日称伊朗的最新提议“不可接受”，并告诉记者，德黑兰希望迅速达成协议，因为其面临经济压力。

paras.en: — CNBC's Anniek Bao contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Anniek Bao 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Stock futures rise as traders eye elevated Treasury yields, brace for jobs report due this week: Live updates

paras.en: Stock futures were higher early Thursday as Wall Street gears up for the start of a new trading month.
paras.zh: 随着华尔街为新交易月的开始做好准备，股票期货周四早些时候走高。

paras.en: Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 170 points, or 0.33%. S&P 500 futures advanced about 0.56%, and Nasdaq-100 futures gained over 1%.
paras.zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 170 点，涨幅为 0.33%。标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨约 0.56%，纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨超过 1%。

paras.en: In regular trading, the broad-market S&P 500 dropped 0.3%, while the Dow lost more than 440 points, or 0.9%. The Nasdaq Composite outperformed, advancing 0.2% on the day.
paras.zh: 常规交易中，标准普尔 500 指数大盘下跌 0.3%，道指下跌超过 440 点，即 0.9%。纳斯达克综合指数当天上涨 0.2%，跑赢大盘。

paras.en: September, historically a weak month for stocks, wasn't kind to the S&P 500, which dropped 0.5%. Investors grappled with higher oil prices and a surge in Treasury yields, stoking fears of additional rate hikes. The Dow lost 4.3%, while the Nasdaq outperformed and gained 1.9% in the month.
paras.zh: 9 月份历来是股市疲软的月份，对标准普尔 500 指数来说并不好，该指数下跌了 0.5%。投资者面临油价上涨和国债收益率飙升的困境，引发了对进一步加息的担忧。道指下跌 4.3%，而纳斯达克指数本月表现优于大盘，上涨 1.9%。

paras.en: Wednesday also marked the end of the third quarter. The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq each advanced about 2%, while the Dow lost 2.7%.
paras.zh: 周三也标志着第三季度的结束。标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数均上涨约 2%，道指下跌 2.7%。

paras.en: In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 0.86%, while the Topix declined 0.44%. South Korea's benchmark Kospi was down 0.8%, while the small-cap Kosdaq Index started the trading day flat. Mainland China and Hong Kong markets were closed for a holiday.
paras.zh: 亚洲方面，日本日经225指数上涨0.86%，东证指数下跌0.44%。韩国基准 Kospi 指数下跌 0.8%，而小型股科斯达克指数开盘持平。中国内地及香港市场因假期休市。

paras.en: Investors are heading into the new trading month weighing a softer inflation picture against still elevated Treasury yields and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve's next rate decision, which is scheduled for the end of October. They're also looking ahead to a fresh round of earnings reports from companies.
paras.zh: 投资者即将进入新的交易月，权衡通胀形势疲软、国债收益率仍高企以及美联储定于 10 月底做出下一次利率决定的不确定性。他们还期待着公司新一轮的盈利报告。

paras.en: "While those factors remain headwinds, corporate earnings have continued to show resilience," said Tracie McMillion, head of global asset allocation strategy at Wells Fargo Investment Institute. "The key question is whether that earnings strength can continue as borrowing costs remain elevated."
paras.zh: 富国银行投资研究所全球资产配置策略主管特雷西·麦克米利恩表示：“尽管这些因素仍然是不利因素，但企业盈利继续表现出弹性。” “关键问题是，随着借贷成本居高不下，盈利强劲能否持续。”

paras.en: Treasury yields crept higher even as the personal consumption expenditures price index reading for August came in lighter than anticipated. The metric rose 3.4% over the prior 12 months, coming in cooler than the Dow Jones consensus call for 3.7%.
paras.zh: 尽管 8 月份个人消费支出价格指数数据低于预期，但美国国债收益率却小幅走高。该指标在过去 12 个月中上涨了 3.4%，低于道琼斯一致预测的 3.7%。

paras.en: The 10-year Treasury yield breached 5.3% at one point on Wednesday, trading near 2007 highs. The 30-year yield surpassed 5.6%, reaching its highest level since 2002.
paras.zh: 周三，10 年期国债收益率一度突破 5.3%，接近 2007 年高点。 30年期国债收益率超过5.6%，达到2002年以来的最高水平。

paras.en: On Thursday, investors will digest initial jobless claims, due out at 8:30 a.m. ET. That release will be followed by Friday's September jobs report.
paras.zh: 周四，投资者将消化首次申请失业救济人数，预计将于美国东部时间上午 8:30 公布。该报告发布后将发布周五的九月就业报告。

paras.en: Nike will report earnings after the bell.
paras.zh: 耐克将在盘后公布财报。

articles.title: South Korean President Lee pushes back on Alaska LNG project after Trump touts Seoul's participation

paras.en: South Korea's $200 billion investment into the U.S., which President Donald Trump said would transform America "for generations," is not a done deal in totality.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，韩国对美国的 2000 亿美元投资将“为数代人”改变美国，但这项投资尚未完全完成。

paras.en: The South Korean investment plan includes nuclear power plants, a natural gas power facility in Texas and potentially the long-planned Alaska LNG project.
paras.zh: 韩国的投资计划包括核电站、德克萨斯州的天然气发电设施以及可能长期计划的阿拉斯加液化天然气项目。

paras.en: Trump in a Truth Social post late Wednesday stateside said the countries had agreed to work on the Alaska LNG project, pegging its value at $50 billion, drawing a response from South Korea's President Lee Jae Myung, who emphasized that involvement in some of the projects remains subject to commercial considerations.
paras.zh: 周三晚些时候，特朗普在美国本土的《Truth Social》帖子中表示，两国已同意合作开发阿拉斯加液化天然气项目，并将其价值确定为 500 亿美元，韩国总统李在明对此作出回应，他强调参与某些项目仍需出于商业考虑。

paras.en: Lee in an X post on Thursday local time said that participation in the Alaska LNG project was dependent on its financial viability and legal compliance. He added that investments in nuclear power plants would also require assessment of commercial viability on a plant-by-plant basis.
paras.zh: Lee于当地时间周四在X帖子中表示，参与阿拉斯加液化天然气项目取决于其财务可行性和法律合规性。他补充说，对核电站的投资还需要对每个工厂的商业可行性进行评估。

paras.en: Trump had hailed South Korean investments in his post late Wednesday stateside, saying that the countries had agreed to work on the Alaska LNG project, pegging its value at $50 billion.
paras.zh: 周三晚些时候，特朗普在美国国内的帖子中对韩国的投资表示欢迎，称两国已同意合作开发阿拉斯加液化天然气项目，并将其价值定为 500 亿美元。

paras.en: The joint statement earlier on Wednesday, however, had mentioned that work on the project was contingent on "commercial reasonableness," without highlighting details on allocations toward the project.
paras.zh: 然而，周三早些时候的联合声明提到，该项目的工作取决于“商业合理性”，但没有强调该项目拨款的细节。

paras.en: The Alaska LNG project seeks to transport natural gas roughly 1,300 kilometers from fields on Alaska's North Slope to the southern part of the state, where it would be liquefied for export to markets including Asia, reported Yonhap. The project has faced longstanding questions over its economics given the large upfront investment required.
paras.zh: 据韩联社报道，阿拉斯加液化天然气项目旨在将天然气从阿拉斯加北坡的油田运输到该州南部约 1,300 公里，在那里液化后出口到亚洲等市场。由于需要大量的前期投资，该项目长期以来一直面临着经济问题。

paras.en: Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan had described it as "high-risk" last year and said participation would be difficult unless it could generate sufficient cash flow.
paras.zh: 工业部长金正宽去年曾将其描述为“高风险”，并表示除非能够产生足够的现金流，否则参与将很困难。

paras.en: Overall, the investment package includes $22.3 billion for a 6,472-megawatt natural gas power facility in Encinal, Texas, that will supply electricity to co-located data centers. The project will be led by developer Related Companies and U.S. power company NextEra Energy, with the first phase expected to begin commercial operations in 2029 and the full facility coming online in stages by 2032.
paras.zh: 总体而言，该投资计划包括 223 亿美元，用于在德克萨斯州恩西纳尔建设一座 6,472 兆瓦的天然气发电设施，该设施将为位于同一地点的数据中心供电。该项目将由开发商Related Companies和美国电力公司NextEra Energy牵头，第一阶段预计将于2029年开始商业运营，整个设施将于2032年分阶段上线。

paras.en: Trump said the investments would turn South Korea's commitments into "huge construction projects" and create "tens of thousands of American jobs."
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，这些投资将把韩国的承诺转化为“大型建设项目”，并创造“数以万计的美国就业机会”。

paras.en: "These are massive energy projects, adding power capacity in the United States," Trump said. "This is new construction, new manufacturing, and great jobs for American workers."
paras.zh: 特朗普表示：“这些都是大型能源项目，增加了美国的电力容量。” “这是新的建筑、新的制造业，为美国工人提供了很好的就业机会。”

paras.en: The two countries said they would seek to expand Korean companies' participation in the Texas project across equipment supply, engineering and construction, as well as long-term operations and maintenance. The U.S. also intends to give Korean companies opportunities to supply equipment, including turbines, to similar projects in the country.
paras.zh: 两国表示，将寻求扩大韩国公司在德克萨斯州项目中的设备供应、工程和施工以及长期运营和维护方面的参与。美国还打算为韩国公司提供机会，为该国的类似项目提供包括涡轮机在内的设备。

paras.en: Another $120 billion has been allocated to plans for eight large-scale nuclear reactors in the U.S. Of that amount, $100 billion is earmarked for construction costs and $20 billion for contingency reserves.
paras.zh: 另外1200亿美元已拨款用于美国八座大型核反应堆的计划。其中，1000亿美元专门用于建设成本，200亿美元用于应急储备。

paras.en: The nuclear agreement was signed by both governments as well as Westinghouse Electric, Korea Electric Power Corp. and Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power. The plan also calls for pursuing a potential significant minority investment in Westinghouse by Korean companies, with the terms subject to commercial negotiations.
paras.zh: 该核协议由两国政府以及西屋电气公司、韩国电力公司和韩国水力与核电公司签署。该计划还呼吁韩国公司寻求对西屋电气进行潜在的重大少数股权投资，具体条款需进行商业谈判。

articles.title: Satellite images reveal ethereal auroral storm raging above the North Pole

paras.en: Auroras swirling above the North Pole are a gorgeous sight from Earth’s surface—and from space.
paras.zh: 从地球表面和太空看，北极上空旋转的极光是一道美丽的风景。

paras.en: A satellite named Smile has captured an auroral substorm raging above the North Pole. The footage represents the first images released from the mission’s ultraviolet (UV) camera. The satellite was launched into a highly elliptical orbit above Earth in May and is a collaboration between the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Chinese Academy of Sciences to study solar and geomagnetic storms and space weather.
paras.zh: 一颗名为“微笑”的卫星捕捉到了北极上空肆虐的极光亚暴。这段视频是该任务的紫外线 (UV) 相机发布的第一批​​图像。这颗卫星于 5 月发射到地球上空的高椭圆轨道，是欧洲航天局 (ESA) 和中国科学院合作的项目，旨在研究太阳和地磁风暴以及太空天气。

paras.en: The images show the somewhat hurricanelike swirl of UV light during the auroral substorm over the North Pole. This kind of storm is caused by solar wind interacting with Earth’s magnetic field.
paras.zh: 这些图像显示了北极上空极光亚暴期间有点像飓风的紫外线漩涡。这种风暴是由太阳风与地球磁场相互作用引起的。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Taken on July 24, during a particularly large influx of solar particles into the atmosphere, the observations reveal the full extent of the northern lights in UV light.
paras.zh: 7 月 24 日，在大量太阳粒子涌入大气期间，观测结果揭示了紫外线中北极光的全部范围。

paras.en: Storms like this are best viewed in the ultraviolet range because there’s no interference from daytime sunlight. Smile will be recording auroras for 45 hours at a time, according to the ESA.
paras.zh: 像这样的风暴最好在紫外线范围内观看，因为没有白天阳光的干扰。据 ESA 称，Smile 将一次记录 45 小时的极光。

paras.en: Smile’s x-ray camera also captured the bright remnants of a distant exploding star—but in the future, it, too, will be pointed at Earth in order to better understand our planet’s place in space.
paras.zh: Smile 的 X 射线相机还捕捉到了一颗遥远恒星爆炸的明亮遗迹，但在未来，它也将指向地球，以便更好地了解我们的星球在太空中的位置。

paras.en: Great science journalism requires human expertise, time, effort and creativity. And it costs money. That’s why I and the journalists here at Scientific American hope you’ll join our community.
paras.zh: 伟大的科学新闻需要人类的专业知识、时间、努力和创造力。而且这需要花钱。这就是为什么我和《科学美国人》的记者希望您加入我们的社区。

paras.en: Jeanna Bryner, Editor in Chief, Scientific American
paras.zh: Jeanna Bryner，《科学美国人》主编

articles.title: The Atlantic hurricane season has been so quiet it’s unprecedented

paras.en: We’ve never had an Atlantic hurricane season without a single hurricane through the end of September since reliable records began—until now.
paras.zh: 自从有可靠记录以来，直到现在，我们从未经历过一个在九月底没有飓风的大西洋飓风季节。

paras.en: That fact underscores how remarkable this season has been, with an exceptionally strong El Niño—likely to become the biggest in living memory—keeping a lid on tropical cyclone activity in the Atlantic while supercharging it in the eastern Pacific (and giving Hawaii one of its busiest seasons on record).
paras.zh: 这一事实凸显了这个季节的非凡，异常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象（可能成为人们记忆中最严重的厄尔尼诺现象）限制了大西洋的热带气旋活动，同时增强了东太平洋的热带气旋活动（并使夏威夷成为有记录以来最繁忙的季节之一）。

paras.en: “No hurricanes through September is unprecedented in the modern record, and it’s a little surreal to look at the maps every day this month and see the deep tropics basically shut off,” says meteorologist Michael Lowry.
paras.zh: 气象学家迈克尔·洛瑞 (Michael Lowry) 表示：“在现代记录中，整个 9 月份都没有出现飓风，这在现代记录中是史无前例的，这个月每天查看地图，看到深热带地区基本被封锁，这有点超现实。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: There isn’t a single other hurricane season in the reliable records where there wasn’t at least one hurricane from sometime between the June 1 start of the season and the end of September. The lack of any hurricanes so far this season is particularly jarring because September is usually when tropical cyclone activity peaks in the Atlantic: at that time, ocean waters have become plenty warm after summer, and the cross-cutting winds that can stymie storms tend to relax.
paras.zh: 在可靠的记录中，没有任何其他飓风季节从 6 月 1 日飓风季节开始到 9 月底之间的某个时间段内至少没有发生过一场飓风。本季节到目前为止还没有发生任何飓风尤其令人不安，因为九月通常是大西洋热带气旋活动的高峰期：那时，海水在夏季之后已经变得非常温暖，可以阻止风暴的横风往往会减弱。

paras.en: Though ocean waters across the Atlantic are amply warm right now, those cross-cutting winds—known as wind shear—aren’t abating. That’s thanks to El Niño. This cyclical climate phenomenon happens because of an eastward shift in warm ocean waters in the Pacific, although it has worldwide effects on the weather. The movement of warm waters, in turn, changes where heat enters the atmosphere, which alters the motions of atmospheric currents. In the Atlantic, that means there is more wind shear and air that pushes downward, both of which stymie cyclone development.
paras.zh: 尽管大西洋彼岸的海水目前非常温暖，但那些横切的风（称为风切变）并没有减弱。这要归功于厄尔尼诺现象。这种周期性气候现象的发生是由于太平洋温暖海水向东移动，尽管它对全球天气产生影响。反过来，暖水的运动会改变热量进入大气的位置，从而改变大气流的运动。在大西洋，这意味着有更多的风切变和向下推动的空气，这两者都会阻碍气旋的发展。

paras.en: It’s possible the new record low for Atlantic hurricane activity could be overturned later. As Lowry wrote in his blog, Tropical Storm Fay, which began as a tropical depression far out in the Atlantic on September 19, came close to reaching the hurricane threshold of 74-mile-per-hour winds, and one satellite estimate measured winds of 84 mph on September 20. But that method of measuring winds tends to produce falsely high readings, Lowry notes. The National Hurricane Center will examine the data more closely after the season to see if it needs to revise Fay’s status to that of a hurricane.
paras.zh: 大西洋飓风活动的新纪录低点可能会在稍后被推翻。正如洛瑞在博客中所写，热带风暴费伊于 9 月 19 日在大西洋深处形成热带低气压，接近达到每小时 74 英里风速的飓风阈值，一颗卫星估计 9 月 20 日测量到的风速为 84 英里每小时。但洛瑞指出，这种测量风速的方法往往会产生错误的高读数。国家飓风中心将在季节结束后更仔细地检查数据，看看是否需要将费伊的状态修改为飓风。

paras.en: If Fay is designated as a hurricane, it would still set the mark for the latest hurricane formation ever in the Atlantic in reliable records. Either way, this has been a hurricane season unlike any Lowry can recall.
paras.zh: 如果费伊被指定为飓风，它仍将在可靠记录中为大西洋上最新的飓风形成奠定基础。不管怎样，这都是一个与洛瑞记忆中不同的飓风季节。

paras.en: “We expected a notably down year, activity-wise, across the Atlantic due primarily to the record-setting El Niño. But none of us in the hurricane space could’ve confidently predicted it’d be this dead through September,” Lowry says.
paras.zh: “我们预计今年大西洋彼岸的活动量将显着下降，这主要是由于创纪录的厄尔尼诺现象。但在飓风领域，我们没有人能够自信地预测到九月份飓风会如此严重，”洛瑞说。

paras.en: As we move away from the peak of the season, it becomes harder for hurricanes to spin up. So, assuming Fay doesn’t get the hurricane nod later, we could potentially go the rest of the season—until November 30—without a hurricane. That’s never happened before in modern history, but if it did, this would be one of the likeliest seasons for it to occur.
paras.zh: 当我们远离季节高峰时，飓风变得更难旋转。因此，假设费伊稍后没有获得飓风许可，我们可能会在本赛季余下的比赛中（直到 11 月 30 日）没有飓风。这在现代历史上从未发生过，但如果真的发生了，这将是最有可能发生的季节之一。

paras.en: As disorienting as the current weather is, it’s a relief to communities that have been hard-hit in recent years. “After a decade of active to hyperactive hurricane seasons with some of our costliest and deadliest U.S. hurricanes,” Lowry says, “this is one record I’m relieved to see!”
paras.zh: 尽管目前的天气令人迷惑，但这对近年来遭受重创的社区来说是一种解脱。洛瑞说：“在经历了十年活跃到过度活跃的飓风季节之后，美国经历了一些损失最惨重、死亡人数最多的飓风，看到这一记录我感到很欣慰！”

articles.title: NASA directive might increase the odds of contaminating Mars

paras.en: A new NASA directive seeks to loosen “planetary protection” rules meant to avoid the contamination other worlds with microbial life from Earth.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的一项新指令旨在放宽“行星保护”规则，旨在避免来自地球的微生物污染其他世界。

paras.en: The policy shift arrived via a message to NASA personnel that was obtained and shared yesterday by the independent watchdog sites NASA Watch and Astrobiology.com. In it, NASA administrator Jared Isaacman writes that procedures for avoiding contamination “must reflect our current scientific knowledge” and argues that this knowledge has shifted since the current rules were established decades ago.
paras.zh: 这一政策转变是通过独立监管网站 NASA Watch 和 Astrobiology.com 昨天获得并分享的一条发给 NASA 人员的消息实现的。美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼在其中写道，避免污染的程序“必须反映我们当前的科学知识”，并认为自几十年前制定现行规则以来，这种知识已经发生了变化。

paras.en: The directive “ensures we can use our incredible data to lower costs on our missions,” says Nicky Fox, associate administrator of NASA’s Science Mission Directorate. “This process will also help increase commercial capabilities — getting more missions into space by streamlining space exploration.”
paras.zh: NASA 科学任务理事会副局长尼基·福克斯 (Nicky Fox) 表示，该指令“确保我们能够利用令人难以置信的数据来降低任务成本”。 “这一过程还将有助于提高商业能力——通过简化太空探索来执行更多太空任务。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: In 1964 members of the International Council for Science’s Committee on Space Research (COSPAR), led by the United Nations–affiliated International Council of Scientific Unions (now the International Science Council), feared that the breakneck pace of the space race could lead to spacecraft accidentally contaminating alien worlds with microbial life from Earth. If those interplanetary hitchhikers were sufficiently resilient and numerous to form self-sustaining populations on Mars or other planets, they could forever alter those otherwise-pristine environments and sabotage all future efforts to discover true alien life there. So COSPAR issued a resolution that any mission to another potentially habitable or inhabited world must demonstrate a less than one-in-10,000 chance of exposing such places to terrestrial life capable of interplanetary colonization.
paras.zh: 1964 年，由联合国附属国际科学联盟理事会（现为国际科学理事会）领导的国际科学理事会空间研究委员会 (COSPAR) 的成员担心，太空竞赛的惊人速度可能会导致航天器意外地让来自地球的微生物污染外星世界。如果这些星际搭便车的人有足够的弹性和数量，能够在火星或其他行星上形成自给自足的种群，他们就可以永远改变那些原本原始的环境，并破坏未来所有在那里发现真正的外星生命的努力。因此，COSPAR 发布了一项决议，要求任何前往另一个可能适宜居住或有人居住的世界的任务都必须证明，将这些地方暴露于能够进行星际殖民的地球生命的可能性低于万分之一。

paras.en: The new directive notes that COSPAR subsequently tightened those rules to account for the flurry of Mars-bound missions, some carrying human crews, that were widely expected to launch in the intervening decades. Codified in 1969, those more stringent and costly restrictions have guided—and greatly limited, some critics say—Mars exploration ever since. But “human exploration did not progress as quickly as all believed,” Isaacman’s message reads, while technology for sterilizing spacecraft has improved markedly. “Our long-standing policies were designed in a different era,” he writes.
paras.zh: 新指令指出，空间研究委员会随后收紧了这些规则，以应对一系列前往火星的任务，其中一些载人航天器，人们普遍预计这些任务将在接下来的几十年内发射。这些更严格、成本更高的限制自 1969 年制定以来一直指导着火星探索，一些批评者称，这些限制也极大地限制了火星探索。但艾萨克曼的信息中写道，“人类探索的进展并不像所有人想象的那么快”，而航天器消毒技术却有了显着进步。 “我们的长期政策是在不同的时代制定的，”他写道。

paras.en: Now, the message states, NASA’s rules will immediately be restored to the looser 1964 restriction of less than a one-in-10,000 chance of biocontamination for each Mars-bound mission. And in the meantime, NASA officials will perform a rapid-fire “modernization assessment” of the current science and technology concerning contamination risk, with a December 2026 deadline for delivering recommendations to lower that threshold even further.
paras.zh: 现在，消息称，NASA 的规则将立即恢复到 1964 年较为宽松的限制，即每次火星任务发生生物污染的可能性低于万分之一。与此同时，NASA 官员将对当前有关污染风险的科学技术进行快速“现代化评估”，并在 2026 年 12 月的最后期限内提出进一步降低该阈值的建议。

paras.en: A statement from NASA clarified that the new directive isn’t “weakening” existing planetary protection protocols so much as updating them. “This directive moves NASA toward a quantitative, performance-based approach that measures actual contamination risk and applies protections accordingly,” the statement said. Additionally, missions looking for past or present life on Mars—such as NASA’s Perseverance rover—will “continue to carry requirements appropriate to protecting those investigations.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的一份声明澄清说，新指令并不是“削弱”现有的行星保护协议，而是对其进行更新。声明称：“这项指令促使美国宇航局采取一种定量的、基于绩效的方法，衡量实际的污染风险并采取相应的保护措施。”此外，寻找火星过去或现在生命的任务——例如美国宇航局的毅力号火星车——将“继续满足保护这些调查的适当要求。”

paras.en: Such cautions are crucial, experts say, especially since Perseverance has uncovered tantalizing hints of possible ancient biosignatures in some of the rocks it has studied; samples from those rocks are now in limbo, awaiting an as-yet-unclear ride back to Earth for further analysis.
paras.zh: 专家表示，这种谨慎至关重要，特别是因为毅力号在其研究的一些岩石中发现了可能存在古代生物特征的诱人线索。这些岩石的样本目前处于悬而未决的状态，等待着返回地球进行进一步分析，但目前情况尚不清楚。

paras.en: “We are actively seeking to learn if the organics we have found on Mars are biological in origin,” says Linday Hays, NASA’s senior scientist for Mars exploration. This policy change will not threaten that goal, she says, but “will allow us to bring decades of science from our Mars exploration to help make our processes more straightforward for robotic and, in the future, human exploration of the Red Planet.”
paras.zh: “我们正在积极寻求了解我们在火星上发现的有机物是否起源于生物，”美国宇航局火星探索高级科学家林迪·海斯说。她说，这一政策变化不会威胁到这一目标，但“将使我们能够利用数十年的火星探索科学成果，帮助我们的流程更加简单，适合机器人以及未来人类对这颗红色星球的探索。”

paras.en: Editor’s Note (9/30/26): This is a breaking news story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（9/30/26）：这是一个突发新闻报道，将会更新。

articles.title: Magnetism may have helped kick-start our solar system
articles.author: Katherine Kornei

paras.en: Before the sun fully formed, tiny bits of rock were already recording the magnetic forces present in the very early solar system. More than 4.5 billion years later, scientists have learned how to read that record.
paras.zh: 在太阳完全形成之前，微小的岩石碎片已经记录了早期太阳系中存在的磁力。 45 亿年后，科学家们已经学会了如何解读该记录。

paras.en: The ancient rocks suggest that the turbulent cloud of gas and dust that gave rise to our solar system was shot through a powerful magnetic field. That field may have helped feed the growing sun, researchers report August 24 in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. The findings suggest gravity may not have acted alone to build our solar system or the countless other planetary systems in the Milky Way and beyond.
paras.zh: 古老的岩石表明，形成太阳系的气体和尘埃湍流云是通过强大的磁场射出的。研究人员 8 月 24 日在《美国国家科学院院刊》上报道称，该磁场可能有助于滋养不断生长的太阳。研究结果表明，引力可能并不是单独作用来构建我们的太阳系或银河系及其他无数其他行星系统的。

paras.en: That ancient record is preserved in meteorites — time capsules of material that formed long ago. In particular, rocks that contain specific speckly mineral inclusions really turn back the clock. These inclusions solidified more than 4.5 billion years ago, before the sun and planets, says Cauê Borlina, a planetary scientist at Purdue University in West Lafayette, Ind. “They’re forming before everything else.”
paras.zh: 这一古老的记录保存在陨石中——很久以前形成的物质的时间胶囊。特别是含有特定斑点矿物内含物的岩石确实会让时光倒流。印第安纳州西拉斐特普渡大学的行星科学家 Cauê Borlina 表示，这些包裹体在 45 亿年前就已经凝固，比太阳和行星还早。“它们是在其他一切事物之前形成的。”

paras.en: Scientists have long debated whether the gas that makes up the sun was shepherded into place mainly by gravity or by a magnetic field. Previous studies suggest the presence of a solar system –wide magnetic field after the sun formed. What’s been much harder to determine is whether that field was already present during the sun’s earliest stages of formation, Borlina says.
paras.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直在争论构成太阳的气体主要是通过重力还是磁场引导到位。先前的研究表明，太阳形成后存在太阳系范围内的磁场。博利纳说，更难确定的是，在太阳形成的最早阶段，这个场是否已经存在。

paras.en: He and his colleagues analyzed a meteorite that fell to Earth in 2008. The team focused on five inclusions containing iron, an element whose electrons readily rearrange to record magnetic fields. Using sensitive magnetometers, the researchers measured magnetic fields of a few gauss, a common unit of magnetism. That’s several times stronger than Earth’s current magnetic field.
paras.zh: 他和同事分析了 2008 年坠落地球的陨石。研究小组重点研究了五种含有铁的内含物，铁是一种电子很容易重新排列以记录磁场的元素。研究人员使用灵敏的磁力计测量了几个高斯（磁性的常见单位）的磁场。这比地球当前的磁场强几倍。

paras.en: Simulations of planetary system formation predict that stronger magnetic fields will transport more gas toward the nascent star, Borlina says. During the sun’s earliest, or Class 0, phase some models suggest it could have gobbled up more than 300 Earth masses of gas each year. The newly measured field is strong enough that magnetism could have contributed substantially to that feeding frenzy. “You can’t ignore the contribution of magnetism,” Borlina says.
paras.zh: 博利纳说，对行星系统形成的模拟预测，更强的磁场将向新生恒星输送更多的气体。一些模型表明，在太阳最早的阶段（即 0 级阶段），它每年可能会吞噬超过 300 个地球质量的气体。新测量的磁场足够强，磁力可能对这种进食狂潮产生了重大影响。 “你不能忽视磁性的贡献，”博利纳说。

paras.en: These results provide an important look at the solar system’s very beginnings, says Indrani Das, a theoretical astrophysicist at the Academia Sinica Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics in Taipei, Taiwan. “This is one of the first measurements that has been done of the Class 0 phase.”
paras.zh: 台湾台北中央研究院天文与天体物理研究所的理论天体物理学家英德拉尼·达斯 (Indrani Das) 表示，这些结果为我们了解太阳系的起源提供了重要的视角。 “这是对 0 级阶段进行的首批测量之一。”

paras.en: Still, these findings need to be bolstered with measurements from other meteorites, Das says. “We need a bigger sample size.”
paras.zh: 达斯说，尽管如此，这些发现还需要其他陨石的测量结果来支持。 “我们需要更大的样本量。”

articles.title: ‘The Deep End’ podcast is back to explore what makes your voice yours
articles.author: Laura Sanders

paras.en: What if you lost your voice? Today, AI can recreate it, and brain implants can turn thoughts into speech. This season of The Deep End follows people living through these vocal transformations — and asks what these remarkable technologies can teach us about why our voices matter in the first place. Episodes will drop Tuesdays, starting Oct. 6.
paras.zh: 如果你失声了怎么办？如今，人工智能可以重新创造它，大脑植入物可以将思想转化为语音。这一季的《The Deep End》讲述了人们经历这些声音转变的过程，并询问这些非凡的技术可以教会我们什么，让我们了解为什么我们的声音首先如此重要。从 10 月 6 日开始，剧集将于每周二播出。

paras.en: Laura Sanders: One of today’s most powerful pieces of technology is something we’ve had all along…
paras.zh: 劳拉·桑德斯：当今最强大的技术之一是我们一直拥有的……

paras.en: Laura: The human voice. If you’ve ever saved and replayed a voicemail, or called someone just to hear their voice…
paras.zh: 劳拉：人类的声音。如果您曾经保存并重播过语音邮件，或者致电某人只是为了听听他们的声音......

paras.en: Female voice: Hey dude, I’m just calling to say hi and chitchat.
paras.zh: 女声：嘿伙计，我打电话只是想打个招呼，聊聊。

paras.en: Laura: Then you know that voices can connect, soothe, inspire, scare, seduce and make us laugh until we cry.
paras.zh: 劳拉：那你就知道声音可以联系、抚慰、激励、恐吓、引诱，让我们笑到哭。

paras.en: Laura: Our voices make us who we are, but what happens when they are lost?
paras.zh: 劳拉：我们的声音造就了我们，但是当它们消失时会发生什么呢？

paras.en: MA Fernandez: I still remember the first time that I heard the first little crack in his voice that let me know something’s changing.
paras.zh: MA Fernandez：我仍然记得第一次听到他声音中的第一个小裂痕，让我知道事情正在发生变化。

paras.en: Laura: Welcome to The Deep End, a podcast about our brains and ourselves. I’m Laura Sanders, a reporter with Science News. And on this season, called Talk to Me, we dive into the latest scientific research to answer the question, “What happens when a voice is lost? And can it be found again?”
paras.zh: 劳拉：欢迎来到《The Deep End》，这是一个关于我们的大脑和我们自己的播客。我是劳拉·桑德斯，《科学新闻》记者。在这一季《跟我说话》中，我们深入研究最新的科学研究来回答这个问题：“当声音消失时会发生什么？并且可以再次找到它吗？”

paras.en: Jules Rodriguez: When I first heard my cloned voice, it felt like I reappeared.
paras.zh: 朱尔斯·罗德里格斯：当我第一次听到我的克隆声音时，感觉就像我重新出现了一样。

paras.en: Laura: Across six episodes, you’ll hear a chorus of voices like Casey, who has a brain implant that can pull words from his thoughts.
paras.zh: 劳拉：在六集里，你会听到像凯西这样的合唱声，他有一个大脑植入物，可以从他的思想中提取单词。

paras.en: Casey Harrell: The ability to scream when you are running and want to get out some stress. The ability to say sweet nothings into your partner’s ear. These are the things that life is all about. And when you are robbed of those times, you want them back at all costs.
paras.zh: Casey Harrell：当你跑步并想要释放一些压力时能够尖叫。在伴侣耳边说甜言蜜语的能力。这些就是生活的全部内容。当你的那些时光被剥夺时，你会不惜一切代价想要把它们夺回来。

paras.en: Laura: You’ll hear from Jules, who performs live comedy sets with a voice cloned through artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 劳拉：你会听到朱尔斯的声音，他用人工智能克隆的声音表演现场喜剧。

paras.en: Jules: Do I want to be right, or do I want to eat tonight. [laughter]
paras.zh: 朱尔斯：我想是对的，还是我今晚想吃东西？ [笑声]

paras.en: Laura: And you’ll hear from Patrick, a musician who sings with a synthetic voice.
paras.zh: 劳拉：你会听到帕特里克的声音，他是一位用合成声音唱歌的音乐家。

paras.en: Patrick: (Singing) Then played the rocky road, with a fire and a glow.
paras.zh: 帕特里克：（唱歌）然后演奏了岩石路，伴随着火焰和光芒。

paras.en: Laura: Synthetic voice clones, brain implants and even AI voices that can speak at their own funerals, like it or not, the story of the human voice is changing. Let’s talk about it. Listen to The Deep End: Talk to Me wherever you get your podcasts.
paras.zh: 劳拉：合成声音克隆、大脑植入，甚至可以在自己的葬礼上说话的人工智能声音，无论你喜欢与否，人类声音的故事正在改变。我们来谈谈吧。收听《The Deep End：无论您在何处观看播客，都可以与我交谈》。

paras.en: This podcast was produced with support from the Burroughs Wellcome Fund and in partnership with PRX. The podcast logo was created by Neil Webb.
paras.zh: 该播客是在 Burroughs Wellcome 基金的支持下并与 PRX 合作制作的。播客徽标由尼尔·韦伯创建。

articles.title: A new map points out U.S. rivers most worth protecting
articles.author: Stefan Lovgren

paras.en: First, the bad news: Of all the rivers in the contiguous United States, only 6 percent are both in healthy condition and meaningfully safeguarded. The good news is that many more may be just one repair away from thriving.
paras.zh: 首先是坏消息：在美国本土的所有河流中，只有 6% 的河流状况良好且得到有效保护。好消息是，更多的可能只需要一次修复就能实现繁荣。

paras.en: A new map highlights where conservation money and attention would do the most good as the climate warms, researchers report September 16 in PLOS One. The effort is the most comprehensive to date, assessing the health of the lower 48 states’ rivers and streams.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 16 日在 PLOS One 上发表报告称，一张新地图强调了随着气候变暖，保护资金和关注在哪些地方可以发挥最大作用。这项工作是迄今为止最全面的，评估了下游 48 个州河流和溪流的健康状况。

paras.en: “We can now point at a map for the first time and say, these are the rivers most capable of sustaining diversity of aquatic life, and this is what each one needs,” says Mary Khoury, a freshwater ecologist at The Nature Conservancy who is based in Chicago.
paras.zh: “我们现在第一次可以指着地图说，这些是最有能力维持水生生物多样性的河流，这就是每个人所需要的，”位于芝加哥的大自然保护协会淡水生态学家玛丽·库里说。

paras.en: For decades, conservation in the United States has been organized primarily around land. Scientists know for the most part which forests are intact and who owns what. Rivers have never gotten that treatment, even as more than 150,000 dams have fragmented the country’s waterways — cutting fish off from spawning grounds and cold-water refuges — and climate change has altered the temperatures and flows these animals depend on.
paras.zh: 几十年来，美国的保护工作主要围绕土地进行。科学家们基本上知道哪些森林是完好无损的以及谁拥有哪些森林。尽管超过 15 万座水坝使该国的水道支离破碎——切断了鱼类的产卵场和冷水避难所——而且气候变化改变了这些动物赖以生存的温度和流量，但河流从未得到过这样的待遇。

paras.en: The new assessment, which took four years, maps one-third of the nation’s stream distances. Each small watershed was rated on four measures: how connected its river network is, meaning whether animals including fish and mussels can freely travel along it; the condition of its floodplain and water quality; how much water it has; and how much its flows have been altered. Those ratings were laid over 91 existing assessments of where freshwater life is concentrated. Dozens of scientists and partners from 44 states adjusted the measures for river systems in regions as different as the humid East, the arid Great Plains and the deserts of the Southwest.
paras.zh: 新的评估历时四年，绘制了全国三分之一的河流距离。每个小流域都根据四个指标进行评级：其河网的连接程度，这意味着包括鱼类和贻贝在内的动物是否可以在其上自由活动；洪泛区的状况和水质；它有多少水；以及其流量发生了多少变化。这些评级基于对淡水生物集中地区的 91 项现有评估。来自 44 个州的数十名科学家和合作伙伴调整了湿润东部、干旱大平原和西南部沙漠等不同地区河流系统的措施。

paras.en: A four-year assessment graded every river and stream in the lower 48 for its ability to sustain aquatic life in a warming climate. The healthiest ones cluster along the Pacific Coast, in the northern Rockies and across the Southeast. The most vulnerable sit in the Southwest deserts, the Great Plains and southern New England.
paras.zh: 一项为期四年的评估对下游 48 条河流和溪流在变暖气候下维持水生生物的能力进行了评级。最健康的地区集中在太平洋沿岸、落基山脉北部和整个东南部。最脆弱的地区位于西南部沙漠、大平原和新英格兰南部。

paras.en: Rivers doing well on all four criteria — more than half of the mapped stream distances — came out as resilient. The rest score near average, and were classed as restorable, still functional but held back by a problem, such as runoff from a farm or an obstructing dam, that one intervention could solve.
paras.zh: 在所有四个标准上都表现良好的河流（超过一半的地图河流距离）显示出具有弹性。其余的得分接近平均水平，被归类为可恢复、仍能发挥作用，但受到问题阻碍，例如农场径流或阻塞水坝，只需一次干预即可解决。

paras.en: Together the two categories form what the authors call a freshwater resilient and connected network, a shopping list of what the country would need to look after to keep its freshwater life going. “A resilient system is one that gives species options and environments in which to adapt,” Khoury says.
paras.zh: 这两个类别共同构成了作者所说的淡水弹性和互联网络，这是该国需要照顾以保持淡水生命延续的购物清单。 “一个有弹性的系统能够为物种提供适应的选择和环境，”库里说。

paras.en: Dams leave the clearest mark on the country’s rivers, carving them into more than 9,000 separate pieces. The study maps where reconnecting rivers would pay off most. Among the long unbroken stretches within the resilient system are Oregon and California’s Klamath River, whose lower dams came out in the largest removal project in U.S. history, and the Delaware River, which runs free of barriers along its main stem from New York’s Catskill Mountains to the sea.
paras.zh: 水坝在该国的河流上留下了最清晰的印记，将河流切割成 9,000 多块独立的碎片。该研究绘制了重新连接河流最能带来回报的地区。弹性系统内长长的、不间断的河段包括俄勒冈州和加利福尼亚州的克拉马斯河（其下游水坝是在美国历史上最大的拆除项目中建成的）和特拉华河（其从纽约卡茨基尔山脉到大海的主干流没有任何障碍）。

paras.en: “I can see this being overlaid in the future, for example, with where dam licenses will expire, in order to find the most effective restoration opportunities,” says Rafael Schmitt, a hydrologist at the University of California, Santa Barbara who was not involved in the work.
paras.zh: 未参与这项工作的加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校水文学家拉斐尔·施密特 (Rafael Schmitt) 表示：“我可以看到，未来这些信息会与大坝许可证到期的地点重叠，以便找到最有效的恢复机会。”

paras.en: Unlike on land, the study found, a river’s health says almost nothing about whether anyone is looking after it. On land, the healthiest places tend to be the protected ones. In water, however, 13 percent of the country’s stream distances are in good shape with no real safeguards, roughly twice the 6 percent that is both healthy and protected.
paras.zh: 研究发现，与陆地不同，河流的健康状况几乎不能说明是否有人在照顾它。在陆地上，最健康的地方往往是受保护的地方。然而，在水域方面，该国 13% 的河流状况良好，没有真正的保障措施，大约是健康且受保护的 6% 的两倍。

paras.en: The unprotected healthy rivers are the ones most at risk of slipping, because nothing keeps them in that condition. Locking in protection is harder for a river than for a forest. A designated preserve can hold a kilometer of stream while the water arriving in it may drain 100 kilometers of farm fields, dams and subdivisions. “It matters what’s going on upstream of that protected area,” Khoury says.
paras.zh: 未受保护的健康河流是最有可能发生滑坡的河流，因为没有任何东西可以使它们保持这种状态。河流的锁定保护比森林更难。一个指定的保护区可以容纳一公里长的溪流，而流入其中的水可能会排干 100 公里长的农田、水坝和小区。 “保护区上游发生的事情很重要，”库里说。

articles.title: Ozempic-Like Drugs Could Have a Surprising Effect on Alcohol Cravings
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Imagine ordering a drink you would normally enjoy, then finding you barely want to touch it.
paras.zh: 想象一下，点了一杯您通常喜欢的饮料，然后发现您几乎不想碰它。

paras.en: Some people taking Ozempic-like medications have described just such a change.
paras.zh: 一些服用 Ozempic 类药物的人描述了这样的变化。

paras.en: Could these drugs help people with alcohol use disorder? A review published in Biological Psychiatry brings together the evidence.
paras.zh: 这些药物可以帮助患有酒精使用障碍的人吗？ 《生物精神病学》上发表的一篇评论汇集了证据。

paras.en: It suggests a promising possibility, but also an important distinction: drinking less does not necessarily mean craving alcohol less.
paras.zh: 它提出了一种有希望的可能性，但也提出了一个重要的区别：少喝酒并不一定意味着减少对酒精的渴望。

paras.en: Ozempic's active ingredient, semaglutide, belongs to a class of drugs that mimic GLP-1, a hormone involved in regulating appetite and blood sugar.
paras.zh: Ozempic 的活性成分索马鲁肽属于一类模仿 GLP-1 的药物，GLP-1 是一种参与调节食欲和血糖的激素。

paras.en: Researchers are now testing whether the drugs also change people's relationship with alcohol.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在正在测试这些药物是否也会改变人们与酒精的关系。

paras.en: Mette Kruse Klausen and Anders Fink-Jensen, researchers in Denmark, examined randomized trials, health record studies and reports from people taking the medications.
paras.zh: 丹麦的研究人员梅特·克鲁斯·克劳森 (Mette Kruse Klausen) 和安德斯·芬克·詹森 (Anders Fink-Jensen) 检查了随机试验、健康记录研究和服用药物的人的报告。

paras.en: In one, 127 people seeking help for alcohol use disorder received psychotherapy alongside either weekly injections of the GLP-1 drug exenatide or a placebo. Across the entire group, exenatide did not significantly reduce heavy drinking days compared with placebo.
paras.zh: 在一项研究中，127 名因酒精使用障碍寻求帮助的人接受了心理治疗，同时每周注射 GLP-1 药物艾塞那肽或安慰剂。在整个组中，与安慰剂相比，艾塞那肽并未显着减少酗酒天数。

paras.en: An exploratory analysis suggested that participants with obesity might have benefited.
paras.zh: 一项探索性分析表明，肥胖的参与者可能会受益。

paras.en: Brain scans from a subset of participants also showed a weaker response to alcohol-related images in regions involved in reward. But these findings cannot establish that the drug works only for people with obesity, or explain precisely why drinking might change.
paras.zh: 对一部分参与者的脑部扫描也显示，与奖励有关的区域对与酒精相关的图像的反应较弱。但这些发现并不能证明这种药物只对肥胖者有效，也不能准确解释为什么饮酒可能会改变。

paras.en: A different research team tested semaglutide in 48 people with alcohol use disorder who were not seeking treatment. Those assigned the drug drank less during a laboratory test than those given placebo. They also reported fewer drinks on days when they drank and less weekly alcohol craving.
paras.zh: 另一个研究小组对 48 名未寻求治疗的酒精使用障碍患者进行了索马鲁肽测试。在实验室测试中，接受药物治疗的人比服用安慰剂的人饮酒量要少。他们还报告说，喝酒的日子里喝酒的次数较少，每周对酒精的渴望也较少。

paras.en: The drug did not, however, significantly change the number of days they drank or their average drinks per calendar day.
paras.zh: 然而，该药物并没有显着改变他们饮酒的天数或每个日历日的平均饮酒量。

paras.en: Craving, the amount consumed on a drinking day and the frequency of drinking are distinct outcomes.
paras.zh: 渴望、饮酒日的饮酒量和饮酒频率是不同的结果。

paras.en: The strongest published evidence comes from a 26-week trial in The Lancet, one of two trials in this review that Klausen and Fink-Jensen also co-authored. It enrolled 108 people with obesity who were seeking treatment for moderate-to-severe alcohol use disorder.
paras.zh: 已发表的最强有力的证据来自《柳叶刀》上一项为期 26 周的试验，这是克劳森和芬克-詹森共同撰写的这篇综述中的两项试验之一。它招募了 108 名正在寻求中度至重度酒精使用障碍治疗的肥胖症患者。

paras.en: All received cognitive behavioral therapy and were assigned either weekly semaglutide injections or placebo.
paras.zh: 所有人都接受了认知行为治疗，并被分配每周注射索马鲁肽或安慰剂。

paras.en: "Semaglutide produced a significantly greater reduction in heavy drinking days: a 41.1-percentage-point reduction from baseline compared with 26.4 points with placebo, corresponding to a treatment difference of 13.7 percentage points," Fink-Jensen told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: Fink-Jensen 告诉 ScienceAlert：“索马鲁肽显着减少了酗酒天数：与基线相比减少了 41.1 个百分点，而安慰剂则减少了 26.4 个百分点，相当于 13.7 个百分点的治疗差异。”

paras.en: The 13.7-point figure is the trial's estimated treatment difference, not the result of simply subtracting the two rounded reductions. Participants receiving semaglutide also reduced their overall alcohol intake more than those receiving placebo.
paras.zh: 13.7分的数字是试验估计的治疗差异，而不是简单减去两次四舍五入的减少的结果。与接受安慰剂的参与者相比，接受索马鲁肽的参与者总体酒精摄入量也减少了更多。

paras.en: "So the evidence is increasingly consistent that semaglutide can reduce heavy drinking and the amount consumed when people drink," Fink-Jensen said. "Evidence for an effect on craving is promising but less consistent."
paras.zh: “因此，越来越多的证据表明索马鲁肽可以减少酗酒和人们饮酒时的饮酒量，”芬克-詹森说。 “关于对渴望的影响的证据是有希望的，但不太一致。”

paras.en: A newer randomized trial of oral semaglutide adds to that distinction. It found fewer heavy drinking days, but its primary laboratory measure of craving triggered by alcohol-related cues did not differ significantly from placebo. A separate measure of cravings reported during daily life did improve. The study was published online on July 29, after the review had been accepted.
paras.zh: 一项新的口服索马鲁肽随机试验增加了这一区别。它发现酗酒的天数减少了，但其对酒精相关线索引发的渴望的主要实验室测量与安慰剂没有显着差异。日常生活中对食欲的单独测量确实有所改善。该研究在审查被接受后于 7 月 29 日在线发表。

paras.en: Health record studies have also linked GLP-1 prescriptions to fewer alcohol-related events. They can follow large groups of people, but cannot establish on their own that the medications caused them to drink less.
paras.zh: 健康记录研究还将 GLP-1 处方与较少的酒精相关事件联系起来。他们可以跟踪一大群人，但无法自行确定药物导致他们饮酒量减少。

paras.en: How could a diabetes medication change alcohol consumption? The brain's response to reward may be part of the answer. Appetite, signals related to calories and slower stomach emptying could also contribute. The researchers cannot yet say which mechanisms matter most.
paras.zh: 糖尿病药物如何改变饮酒量？大脑对奖励的反应可能是答案的一部分。食欲、与卡路里相关的信号和胃排空速度减慢也可能有所贡献。研究人员还不能确定哪种机制最重要。

paras.en: Nor is it clear who would benefit. The largest published semaglutide trial included only people with obesity, while the smaller trial found no clear evidence that the effect on drinking depended on body mass index. Researchers also cannot yet say whether any reduction in drinking is independent of weight loss.
paras.zh: 也不清楚谁会受益。已发表的最大的索马鲁肽试验仅包括肥胖人群，而较小的试验没有发现明确的证据表明对饮酒的影响取决于体重指数。研究人员还不能确定饮酒的减少是否与体重减轻无关。

paras.en: "Obesity may influence the response to GLP-1 receptor agonists, but we do not yet know whether BMI is an important treatment modifier," Fink-Jensen said.
paras.zh: “肥胖可能会影响对 GLP-1 受体激动剂的反应，但我们还不知道 BMI 是否是一个重要的治疗调节剂，”Fink-Jensen 说。

paras.en: The drugs can cause nausea and other digestive problems. Larger, longer trials must establish who benefits, what happens after treatment stops and how GLP-1 drugs compare directly with existing medications for alcohol use disorder, including naltrexone and acamprosate.
paras.zh: 这些药物会引起恶心和其他消化问题。更大规模、更长时间的试验必须确定谁受益、治疗停止后会发生什么，以及 GLP-1 药物如何与现有的酒精使用障碍药物（包括纳曲酮和阿坎酸）进行直接比较。

paras.en: Fink-Jensen disclosed a previous unrestricted grant from Novo Nordisk for research on metabolic problems in people with schizophrenia, and an unpaid role on a company trial advisory panel. The Lancet alcohol trial lists the Novo Nordisk Foundation among its five funding sources.
paras.zh: Fink-Jensen 披露了诺和诺德之前为精神分裂症患者代谢问题研究提供的无限制资助，以及公司试验顾问小组的无薪职位。 《柳叶刀》酒精试验将诺和诺德基金会列为其五个资金来源之一。

paras.en: "I would characterize GLP-1 receptor agonists as a promising emerging treatment strategy rather than an established treatment for AUD," Fink-Jensen said.
paras.zh: Fink-Jensen 说：“我将 GLP-1 受体激动剂描述为一种有前途的新兴治疗策略，而不是 AUD 的既定治疗方法。”

paras.en: For now, the clearest signal is that semaglutide may help some people drink less heavily. Whether it reliably quiets the urge to drink, and for whom, remains a question worth pursuing.
paras.zh: 目前最明确的信号是索马鲁肽可以帮助一些人减少饮酒量。它是否能可靠地平息饮酒的冲动，以及为谁服务，仍然是一个值得探讨的问题。

paras.en: The research has been published in Biological Psychiatry.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《生物精神病学》上。

articles.title: Science Says Who You Eat Dinner With Matters as Much as What's on Your Plate
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Dinner by yourself can be a lonely affair. The lack of social connection could change the way that your body processes your meal.
A new study published in Science Advances has now found evidence that eating with others could help your body balance your blood sugar levels.
In experiments, 108 participants consumed just over 100 grams of white-wheat bread. For the following two hours, researchers tracked their glycemic response.
In one scenario, participants ate the bread on their own. In another scenario, they were accompanied by a close companion.
In the social scenario, blood sugar levels spiked less and returned to baseline faster than in the alone scenario.
The authors argue that this aligns with a "robust phenomenon" in humans.
"Blood sugar regulation is not just about what we eat, but who we eat with," explains Shir Atzil from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem in Israel.
"Our relationships have an active biological role in our physical well-being."
Atzil and colleagues argue that their findings provide a proof of concept for the principle of 'social physiology'.
This is a biological framework for understanding how links between our inward and outward lives have evolved over time.
Social physiology could at least partly explain why we, as a species, are incentivized to cooperate: we are interdependent organisms who rely on each other for greater survival.
You can see that in our very blood, even when we aren't physically touching.
"We used to think of the body as an isolated system that regulates itself," explains Atzil.

"Our findings show that human physiology is inherently social. Being close to someone you love lowers the physical energy your body spends on regulating itself. This gives us a direct metabolic benefit to being together and reveals a core evolutionary reason why humans form bonds in the first place: our bodies run better together."
In other social animals, like fruit flies, rodents, pigs, and monkeys, studies suggest that isolation can shorten lifespans, suppress immune systems, or amplify stress reactions.
But for ethical reasons, these sorts of experiments are not conducted among humans.
paras.zh: 但出于伦理原因，此类实验并未在人类中进行。

paras.en: Instead, researchers use small changes in how the body functions alone versus in social settings to better understand how we change in the presence of others.
Glucose responses are a clever way to do this.
When mice are kept in social isolation, studies have found it alters their insulin signaling and impairs their metabolic function, raising the risk of obesity.
In humans, by comparison, loneliness is associated with dysregulated glycemic control and predicts type 2 diabetes.
"While prior work has focused on the outcomes of social isolation, the present study identifies a direct, quantifiable benefit of social proximity in glucose metabolism," the authors explain.
The team's experiments compared how human bodies respond to the same carbohydrate meal when alone versus in company.
They also ran parallel experiments among 116 participants, testing how the body copes with cold exposure.
paras.zh: 他们还在 116 名参与者中进行了平行实验，测试身体如何应对寒冷暴露。

paras.en: When a partner was present, the body's temperature regulation was more efficient, especially when the two people were touching.
But even when no one was touching, there were benefits.
In another set of experiments among 115 adults and 56 mother-infant pairs, participants underwent a stress challenge.
It produced a smaller arousal response, such as increased sweating, when another person was present, even if they weren't physically skin-to-skin.
paras.zh: 当另一个人在场时，即使他们没有皮肤接触，它也会产生较小的唤醒反应，例如出汗增加。

paras.en: This arousal response was also ameliorated faster when in company.
paras.zh: 当有人陪伴时，这种兴奋反应也会得到更快的改善。

paras.en: The findings suggest that having somebody close by, even if you aren't touching, could help your body run more efficiently.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，有人在身边，即使你们没有接触，也可以帮助您的身体更有效地运转。

paras.en: What those effects are in the long run is an open question, but population studies generally suggest that loneliness is not good for our overall health.
paras.zh: 从长远来看，这些影响是什么是一个悬而未决的问题，但人口研究普遍表明孤独不利于我们的整体健康。

paras.en: Evidence suggests that individuals with stronger social ties tend to be healthier, happier, and live longer.
paras.zh: 有证据表明，社会关系较强的人往往更健康、更快乐、寿命更长。

paras.en: Conversely, social isolation is associated with increased metabolic disorders, cardiovascular disease, cancer, slower wound healing, reduced sleep efficiency, and mortality.
paras.zh: 相反，社会孤立与代谢紊乱、心血管疾病、癌症、伤口愈合缓慢、睡眠效率降低和死亡率增加有关。

paras.en: The world's largest study on happiness has been running for 88 years and counting.
paras.zh: 世界上最大的幸福研究已经运行了 88 年，而且还在继续。

paras.en: After analyzing hundreds of peer-reviewed papers and countless questionnaires, medical check-ups, and in-person interviews with participants, researchers found that close relationships were one of the best predictors of a happy and meaningful life.
paras.zh: 在分析了数百篇同行评审论文和无数问卷、体检以及对参与者的面对面访谈后，研究人员发现，亲密关系是幸福而有意义的生活的最佳预测因素之一。

paras.en: Surrounding ourselves with loved ones seems to be inherently good for us.
paras.zh: 让亲人围绕在我们身边似乎本质上对我们有好处。

paras.en: It could change how our bodies cope on a miniscule level, but with big repercussions.
paras.zh: 它可以在很小的程度上改变我们身体的应对方式，但会产生巨大的影响。

paras.en: The research has been published in Science Advances.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学进展》上。

articles.title: Watch Plasma Erupt in Full Color Inside a Fusion Reactor at 16,000 FPS
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: When the tokamak powers on, something magical happens in the confines of its reinforced belly.
Plasma born of heavy hydrogen blooms into brilliant pink, roiling and writhing around the doughnut-shaped chamber.
Then, tiny grains of lithium tumble into the maelstrom, sparkling like scarlet fairy dust before bursting into streaks of vivid green-yellow light.

Thanks to a high-speed color camera, we can watch this process in action as the plasma heats up inside Tokamak Energy's ST40 machine, creating some of the conditions future tokamaks will use to smash atomic nuclei together to generate the fusion energy that could one day power the world.
But it's not just the splendor of the sight that's a marvel.

Plasma fusion has a long way to go before it's close to ready for practical application – and watching the path of blazing lithium could help physicists overcome one of the major hurdles the technology faces: how to safely vent the tremendous heat escaping from a fusion plasma.
A tokamak needs to confine plasma at temperatures of millions of degrees to force atomic nuclei together.
But that confinement is not easy – and some of the tremendous energy swirling around inevitably escapes the confined plasma.
It has to go somewhere, so tokamaks are designed to channel as much of that escaping heat as possible toward components called divertors.

Currently, tokamak experiments are relatively brief. In a future fusion power plant, however, those components will have to withstand punishing heat loads for long periods without rapidly disintegrating.

Divertor heat load is such an important problem that it is one of the key factors shaping the design of future spherical tokamak power plants. In experiments on ST40, researchers have measured heat fluxes as high as 150 megawatts per square meter.
Heat exhaust is therefore one of the problems researchers are using ST40 to investigate – including whether the plasma itself can be coaxed into helping.
Tokamaks have, of course, been equipped with high-speed, high-resolution cameras for almost as long as there have been tokamaks.
High-speed color imaging isn't entirely new, either: A color camera was deployed on Russia's T-11M tokamak in 2014, as described in a 2016 paper.

However, that paper noted a significant wrinkle. Although it was also tracking lithium at the plasma boundary, the camera was operating at 1,000 fps – not fast enough, the researchers noted, to follow the evolution of lithium filaments over time. For that, they said, speeds of more than 10,000 fps would be needed.
The camera trained on the interior of ST40 records at 16,000 fps.

Normally, impurities in the plasma racing around inside a fusion reactor can create significant problems, causing heat to radiate away more quickly, which cools the plasma and can interfere with the conditions needed for fusion.

But if that cooling happens in the right place at the plasma's edge, it could actually be an advantage – it could reduce the heat blasting the divertors, while the interior of the plasma torus remains hot enough to sustain fusion conditions.
This is the idea behind an experimental operating regime called the X-point radiator, or XPR.
The plasma is confined by a powerful magnetic field. The X-point is a region in that magnetic field near the divertor, where the magnetic field forms a distinctive X-shaped structure.

By encouraging impurities to radiate energy away around this region, physicists hope to cool the plasma before it reaches the divertor, reducing the punishment those components have to endure without cooling the fusion-producing core.
Lithium is one of the materials physicists have been experimenting with to see how that cooling can be controlled.
And that's what those spectacular colors are doing.

Counterintuitively, the colorful plasma captured by the camera isn't the hottest part of ST40. The fusion-hot core is too hot to produce the visible light we're seeing; instead, the camera reveals what's happening in the comparatively cooler plasma around its edge.
The pink glow comes from the deuterium gas fed into the tokamak, which emits a combination of red and blue wavelengths.
When the tiny, sand-sized grains of lithium first enter those cooler outer regions, neutral lithium atoms become excited and glow a brilliant crimson red.

As the lithium penetrates deeper into the hotter, denser plasma, however, its atoms lose an electron and become positively charged lithium ions. These Li⁺ ions emit a distinctive greenish-yellow light.

And because they're now electrically charged, the lithium ions follow the magnetic field – turning those vivid green-yellow streaks into a glowing tracer of the otherwise invisible field lines confining the plasma.

A temperature map of the tokamak would be relatively easy to obtain even in black and white. What the color camera gives physicists is a way to trace different atoms and ions under different plasma conditions, revealing where the lithium travels and how deeply it penetrates.

Combined with spectroscopy, which precisely identifies the wavelengths of light being emitted, the high-speed footage gives physicists another way to see whether impurities are radiating energy where they want them to.

If they're not, physicists can change the conditions and try again, learning how to keep the cooling where they want it – knowledge that could eventually shape how future fusion reactors dispose of their tremendous heat.
And there are early signs that the XPR approach could work.

In preliminary results from experiments in ST40, researchers report that they have been able to produce a radiating region that moves across the X-point and significantly cools the plasma edge. When this happens, measurements show that the heat reaching the divertor falls.

The researchers think much of the radiation in those experiments came from carbon knocked off the tokamak walls, rather than the deliberately introduced lithium. But experiments using lithium and neon to further reduce the heat load are now underway.

Computer modeling suggests lithium could be particularly useful because it may be possible to concentrate it around the divertor, where its cooling effect is wanted, without allowing enough of it upstream to degrade the performance of the plasma core.
And Tokamak Energy plans to push the idea even further.

ST40 is currently undergoing a major upgrade to replace its carbon armor with molybdenum, introduce systems for coating its plasma-facing components with lithium, and add new diagnostics to scrutinize what happens at the plasma edge.
After that, perhaps we'll get to see even more spectacular colors shimmering out of space – carrying with them information that could help bring us closer to the fusion future.

articles.title: Ocean heatwaves are hiding months of extra warming

paras.en: Ocean heatwaves are hiding months of extra warming
Marine heatwaves may be hiding months of extra warming, causing scientists to dramatically underestimate the heat stress experienced by ocean ecosystems.

- Marine heatwaves may be only the most intense part of much longer warming events, with elevated temperatures sometimes lingering for months. Researchers found that conventional measurements underestimate total heat exposure by more than 150% on average, potentially overlooking a major source of stress on marine ecosystems.

Anyone who has ever heated a pot of water knows that temperature depends on more than how hot something gets. Time matters too. Yet marine heatwaves (MHWs) have traditionally been studied as distinct events with clearly defined beginnings and endings.

New research led by William & Mary's VIMS & Batten School suggests that approach may overlook a major part of the heat marine ecosystems actually experience. The researchers developed a framework for measuring cumulative exposure not only during MHWs, but also during the extended periods of unusually warm water that can occur before and after them.
Marine heatwaves are part of longer warming periods

The study, published in Nature's Communications Earth & Environment, categorizes warming periods that occur ahead of and following MHWs. Using long term observations from 20 U.S. estuaries, the researchers developed a way to measure total heat exposure by viewing marine heatwaves as part of broader warming episodes rather than as isolated events.

"We started to notice these warm-water anomalies on either side of marine heatwaves and realized that they're actually embedded within larger periods of warm water," explained lead author Ricardo Utzig Nardi M.S. '25, a research specialist working with coauthor Piero Mazzini, assistant professor at VIMS & the Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences. "It sounds obvious, but studies usually focus only on the marine heatwave window and that's not an accurate representation of real-world conditions."
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Nardi found that these broader stretches of unusually warm water can continue for weeks or even months, with the marine heatwave occurring somewhere within that longer period. In many cases, the warming before and after the MHW contributed as much or even more cumulative heat exposure than the heatwave itself.

"We can no longer look at marine heatwaves in isolation when assessing the impact of warming events on coastal and oceanic ecosystems," said Mazzini. "We must acknowledge the larger framework in which they exist and this research provides a way to do just that."
Decades of data reveal underestimated heat stress

The researchers examined more than 2,580 MHWs recorded across 20 U.S. estuaries over two decades. Their analysis found that conventional assessments underestimate total heat exposure by more than 150% on average, a difference that could have important consequences for understanding ecosystem health.

"Consider spending time in the sun," said Nardi, explaining the importance of cumulative heat exposure. "Your risk of sunburn depends on both sunlight intensity and how long you're exposed to it. A few minutes may cause little harm, but hours of exposure can take a toll. It's similar for marine organisms and warm water. Their biological responses depend not only on how warm the water becomes, but also on how long that warming persists. Prolonged, cumulative heat exposure, especially when combined with other stressors, can create conditions that some species may not be able to survive."
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The results indicate that warm water anomalies occurring before and after a heatwave are largely independent of the MHW itself. That finding challenges the usual way scientists interpret thermal stress and provides a new approach for estimating total heat exposure across coastal ecosystems.

The researchers also separated MHWs into two broad categories. About two thirds were classified as "individual" events. These occurred within approximately 60 days of elevated temperatures extending beyond the MHW itself.

The remaining one third were classified as "compound" events. These were associated with much longer periods of warming (approximately 90 days) before and after MHWs and generated more than three times the cumulative heat exposure produced by the MHW itself.

"As you can see, these are remarkably long periods of thermal exposure," explained Mazzini. "Many laboratory experiments simulate marine heatwaves by increasing temperatures for a few days or weeks in total. Our findings demonstrate that while these experiments hold value, they often fail to capture the prolonged thermal exposure organisms experience in nature. Our research provides a new framework for designing experiments that reflect natural marine heatwave conditions and quantify cumulative heat exposure, allowing scientists to better evaluate the biological impacts of marine heatwaves across ecosystems."
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Rethinking how marine heatwaves are studied

The work adds to a growing body of MHW research from faculty and researchers at VIMS & Batten School. Mazzini and Nathan Shunk, a third-year Ph.D. student, recently published a study defining "vertical marine heatwaves" and developing a classification system for them in the Bay.

Last year, Nardi and Mazzini also published research forecasting an increase in MHWs along the U.S. East Coast. That work identified connections between marine heatwaves and large scale climate patterns, including El Niño and the Pacific Decadal Oscillation.

"This study is an example of outstanding science born from a simple question about temperature's relationship to water quality conditions in estuaries," said Mazzini. "It was made possible by NOAA's National Estuarine Research Reserve System and its long-term, high-frequency temperature observations. Comprehensive monitoring programs like these allow us to ask bigger questions and uncover patterns that would otherwise remain hidden."
Longer warming could intensify ecosystem stress

The findings could also help coastal communities and resource managers better understand how prolonged warming affects marine environments. Long periods of elevated water temperatures can intensify other environmental pressures, including low oxygen conditions and harmful algal blooms.

Together, these stresses can place additional pressure on ecosystems ranging from seagrass beds to coral reefs. Including warming periods before and after MHWs in ecological assessments and laboratory experiments could help researchers create more realistic estimates of ecosystem vulnerability and provide better information for conservation and management decisions.

"This research has the potential to shift our understanding of the role warming waters play in ecosystem health by widening our focus beyond the heatwave window, so that we consider the full impact of temperature across time," explained Nardi. "I'm excited to discover what we may have missed before with this new perspective."

As MHWs become more frequent and intense, measuring their full cumulative impact may become increasingly important for protecting coastal resources and helping communities prepare for future environmental change.

articles.title: A record-breaking X-ray flash may reveal the birth of a magnetar

paras.en: A record-breaking X-ray flash may reveal the birth of a magnetar
A mysterious X-ray flash lasting nearly 10 minutes may have revealed the birth of a magnetar after two neutron stars collided.

- Astronomers have found strong evidence that some mysterious, minutes-long X-ray flashes are produced when two neutron stars collide and create a magnetar. One record-setting event glowed in X-rays for nearly 10 minutes, potentially opening a new way to find these extreme cosmic mergers.

Astronomers have long relied on brief bursts of gamma rays to identify collisions between neutron stars. These flashes can vanish in less than two seconds. Now, new research suggests that some neutron star mergers may also produce X-ray flashes that remain visible for several minutes.

A study published in Science Bulletin presents strong evidence for that connection. The findings raise the possibility that some mysterious cosmic flashes, whose sources have been difficult to explain, may actually come from merging neutron stars.

Since the Einstein Probe satellite launched in January 2024, astronomers have detected hundreds of bright X-ray flashes from distant galaxies. These events, called fast X-ray transients, have several possible origins. Some have been connected to the deaths of massive stars, while others remain unexplained.
Determining what causes them can be difficult because astronomers often do not know how far away the events are or how much energy they release.
Researchers in Professor Eleonora Troja's group, supported by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator grant, obtained observations that helped identify the source of one such X-ray transient.

After receiving an alert from the Einstein Probe satellite, the team rapidly organized follow-up observations with several instruments, including the European Southern Observatory's Very Large Telescope (VLT) and the Very Large Array. By studying what remained after the explosion, the researchers concluded that they may have witnessed the formation of a magnetar produced by the collision (or merger) of two neutron stars.

Neutron stars are extremely dense stellar remnants left behind after massive stars reach the ends of their lives. When two neutron stars merge, they generate gravitational waves that travel through space. The light produced during these events can help astronomers determine what survives the collision.
Short gamma-ray bursts have traditionally been the main electromagnetic signal associated with neutron star mergers.

"However, if the remnant of the collision is a magnetar, it could keep bursting for longer," said Prof. Troja, who is part of the Einstein Probe European collaboration and co-corresponding author of the paper. "Magnetars are rapidly spinning neutron stars with huge magnetic fields. When they damp their magnetic power into the surroundings, they can make any explosion brighter and longer-lasting. When I saw the X-ray data from this new event, I realized something was up."
The event, designated EP250704a/GRB 250704B, was detected on July 4, 2025, by the SVOM, Insight-HXMT and Einstein Probe satellites.
Its gamma-ray burst lasted only about half a second. In contrast, Einstein Probe recorded bright X-ray emission for nearly ten minutes.

"This is the longest lasting prompt X-ray flash ever observed from a neutron star merger," said graduate student Niccolò Passaleva, who led the follow-up observations using the VLT in Chile. "It is an opportunity to have a front-row seat to the most extreme forces of the Universe and discover more of its secrets."
The researchers had spent several years looking for a firm connection between fast X-ray transients and neutron star mergers. Previous candidates faded too quickly to provide enough evidence.
This time, Passaleva responded within minutes, allowing observations to begin while the event was still bright enough to study in detail.
"I was traveling home by train," recalls Passaleva, "and all of a sudden I was rushing against time to commandeer one of the largest telescopes in the world from my laptop."
Measuring a Flash From More Than 6 Billion Years Away

Using the VLT's X-Shooter instrument, Passaleva and his colleagues broke the event's light into its individual components. They identified distinct absorption patterns that allowed them to measure its redshift, which reveals how far away the source is.
The team measured a redshift of z=0.6610. That showed the explosion happened long before our Sun and its planets formed. Its light traveled for more than six billion years before reaching Earth.
The researchers then searched for another important clue.

Using deep observations from the VLT's FORS2 instrument, they looked for a bright supernova. A supernova would normally be expected if a long-lasting X-ray flash had been produced by the collapse of a massive star.
Taken together, the measured distance, the absence of a supernova and the properties of the burst provided strong evidence that the event came from a neutron star merger.
If additional events like this one are found, astronomers may be able to determine how frequently neutron star mergers produce magnetars.

"Finding more of these X-ray flashes could help reveal how often neutron star mergers create magnetars," concludes Passaleva, "I am really excited for the next run of gravitational wave observations, when we could finally pair one of these X-ray flashes with a burst of gravitational waves from the same source."
The research was carried out by an international collaboration of astronomers.
Lead authors are: An Li (Beijing Normal University), Chen-Wei Wang (Chinese Academy of Sciences), Niccolò Passaleva (University of Rome Tor Vergata), Jie An (Chinese Academy of Sciences)

Corresponding authors are: Binbin Zhang (Nanjing University), Eleonora Troja (University of Rome Tor Vergata), Yi-Han Iris Yin (The University of Hong Kong), Jing-Wei Hu (Chinese Academy of Sciences), Hua-Li Li (Chinese Academy of Sciences)
The VLT observations used in this study were conducted as part of the large program 114.27LW (PI: Eleonora Troja) titled "QUEENB: a QUEst for Elusive Neutron star and Black hole mergers."

articles.title: Cannabis users were twice as likely to commit violence, review finds

paras.en: Cannabis users were twice as likely to commit violence, review finds

- A review of more than 265,000 people found that cannabis use was associated with higher rates of both committing violence and becoming a victim of it. The researchers say the link is significant but does not prove cannabis itself is the cause.
A large review led by researchers at King's College London has found that people who use cannabis are more likely both to commit violent acts and to experience violence themselves.

Researchers from the Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology & Neuroscience (IoPPN) combined data from 63 studies involving more than 265,000 people. They analyzed the general population separately from people receiving psychiatric care.

The researchers used the World Health Organization's broad definition of violence, which includes physical, sexual and psychological violence toward another person, both inside and outside intimate relationships.

They also separated self-reported violence from cases that resulted in criminal convictions. When individual studies measured several forms of violence, the researchers focused on the most serious type reported. The findings were published in Psychological Medicine.
Dr. Marta Di Forti, co-author of the study from the Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology & Neuroscience (IoPPN) at King's College London, and South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust, said:

"As a clinician, I've seen how heavy cannabis use can be a factor in violence. We've been cautious for a long time about how far we could go in describing this link, but a review of this size lets us speak with more confidence about the risks, while being careful not to stigmatize people who use cannabis more broadly."
The review also found that people who used cannabis were about one and a half times as likely to become victims of violence. This association was stronger among women than among men.
Professor Sir Robin Murray, senior author of the study from the Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology & Neuroscience at King's College London, said:

"In the general population, people who used cannabis were around twice as likely to have committed a violent act as those who didn't; for those in psychiatric care, cannabis users were around two and a half times as likely to be violent as other psychiatric patients who didn't use cannabis. The link held in studies that followed people over time, though it was smaller than in studies that looked at a single point in time. For violence that led to a criminal conviction, people who used cannabis were three to four times as likely to have been convicted.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "As cannabis becomes more commercialized and legalized around the world, the conversation about its risks has focused mostly on the person using it. This review shows that violence, both committing it and experiencing it, needs to be part of that conversation too."
Implications for Mental Health and Public Health

Based on the findings, the researchers say mental health services should routinely ask about cannabis use when evaluating a person's risk of violence. They also argue that public health information about cannabis should include the possible connection with violence.

However, the researchers emphasize that the review identifies an association and does not prove that cannabis directly causes violence. Cannabis use often occurs alongside other factors that can also increase the risk of violent behavior or victimization, including alcohol use, other drug use and difficult social circumstances.

Only a small number of the studies measured how much cannabis people used or how often they used it. The findings involving criminal convictions were also based on a relatively limited number of studies.

Most of the research was conducted before high potency cannabis became common. The researchers suggest that daily use of today's more potent cannabis products could potentially be associated with stronger effects.

The study was supported by the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) Biomedical Research Centre: Maudsley and the Medical Research Council (MR/T007818/1). The views expressed are those of the authors and not necessarily those of the NIHR or the Department of Health and Social Care.
