Even in the face of intense opposition from some of the world’s largest tech companies, she remains steadfast … Future generations will look back on her landmark changes as courageous and trail-blazing.
Australian musician Troye Sivan was also included on the “influential rising stars” list, with a testimonial written by Kylie Minogue. She wrote:
Troye Sivan is a perfect 2020s pop star… Troye doesn’t just make pop music to love. He makes pop music to believe in.
Minns says ‘incumbent upon all of us’ to reduce public spending amid high inflation
The NSW premier, Chris Minns, has again defended the state’s record on inflation, as he seeks to distance himself from the federal government ahead of the March 2027 election.

Following calls by the former RBA governor, Philip Lowe, for federal and state governments to reduce public spending and run large budget surpluses amid high inflation and interest rates, Minns yesterday defended NSW’s record, saying “we’ve been careful with public money”.
Asked about Lowe’s comments again on 2GB today, and whether the prime minister and federal treasurer needed to be “called out”, Minns said:

Well, I think it’s incumbent upon all of us ... me included, and all of the premiers as well. I mean, the Reserve Bank’s been really clear. Public demand, government spending in the economy is pushing or putting pressure on inflation, as is other things like the war in the Middle East and Donald Trump’s decision to spark a war in Iran.

But the truth of the matter is, there’s not much we can do about that geopolitical conflict unless Donald Trump’s listening to this program, and even if he is, I don’t think it’d make a difference. So we have to be look at spending in NSW, whatever we can do, and we’ve tried to do that.
Minns went on to say that NSW was the “only state with a AAA credit rating from [rating agency] Fitch”.

We think that protecting public money, particularly as we get close to an election campaign where political parties are up for spending everything to try and get re-elected, we just can’t throw the barn out because the public are about to go to the polls.

articles.title: Daredevil Jaan Roose completes slackline walk high above central Seoul
articles.author: Raphael Rashid in Seoul

paras.en: The lunchtime crowds drifted slowly back to their offices along central Seoul’s main boulevard, heads up and phones raised to the sky.
paras.zh: 午餐时间的人群慢慢地回到他们的办公室，沿着首尔市中心的主要林荫大道，抬起头，电话飘向天空。

paras.en: High above, a narrow ribbon ran between the Koreana hotel and the Dong-A Media Center, a few hundred metres from the capital’s famous Gyeongbokgung palace and Gwanghwamun square.
paras.zh: 高处有一条狭窄的丝带，穿过韩国酒店和东亚媒体中心，距离首都著名的景福宫和光化门广场仅几百米。

paras.en: A countdown ticked down on a big screen, and at 1pm, a figure stepped off the roof of the Koreana and out over the drop.
paras.zh: 一个倒计时在大屏幕上滴答作响，下午1点，一个人物从韩亚航空的屋顶上跳了下来。

paras.en: Jaan Roose, an Estonian aerial athlete and three-time slackline world champion, was in Seoul to cross a 160-metre long highline suspended 120 metres above the city, in what organisers called South Korea’s first high-altitude slackline performance.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚空中运动员、三届Slackline世界冠军Jaan Roose在首尔穿越悬挂在城市上空120米处的160米长高线，组织者称之为韩国首次高空Slackline表演。

paras.en: The 34-year-old has made a name for himself slacklining dramatic urban environments, such as his 185-metre high feat between Qatar’s Katara towers.
paras.zh: 这位34岁的年轻人在戏剧性的城市环境中名声大噪，例如他在卡塔尔卡塔拉塔楼之间185米高的壮举。

paras.en: In 2024, he became the first person to slackline the strait of Messina between mainland Italy and Sicily, completing the 3.6km traverse despite a fall near the end, caught by his safety harness. Last month, he covered 14.7km over 12 hours on a line above the Danube in Bratislava, Slovakia.
paras.zh: 2024年，他成为第一个在意大利大陆和西西里岛之间的墨西拿海峡松弛的人，尽管他的安全带接近尾声，但他还是完成了3.6公里的航行。上个月，他在斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发的多瑙河上空行驶了14.7公里，历时12个小时。

paras.en: Below Roose, the Seoul traffic kept moving and the crowd held its breath each time he wobbled.
paras.zh: 在Roose的下面，首尔的交通不断移动，每次他摇晃时，人群都屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: “Just looking at him makes my legs go weak,” said Kim Young-sook, an office worker. “I can’t imagine how he can do that without being scared. It’s incredible.”
paras.zh: 上班族金英淑（ Kim Young-sook ）说： “只是看着他会让我的腿变得虚弱。” “我无法想象他怎么能做到这一点而不感到害怕。太不可思议了。”

paras.en: Midway across, Roose sat cross-legged on the line, then lay flat on his back, drawing gasps from below, before the daredevil rose and continued.
paras.zh: 中途，玫瑰盘腿坐在线上，然后平躺在背上，从下面喘气，然后冒失鬼站起来继续。

paras.en: “I’m worried he might fall”, said Choi Eun-jung, who came out to see Roose. “I know he’s a professional, but it’s still a little frightening to watch.”
paras.zh: “我担心他可能会摔倒，”出来见罗斯的崔恩中说。“我知道他是个职业选手，但看着他还是有点吓人。”

paras.en: On reaching Dong-A Media Center, he turned around, and started his return to the hotel rooftop.
paras.zh: 到达东亚传媒中心后，他转过身来，开始返回酒店屋顶。

paras.en: At the halfway point, he again dropped down and waved at the crowd. But this time he hung from the line with one arm and then dangled by his feet.
paras.zh: 中途，他再次跌倒，向人群挥手。但这一次，他用一只胳膊挂在绳子上，然后用脚晃来晃去。

paras.en: When he finished his performance, the crowds clapped, some clearly relieved.
paras.zh: 表演结束后，人群拍手，有些人明显松了一口气。

paras.en: At nearby Cheonggye plaza, people tried out their skills on slacklines, but these were set a mere 30cm and 50cm off the ground. Roose was scheduled for a second performance at 4pm.
paras.zh: 在附近的清溪广场，人们在松弛线上尝试他们的技能，但这些距离地面只有30厘米和50厘米。Roose定于下午4点进行第二次表演。

paras.en: Roose said a visit in 2022 to South Korea inspired his Gwanghwamun walk.
paras.zh: Roose说， 2022年对韩国的访问激发了他在光化门散步的灵感。

paras.en: On that trip, Roose encountered jultagi, Korea’s traditional tightrope walking, which Unesco added to its list of intangible cultural heritage in 2011.
paras.zh: 在那次旅行中， Roose遇到了韩国传统的钢丝绳步道jultagi ，联合国教科文组织于2011年将其列入非物质文化遗产名录。

paras.en: Unlike tightrope walking elsewhere, jultagi is as much comedy as acrobatics. The walker sings, jokes and dances on the rope, trading banter with a clown on the ground as musicians play.
paras.zh: 与其他地方走钢丝不同， jultagi和杂技一样喜剧。步行者在绳子上唱歌、开玩笑和跳舞，在音乐家演奏时与地上的小丑交换玩笑。

articles.title: Too early to say what motive for Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack was, Israeli PM says

paras.en: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said it is too early to say what was behind the foiled attempt by a co-pilot to crash an Emirati flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）表示，现在要说一名副驾驶试图坠毁从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的阿联酋航班的企图被挫败的原因还为时过早。

paras.en: There is no suggestion yet from authorities of a motive for the attacking pilot, but asked by Fox News whether there was any indication of Iran's involvement, Netanyahu replied: "It's too early to say."
paras.zh: 当局尚未暗示袭击飞行员的动机，但福克斯新闻询问是否有任何迹象表明伊朗参与其中，内塔尼亚胡回答说： “现在说还为时过早。”

paras.en: He said the attacker was being investigated in Saudi Arabia, where he was arrested after the Flydubai plane made an emergency landing.
paras.zh: 他说，袭击者正在沙特阿拉伯接受调查，他在Flydubai飞机紧急降落后被捕。

paras.en: Shaken passengers described how they burst into the cockpit and wrestled with the attacker as the aircraft descended sharply.
paras.zh: 震惊的乘客描述了他们如何在飞机急剧下降时冲进驾驶舱并与袭击者摔跤。

paras.en: Netanyahu added that he expected the attacker would be taken to the United Arab Emirates, where the plane took off. "We'll be following and possibly also participating in this investigation," Netanyahu added.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡补充说，他预计袭击者将被带到阿拉伯联合酋长国，飞机在那里起飞。“我们将关注并可能参与这项调查，”内塔尼亚胡补充道。

paras.en: He told CNN that Israel did not have any warning or advance intelligence about the incident on the plane, which was flying 174 people to Israel.
paras.zh: 他告诉美国有线电视新闻网，以色列对飞机上的事件没有任何警告或事先情报，飞机上有174人飞往以色列。

paras.en: The pilot was arrested after he stabbed the other pilot on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv and "apparently tried to crash the plane", according to Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 根据内塔尼亚胡的说法，这名飞行员在从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班上刺伤了另一名飞行员并“显然试图坠毁飞机”后被捕。

paras.en: Passengers and crew overpowered the attacker and retook control of the Flydubai aircraft, landing it safely at an airport in Tabuk, northwestern Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 乘客和机组人员制服了袭击者，重新控制了Flydubai飞机，将其安全降落在沙特阿拉伯西北部塔布克的一个机场。

paras.en: The passengers, who were almost all Israeli, arrived later on Wednesday in Tel Aviv on a repatriation flight.
paras.zh: 这些乘客几乎都是以色列人，于周三晚些时候乘坐遣返航班抵达特拉维夫。

paras.en: The stabbed pilot, named as Indian national Captain Smit Machchhar, has been taken to hospital but is reported to be in a stable condition. Netanyahu and India's leader Narendra Modi praised him as a "hero".
paras.zh: 这名被刺伤的飞行员名为印度国民队长Smit Machchhar ，已被送往医院，但据报道情况稳定。内塔尼亚胡和印度领导人纳伦德拉·莫迪称赞他是“英雄”。

paras.en: "Despite being stabbed and seriously injured, he fought back, resisted, opened the cockpit door, and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker â preventing a catastrophic mid-air disaster," Netanyahu wrote on X.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在X上写道： “尽管被刺伤并严重受伤，但他反击，抵抗，打开驾驶舱门，并使乘客和机组人员能够压制袭击者-防止灾难性的空中灾难。”

paras.en: The Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia said Machchhar was in a stable condition in hospital.
paras.zh: 印度驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆表示， Machchhar在医院病情稳定。

paras.en: Modi praised the pilot's actions, writing on X: "In the face of the gravest danger and despite being seriously injured, he showed immense courage and an unwavering resolve to protect the lives of others.
paras.zh: 莫迪称赞了飞行员的行为，并在X上写道： “面对最严重的危险，尽管受了重伤，但他表现出巨大的勇气和坚定不移的决心来保护他人的生命。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump said he had spoken with Netanyahu following the incident, saying it seemed as though the attacker was "perhaps a terrorist" or there were other reasons behind the attack.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德特朗普表示，他在事件发生后与内塔尼亚胡进行了交谈，称袭击者似乎是“可能是恐怖分子” ，或者袭击背后有其他原因。

paras.en: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz has also called it an "attempted jihadist terror attack", without giving any details.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部长以色列·卡茨（ Israel Katz ）也称其为“未遂的圣战恐怖袭击” ，但没有提供任何细节。

paras.en: Flydubai's flight FZ1073 took off from Dubai International Airport in the UAE at 03:05 GMT (07:05 local time), en route to Ben-Gurion Airport in Israel.
paras.zh: Flydubai的FZ1073航班于格林威治标准时间03:05 （当地时间07:05 ）从阿联酋迪拜国际机场起飞，前往以色列本古里安机场。

paras.en: Around two and a half hours into its journey, data from flight tracking website Flightrader24 reported a rapid descent over Saudi Arabia, dropping more than 17,000 feet (over 5,000m) in less than two minutes.
paras.zh: 飞行追踪网站Flightrader24的数据显示，飞行开始约两个半小时后，飞行数据在沙特阿拉伯上空快速下降，在不到两分钟的时间内下降了超过17,000英尺（超过5,000米）。

paras.en: Minutes later, the plane signalled an emergency code - squawk 7700 - before switching it to a squawk 7500 code reporting a hijacking.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，飞机发出紧急代码- SQUAWK 7700 -然后切换到SQUAWK 7500代码报告劫持。

paras.en: Around 20 minutes after these codes were signalled, the plane looped back into Saudi Arabia, where it later started its manual descent for landing.
paras.zh: 这些密码发出信号约20分钟后，这架飞机返回沙特阿拉伯，后来开始手动下降着陆。

paras.en: Less than an hour later, the plane returned to squawk 7700.
paras.zh: 不到一个小时后，飞机返回了SQUAWK 7700。

paras.en: Shortly after the incident, the Israeli and Saudi Arabian air forces dispatched fighter jets, while Netanyahu held urgent consultations.
paras.zh: 事件发生后不久，以色列和沙特阿拉伯空军派出了战斗机，而内塔尼亚胡举行了紧急磋商。

paras.en: Initial media reports suggested a fight had broken out between the aircraft's two pilots, causing the rapid descent and landing.
paras.zh: 最初的媒体报道表明，飞机的两名飞行员之间爆发了战斗，导致飞机快速下降和着陆。

paras.en: However, in the hours after the plane touched down in Tabuk, eyewitness accounts and a statement by Netanyahu confirmed one of the pilots had stabbed the other and, according to the Israeli prime minister, "apparently tried to crash" the aircraft.
paras.zh: 然而，在飞机在塔布克降落后的几个小时内，目击者的说法和内塔尼亚胡的一份声明证实，其中一名飞行员刺伤了另一名飞行员，据以色列总理称，这架飞机“显然试图坠毁”。

paras.en: He said an Israeli passenger told him "the plane went into a spin and began to descend" before the passenger and a crew member entered the cockpit and overpowered the "pilot who had carried out the stabbing".
paras.zh: 他说，一名以色列乘客告诉他“飞机旋转并开始下降” ，然后乘客和一名机组人员进入驾驶舱并压制了“进行刺伤的飞行员”。

paras.en: Two on-duty crew travelling on the flight were then able to land the plane safely, Flydubai said.
paras.zh: Flydubai说，两名乘坐飞机的值班机组人员随后能够安全降落飞机。

paras.en: In an address on Wednesday evening, Netanyahu called the situation "a very serious security incident" and said Israeli security forces were "maintaining close contact with the relevant authorities to ensure the continued safety of the passengers".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在周三晚上的一次讲话中称这种情况是“非常严重的安全事件” ，并表示以色列安全部队“与有关当局保持密切联系，以确保乘客的持续安全”。

paras.en: Unlike Israel's defence minister, Netanyahu did not give a motive for the incident during the address.
paras.zh: 与以色列国防部长不同，内塔尼亚胡在讲话中没有给出这一事件的动机。

paras.en: "I salute these heroes who demonstrated extraordinary resourcefulness and courage," he added. "They saved many lives and prevented a major disaster."
paras.zh: “我向这些表现出非凡的智慧和勇气的英雄致敬，”他补充说。“他们挽救了很多人的生命，避免了一场大灾难。”

paras.en: Flydubai said in a statement that "an altercation occurred in the flight deck" and the flight was "successfully secured by on-duty Flydubai crew travelling on the flight, who diverted and landed the aircraft safely at Tabuk airport".
paras.zh: Flydubai在一份声明中表示， “驾驶舱发生争执” ，该航班“由乘坐该航班的值班Flydubai机组人员成功固定，他们将飞机安全转移并降落在塔布克机场”。

paras.en: An airline spokesperson added: "Our immediate priority is to ensure the ongoing safety, health, and wellbeing of all passengers and crew members involved in this incident and support the official investigation."
paras.zh: 航空公司发言人补充说： “我们的当务之急是确保参与此事件的所有乘客和机组人员的安全、健康和福祉，并支持官方调查。”

paras.en: The passengers who had been on board flight FZ1073 arrived in Tel Aviv at around 18:40 local time (15:40 GMT). They were greeted at the airport by crowds of onlookers playing music, singing, dancing and waving Israeli flags.
paras.zh: 乘坐FZ1073航班的乘客于当地时间18:40左右（格林尼治标准时间15:40 ）抵达特拉维夫。他们在机场受到一群围观者的欢迎，他们演奏音乐、唱歌、跳舞和挥舞以色列国旗。

paras.en: A number of people were "very emotional and crying as they came off the plane," a paramedic from Israel's ambulance service told the BBC.
paras.zh: 以色列救护车服务处的一名护理人员告诉英国广播公司，许多人“下飞机时非常激动和哭泣”。

paras.en: One passenger, Yaniv Hayun, met Netanyahu and told him how he and others on the flight had restrained the attacker.
paras.zh: 一名乘客亚尼夫·哈云（ Yaniv Hayun ）会见了内塔尼亚胡，并告诉他他和飞机上的其他人是如何制服袭击者的。

paras.en: "The pilot who was stabbed was simply very close to the door, so it was hard for us to open it," Hayun said in a video posted on social media by the prime minister's office, but before the stabbed pilot - now identified as Machchhar - collapsed, he was able to open the door.
paras.zh: “被刺伤的飞行员离门很近，所以我们很难打开它，” Hayun在总理办公室在社交媒体上发布的视频中说，但在被刺伤的飞行员-现在被确定为Machchhar -倒塌之前，他能够打开门。

paras.en: Yaniv said he put the attacker, who was trying to disable the plane, in a chokehold before other passengers helped pin him down.
paras.zh: Yaniv说，在其他乘客帮助他之前，他将试图使飞机失效的袭击者置于窒息状态。

paras.en: He added that he "pulled the controls" of the plane and after it levelled out, another pilot took over control.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他“拉动了飞机的控制” ，飞机夷为平地后，另一名飞行员接管了控制权。

paras.en: Zvika Meness, another passenger, told Israeli public broadcaster Kan News that he and other passengers tied the attacker up "with his own zip ties and with the multimedia headphones".
paras.zh: 另一名乘客Zvika Meness告诉以色列公共广播公司Kan News ，他和其他乘客“用自己的拉链和多媒体耳机”将袭击者绑起来。

paras.en: He said: "There are children and families here who have been through a very severe, highly traumatic event."
paras.zh: 他说： “这里有儿童和家庭经历了非常严重，高度创伤性的事件。”

articles.title: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger

paras.en: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger
paras.zh: 乘客说，以色列航班像“过山车”一样直线下降

paras.en: A passenger on board Flight FZ1073, which fell 17,000ft (5,200m) in less than two minutes when a pilot apparently stabbed his co-pilot, told the BBC about his experience.
paras.zh: FZ1073航班上的一名乘客在不到两分钟的时间内坠落了17,000英尺（ 5,200米） ，当时一名飞行员显然刺伤了他的副驾驶，他告诉BBC他的经历。

paras.en: The aircraft had been flying to Israel when the incident took place, which Almog Itali described as feeling like a "rollercoaster".
paras.zh: 事件发生时，这架飞机正在飞往以色列， Almog Itali称之为“过山车”。

paras.en: The plane was diverted to Saudi Arabia after several passengers said they took control of the flight and two other pilots at the rear of the plane reportedly came forward to land the plane.
paras.zh: 这架飞机在几名乘客表示他们控制了飞机后被转移到沙特阿拉伯，据报道，飞机后方的另外两名飞行员挺身而出降落飞机。

articles.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike taken to hospital after surviving two lethal injections, says lawyer

paras.en: Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike has been taken to hospital after her heart was still beating following two lethal injections during her execution, her lawyer says.
paras.zh: 她的律师说，田纳西州死囚克里斯塔·派克（ Christa Pike ）在执行死刑期间接受了两次致命注射后，她的心脏仍在跳动，她已被送往医院。

paras.en: Her legal team filed an emergency motion to halt the convicted murderer's execution as it was happening, saying: "Ms Pike has lost consciousness and still has a heartbeat and is audibly snoring."
paras.zh: 她的法律团队提出了一项紧急动议，要求停止对被定罪的凶手的处决，并说： “派克女士已经失去知觉，仍然有心跳，听起来像是在打鼾。”

paras.en: One of her attorneys told the BBC that Pike, 50, was "being provided life-saving measures" in hospital after two syringes of pentobarbital had been administered.
paras.zh: 她的一位律师告诉英国广播公司，在接受两次戊巴比妥注射后， 50岁的派克正在医院“接受救生措施”。

paras.en: Pike was sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer.
paras.zh: 派克因谋杀19岁的科琳·斯莱默（ Colleen Slemmer ）于1996年被判处死刑。

paras.en: Pike was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, beat, tortured and killed 19-year-old Slemmer, whom they had met at a job training camp for troubled teens.
paras.zh: 派克18岁时，她和当时的男友塔达里尔·希普（ Tadaryl Shipp ）殴打、折磨并杀害了19岁的斯莱默（ Slemmer ） ，他们在为陷入困境的青少年提供的工作训练营中遇到了他们。

paras.en: Slemmer's mother May Martinez said she wanted the execution to take place, telling the Associated Press on Saturday: "Every time I think about it, I think about Colleen feeling that pain and trying to get up and run."
paras.zh: Slemmer的母亲May Martinez说她希望执行死刑，周六告诉美联社： “每当我想到它时，我都会想到Colleen感到疼痛并试图站起来跑步。”

paras.en: Her attempted execution took place at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville at about 20:00 local time on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 她于当地时间周三晚上20:00左右在纳什维尔的Riverbend Maximum安全机构被处决。

paras.en: Pike was given two doses of pentobarbital, and the curtain in the witness room was closed twice, the Associated Press reports.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，派克接受了两剂戊巴比妥，证人室的窗帘关闭了两次。

paras.en: Media were at some point asked to leave, the news agency said.
paras.zh: 该通讯社说，媒体在某些时候被要求离开。

paras.en: Pike's legal team said in a statement to the Tennessean newspaper: "Tonight the State of Tennessee once again failed to carry out a lawful execution.
paras.zh: 派克的法律团队在给田纳西州报纸的一份声明中说： “今晚，田纳西州再次未能执行合法处决。

paras.en: "We take no pleasure in being right, but the concerns raised by Ms Pike proved to be true: difficult vein access, blown veins, degraded pentobarbital, no emergency medical care available when things inevitably go wrong, all under a protocol that remains veiled in secrecy."
paras.zh: “我们不高兴自己是对的，但派克女士提出的担忧被证明是真实的：静脉通路困难，静脉被吹，戊巴比妥降解，当事情不可避免地出错时没有紧急医疗护理，所有这些都是在一个秘密的方案下进行的。”

paras.en: Pike's lawyers filed an emergency motion to stay her execution and provide medical care after the lethal injection was apparently botched.
paras.zh: 派克的律师提出了一项紧急动议，要求在致命注射显然失败后暂停处决并提供医疗护理。

paras.en: District Judge Clifton L Corker issued a ruling noting that "medical personnel have begun to administer medical care as requested in the motion".
paras.zh: 地区法官Clifton L Corker发布了一项裁决，指出“医务人员已开始按照动议中的要求提供医疗服务”。

paras.en: The Tennessee Department of Correction has said it stands by all the actions it took during the attempted execution.
paras.zh: 田纳西州惩教局表示，它支持在未遂处决期间采取的所有行动。

paras.en: "The Tennessee Department of Correction followed every step of the State's lawful, established execution protocol approved by the Attorney General's Office," department spokesperson Dorinda Carter told the Tennessean newspaper.
paras.zh: 田纳西州惩教部门发言人多琳达·卡特（ Dorinda Carter ）告诉《田纳西州报》： “田纳西州惩教部门遵循了总检察长办公室批准的该州合法、既定的执行协议的每一步。”

paras.en: "The lethal injection chemical in the protocol has consistently been effective, and the protocol does not allow for additional procedures beyond what was carried out this evening. Christa Pike has been transported to an off-site medical facility," she said.
paras.zh: “方案中的致命注射化学品一直有效，方案不允许在今晚之外进行额外的程序。Christa Pike已被送往非现场医疗机构，”她说。

paras.en: Dr Joel Zivot, a professor at the Emory University School of Medicine who told the BBC he had been retained by Pike's legal team as a medical expert, said she likely never achieved a sufficient blood level of pentobarbital to cause apnoea and cardiovascular failure during the attempted execution.
paras.zh: 埃默里大学医学院教授Joel Zivot博士告诉英国广播公司，他被派克的法律团队聘为医学专家，她说她可能从未达到足够的戊巴比妥血液水平，在试图执行期间导致呼吸暂停和心血管衰竭。

paras.en: "It's very possible that as a consequence of the delay of the beginning of resuscitation she will have a brain injury," Zivot said in an email.
paras.zh: Zivot在一封电子邮件中说： “很可能由于复苏开始的延迟，她会受到脑损伤。”

paras.en: The attempted capital punishment went ahead after multiple last-minute legal challenges by Pike's lawyers failed.
paras.zh: 派克的律师在最后一刻多次法律挑战失败后，死刑的尝试继续进行。

paras.en: The US Supreme Court had thwarted two separate efforts to stop the lethal injection.
paras.zh: 美国最高法院挫败了两项分别阻止致命注射的努力。

paras.en: Late on Wednesday, the Supreme Court overturned a reprieve granted by a lower court earlier in the day, which granted a pause saying it needed more time to consider the arguments in Pike's case.
paras.zh: 周三晚些时候，最高法院推翻了当天早些时候下级法院批准的缓刑，该缓刑允许暂停，称需要更多时间来考虑派克案件中的论点。

paras.en: It followed the Supreme Court's earlier dismissal of an appeal by Pike's lawyers, who had argued the jury did not get the chance to weigh mitigating evidence of Pike's documented history of childhood sexual abuse, before they sentenced her to death in 1996.
paras.zh: 在此之前，最高法院早些时候驳回了派克的律师的上诉，他们认为陪审团在1996年判处她死刑之前，没有机会权衡派克有记录的童年性虐待历史的减轻证据。

paras.en: The defence said that for years, the state of Tennessee had argued in court that she lied about being sexually abused as a child.
paras.zh: 辩方说，多年来，田纳西州在法庭上辩称，她谎称自己小时候遭到性虐待。

paras.en: But at a recent hearing about her execution method, the state said it did not dispute that she had suffered sexual abuse and rape.
paras.zh: 但在最近关于她的处决方法的听证会上，该州表示对她遭受性虐待和强奸没有争议。

paras.en: Tennessee's governor denied a clemency request this week from Pike, the only woman on the state's death row.
paras.zh: 田纳西州州长本周拒绝了派克的宽大处理请求，派克是该州死囚牢房中唯一的女性。

paras.en: In her clemency petition, Pike said that she intended to beat Slemmer, not kill her, but that she was unable to "put the brakes on".
paras.zh: 派克在她的宽大处理请愿书中说，她打算殴打Slemmer ，而不是杀死她，但她无法“刹车”。

paras.en: "I was a mentally ill 18-year-old kid," she said in a statement. "It took me numerous years to even realise the gravity of what I'd done. Even more to accept how many lives I affected. I took the life of someone's child, sister, friend. It sickens me now to think I had the ability to commit such a crime."
paras.zh: “我是一个患有精神疾病的18岁孩子，”她在一份声明中说。“我花了很多年才意识到我所做的事情的严重性。更重要的是要接受我影响了多少人的生命。我夺走了别人的孩子、姐姐、朋友的生命。现在，我觉得自己有能力犯下这样的罪行，这让我感到恶心。”

paras.en: The murder in 1995 created a media frenzy in Knoxville, Tennessee, after Colleen was found with an inverted pentagram - a symbol that is associated with satanic groups - carved into her chest. Pike has denied carving the symbol herself.
paras.zh: 1995年的谋杀案在田纳西州诺克斯维尔引发了一场媒体狂热，此前科琳被发现胸前刻着一个倒置的五角星--一个与撒旦团体有关的符号。派克否认自己雕刻了这个符号。

paras.en: Before the killing, Pike had accused Colleen of insulting her and trying to steal her then-boyfriend.
paras.zh: 在杀人之前，派克指责科琳侮辱她，并试图偷走她当时的男朋友。

paras.en: Two other residents at the camp later testified that Pike had bragged about the murder before and after, and showed them a piece of Colleen's skull.
paras.zh: 营地的另外两名居民后来作证说，派克在前后吹嘘这起谋杀案，并向他们展示了科琳的一块头骨。

paras.en: Colleen's mother May Martinez said she had waited decades to see Pike's sentence carried out.
paras.zh: 科琳的母亲梅·马丁内斯（ May Martinez ）说，她等了几十年才看到派克的判决得到执行。

paras.en: Over the weekend, she told the Associated Press that a group helped raise funds for her and her husband to travel from Florida to Tennessee to witness the execution.
paras.zh: 上周末，她告诉美联社，一个团体帮助她和她的丈夫从佛罗里达州前往田纳西州见证处决。

paras.en: "Not a day goes by, or a minute goes by that I do not think about Colleen. Holidays are the worst," Martinez said.
paras.zh: “没有一天过去了，也没有一分钟过去了，我没有想到Colleen。假期是最糟糕的，”马丁内斯说。

paras.en: Since 1976, when the Supreme Court resumed the death penalty, only 18 women have been executed in the US, compared to 1,663 men. That's about 1% of all US executions.
paras.zh: 自1976年最高法院恢复死刑以来，美国只有18名女性被处决，而男性为1663人。这约占美国所有处决人数的1%。

articles.title: TAEMIN Forced to Pull Plug on Entire North American Tour Due to Visa Issues: ‘No Clear Timeline For Issuance’
articles.author: Gil Kaufman

paras.en: K-pop star TAEMIN has been forced to cancel the entire North American run of his TAEMIN WORLD TOUR <LiMiNaL> due to reported visa issues. In a statement posted on X earlier this week, the solo star and former member of boy band SHINee explained, “Due to ongoing uncertainty surrounding U.S. visa and related administrative processes affecting key touring and production personnel, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the scheduled North American dates of the 2026-27 TAEMIN WORLD TOUR <LiMiNaL>.”
paras.zh: 由于签证问题，韩国流行歌星泰民被迫取消了整个北美的泰民世界巡回演唱会<LiMiNaL>。在本周早些时候在 X 上发布的一份声明中，这位独唱明星、男孩乐队 SHINee 的前成员解释道：“由于美国签证和影响关键巡演和制作人员的相关行政程序的持续不确定性，我们做出了艰难的决定，推迟原定的 2026-27 泰民世界巡回演唱会 <LiMiNaL> 的北美日期。”

paras.en: The 33-year-old singer added that a “significant number” of key touring and production staff hired for the North American tour were still awaiting their travel visas, with “no clear timeline for issuance. Given the continued uncertainty surrounding the participation of essential personnel, we determined that proceeding with the tour as scheduled would carry significant operational and production risks.”
paras.zh: 这位 33 岁的歌手补充说，为北美巡演聘用的“大量”主要巡演和制作人员仍在等待旅行签证，“没有明确的发放时间表。鉴于关键人员参与的持续不确定性，我们确定按计划进行巡演将带来重大的运营和制作风险。”

paras.en: He promised that the North American leg of his world tour remains an “integral part” of the outing and assured fans he will announce rescheduled shows soon. In the meantime, refunds for the originally scheduled North American shows will be available upon request from the original point of purchase.
paras.zh: 他承诺，他的世界巡演的北美站仍然是这次巡演的“不可或缺的一部分”，并向粉丝保证他将很快宣布重新安排的演出。与此同时，原定北美演出的退款将根据原购买点的要求提供。

paras.en: “We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the shows and appreciate your understanding,” he wrote. “We look forward to sharing the new North American tour dates with you soon.”
paras.zh: 他写道：“我们向所有期待演出的人致以诚挚的歉意，并感谢你们的理解。” “我们期待尽快与您分享新的北美巡演日期。”

paras.en: The six-city tour was slated to open on Oct. 12 at SAP Center in San Jose, Calif. before hitting Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Grand Prairie, Texas, Chicago and Newark, N.J.
paras.zh: 六城市巡演定于 10 月 12 日在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的 SAP 中心拉开帷幕，然后前往洛杉矶、拉斯维加斯、德克萨斯州大草原城、芝加哥和新泽西州纽瓦克。

paras.en: The dates were slated to support TAEMIN’s August EP Phase 1: SOFT VIOLENCE, which dropped four months after he made his Coachella debut with the first-ever solo set by a male Korean artist at the festival.
paras.zh: 这些日期原定是为了支持泰民 8 月的 EP 第一阶段：SOFT VIOLENCE，该专辑在泰民在科切拉音乐节首次亮相、首次由韩国男性艺术家在音乐节上独唱四个月后停播。

paras.en: Under the second Trump administration a number of international artists have faced long delays in obtaining visas and last-minute revocations by the State Department. Recent examples include Canadian indie rockers The New Pornographers, FKA Twigs, Australian artist Keli Holiday (Adam Hyde), and norteño artist Julión Álvarez.
paras.zh: 在特朗普第二届政府执政期间，许多国际艺术家在获得签证方面面临着长期拖延和国务院在最后一刻撤销签证的情况。最近的例子包括加拿大独立摇滚歌手 The New Pornographers、FKA Twigs、澳大利亚艺术家 Keli Holiday (Adam Hyde) 和北欧艺术家 Julión Álvarez。

articles.title: ‘Street Fighter’ Soundtrack Takes ‘Guile’s Theme’ From Arcade to Big Screen: See the Full Track List
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: If you’ve ever played Street Fighter, there’s a good chance you might recognize “Guile’s Theme” before the first few notes even finish. Now, the famous melody has been transformed into a cinematic piece that gives the tune a new, adrenaline-filled life.
paras.zh: 如果您曾经玩过《街头霸王》，那么您很有可能在前几个音符结束之前就认出了“Guile 的主题”。现在，这首著名的旋律已被改编成电影作品，赋予了这首曲子新的、充满肾上腺素的生命。

paras.en: Leo Birenberg and Zach Robinson have unveiled their new version of “Guile’s Theme,” the lead single from the upcoming Street Fighter original motion picture soundtrack — and Billboard is exclusively revealing the full track list for the soundtrack below as well. “Guile’s Theme” arrives ahead of the film’s Oct. 16 theatrical release, giving one of the video game franchise’s signature musical pieces a cinematic upgrade. It pairs its familiar melody with orchestral arrangements, electric guitar and an overall heroic sound.
paras.zh: 里奥·比伦伯格 (Leo Birenberg) 和扎克·罗宾逊 (Zach Robinson) 推出了他们的新版本“Guile’s Theme”，这是即将上映的《街头霸王》原创电影原声带的主打单曲，而 Billboard 也独家公布了下面原声带的完整曲目列表。 《Guile’s Theme》在影片 10 月 16 日院线上映之前上映，为视频游戏系列的标志性音乐作品之一带来了电影化升级。它将熟悉的旋律与管弦乐编排、电吉他和整体英雄般的声音相结合。

paras.en: The new recording is more than just a nostalgic nod to the game. For Birenberg and Robinson, “Guile’s Theme” was part of the musical foundation that helped shape them as composers. The duo said the Street Fighter music has been a major influence on their musical identities since they were young, making the opportunity to reinterpret the theme for the new film extremely substantial.
paras.zh: 新录音不仅仅是对游戏的怀旧致敬。对于比伦伯格和罗宾逊来说，“Guile’s Theme”是帮助他们成为作曲家的音乐基础的一部分。两人表示，《街头霸王》音乐从他们年轻时起就对他们的音乐身份产生了重大影响，这使得重新诠释新电影主题的机会变得非常重要。

paras.en: “To describe the music of Street Fighter as an influence would simply be an understatement — it is legitimately one of the core musical works that forged our musical identities,” the pair said in a statement. “As young and budding composers, we listened to Yoko Shimomura’s iconic ‘Guile’s Theme’ probably more than Raiders of the Lost Ark. We hope fans will hear the love and reverence we hold for this music within our version of ‘Guile’s Theme.’ We are beyond grateful to Kitao [Sakurai] and the teams at Legendary and Capcom for the opportunity to contribute music to the Street Fighter universe.”
paras.zh: “将《街头霸王》的音乐描述为一种影响只是一种轻描淡写的说法——它确实是塑造我们音乐身份的核心音乐作品之一，”两人在一份声明中表示。 “作为年轻的崭露头角的作曲家，我们听下村阳子标志性的《Guile's Theme》的次数可能比《夺宝奇兵》还要多。我们希望粉丝们能够在我们版本的《Guile's Theme》中听到我们对这首音乐的热爱和崇敬。我们非常感谢北尾[樱井]以及传奇影业和卡普空的团队给了我们为《街头霸王》宇宙贡献音乐的机会。”

paras.en: The soundtrack, also due Oct. 16 via Milan Records, will feature Birenberg and Robinson’s original score for the film, along with two new original songs from industrial metal band HEALTH that were written specifically for the movie.
paras.zh: 该原声带也将通过米兰唱片公司于 10 月 16 日发行，其中包括比伦伯格和罗宾逊为电影创作的原创配乐，以及工业金属乐队 HEALTH 专为电影创作的两首新原创歌曲。

paras.en: Directed by Kitao Sakurai, the new Street Fighter brings the Capcom fighting game franchise back to theaters with Andrew Koji as Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken Masters and Callina Liang as Chun-Li. The story is set in 1993 and follows Ryu and Ken as they reunite after being recruited by Chun-Li for the World Warrior Tournament. The expansive cast also includes Jason Mamoa as Blanka, David Dastmalchian as M. Bison, Cody Rhoes as Guile, Curtis “50 Cent” Jackson as Balrog and Joe “Roman Reigns” Anoa’i as Akuma.
paras.zh: 由北尾樱井执导的新《街头霸王》将 Capcom 格斗游戏系列带回影院，安德鲁·小司 (Andrew Koji) 饰演 Ryu，诺亚·琴蒂尼奥 (Noah Centineo) 饰演肯·马斯特斯 (Ken Masters)，卡琳娜·梁 (Callina Liang) 饰演春丽。故事发生在 1993 年，讲述了 Ryu 和 Ken 在被春丽招募参加世界战士锦标赛后重聚的故事。庞大的演员阵容还包括杰森·马莫阿（Jason Mamoa）饰演布兰卡（Blanka）、大卫·达斯马奇安（David Dastmalchian）饰演M. Bison、科迪·罗伊斯（Cody Rhoes）饰演Guile、柯蒂斯·“50 Cent”·杰克逊（Curtis “50 Cent” Jackson）饰演炎魔（Balrog）和乔·“罗曼·雷恩斯”·阿诺伊（Joe “Roman Reigns” Anoa'i）饰演阿库玛（Akuma）。

articles.title: Watch Tom Cruise Dust off His ‘Risky Business’ Dance Moves for the ‘Jennifer Hudson Show’ Spirit Tunnel
articles.author: Gil Kaufman

paras.en: Tom Cruise dug out some of his classic early career dance moves on his visit to the Jennifer Hudson Show on Tuesday (Sept. 29). The Oscar-nominated movie icon even brought along his signature Ray-Ban sunglasses for an enthusiastic shuffle down the show’s iconic Spirit Tunnel.
paras.zh: 汤姆·克鲁斯 (Tom Cruise) 在周二（9 月 29 日）参观詹妮弗·哈德森秀 (Jennifer Hudson Show) 时，展现了他职业生涯早期的一些经典舞蹈动作。这位获得奥斯卡提名的电影偶像甚至还带着他标志性的雷朋太阳镜，热情地拖着脚步走过该剧标志性的灵魂隧道。

paras.en: Dressed all in black, Cruise spun, bopped and kicked his way down the carpet, pulling several staffers in to dance with him as the crew sang a Risky Business homage to the Digger star cued to Bob Seger’s “Old Time Rock & Roll,” but with Cruise-centric lyrics.
paras.zh: 克鲁斯身着一身黑衣，在地毯上旋转、跳跃和踢腿，拉着几名工作人员与他一起跳舞，而工作人员则唱着《危险的生意》向这位挖掘者明星致敬，暗示着鲍勃·西格的“旧时光摇滚”，但歌词以克鲁斯为中心。

paras.en: “We’ve got Tom Cruise at the Happy Place. He’s in the tunnel walking to the stage,” the crew sang to Cruise, as they matched his vibe with their own black shades. “He’s a legend everybody knows. We’ve got that Tom Cruise rock ‘n’ roll.”
paras.zh: “我们在快乐之地找到了汤姆·克鲁斯。他正在隧道中走向舞台，”工作人员向克鲁斯唱道，同时他们将汤姆·克鲁斯的氛围与他们自己的黑色色调相匹配。 “他是每个人都知道的传奇人物。我们有汤姆·克鲁斯的摇滚乐。”

paras.en: Cruise is out and about promoting the environmental apocalypse drama Digger, due out on Friday (Oct. 2) and directed by Oscar-winner Alejandro González Iñárritu (Birdman, The Revenant). In it, Cruise disappears behind makeup and prosthetics into the role of Texas oilman Digger Rockwell, whose company sparks an ecological disaster that could end in nuclear apocalypse.
paras.zh: 克鲁斯出任宣传环境灾难片《挖掘者》，该剧将于周五（10 月 2 日）上映，由奥斯卡奖得主亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊纳里图（《鸟人》、《荒野猎人》）执导。在影片中，克鲁斯化装和假肢消失在德克萨斯州石油公司迪格·罗克韦尔的角色中，他的公司引发了一场生态灾难，最终可能导致核灾难。

paras.en: While some critics have said the film might finally win Cruise his first competitive Oscar, others have savaged it, including the Boston Globe, which gave it a brutal 0-out-of-4 rating, calling it the “worst movie” of his career, as well as The Hollywood Reporter, which said it was “a climate crisis satire so smug and bombastic it makes Adam McKay’s Don’t Look Up seem almost innocuous.” The New York Post dubbed it Cruise’s “first real stinker in nearly 10 years,” predicting that audiences will “want to leave after the first five minutes,” while Deadline said it was a “return to the kind of adventurous films in cinema’s groundbreaking” 1970s era, and “the kind of movie we don’t see often on this scale.”
paras.zh: 虽然一些评论家表示这部电影可能最终为克鲁斯赢得了他的第一座奥斯卡奖，但其他人却猛烈抨击了它，其中包括《波士顿环球报》，该片给了该片残酷的 0 分（满分 4 分），称其为克鲁斯职业生涯中“最糟糕的电影”；还有《好莱坞报道》，该报称该片是“一部如此自鸣得意、夸夸其谈的气候危机讽刺片，让亚当·麦凯的《别抬头》看起来几乎无伤大雅。” 《纽约邮报》将其称为克鲁斯“近 10 年来第一部真正的烂片”，并预测观众将“在前五分钟后就想离开”，而 Deadline 则表示，这是“电影界开创性的”1970 年代那种冒险电影的回归，也是“我们不常看到这种规模的电影”。

paras.en: Cruise’s long-walk promotion of the film began in July when he brought his signature high-energy spirit to the 2026 FIFA World Cup final in pregame pump-up speech at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium before the gripping match between champions Spain and Argentina. Most recently it brought him to the Kansas City Chiefs’ season opener, where he hung out and yukked it up with Taylor Swift, who he said “schooled” him on football, while calling the singer a “genius.
paras.zh: 克鲁斯对这部电影的长期宣传始于 7 月份，当时他在新泽西州大都会人寿体育场举行的 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯决赛中，在冠军西班牙和阿根廷之间扣人心弦的比赛之前发表了赛前演讲，将自己标志性的高能精神带到了现场。最近，他参加了堪萨斯城酋长队的赛季揭幕战，在那里他和泰勒·斯威夫特一起闲逛并大笑，他说泰勒·斯威夫特“教会”了他足球，同时称这位歌手是“天才”。

paras.en: Digger‘s cast also includes Sandra Hüller, Riz Ahmed, Jesse Plemons, John Goodman, Michael Stuhlbarg and Emma D’Arcy.
paras.zh: 《挖掘者》的演员阵容还包括桑德拉·惠勒、里兹·艾哈迈德、杰西·普莱蒙、约翰·古德曼、迈克尔·斯图巴和艾玛·达西。

articles.title: Condé Nast CEO Leaves to Run Mattel In Major Shake Up
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: Mattel on Wednesday named Roger Lynch as its new CEO and chairman, succeeding Ynon Kreiz, who the the toy giant says is leaving for a role at another public company.
paras.zh: 美泰周三任命罗杰·林奇 (Roger Lynch) 为其新任首席执行官兼董事长，接替伊农·克雷兹 (Ynon Kreiz)，这家玩具巨头表示，伊农·克雷兹 (Ynon Kreiz) 即将离职，前往另一家上市公司任职。

paras.en: Kreiz, of course, is the executive responsible for pushing Mattel into entertainment, with box office hits like Barbie, alongside a slate of other films and shows.
paras.zh: 当然，克瑞兹是负责推动美泰进军娱乐业的高管，推出了《芭比娃娃》等票房热门影片以及一系列其他电影和节目。

paras.en: Lynch, who was already a Mattel board member (he has been its lead independent director) since 2018, will step down as CEO of Condé Nast, the media company that owns brands like Vogue, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair and Wired. Mike Perlis, currently the lead independent director of the publishing giant, will become interim CEO.
paras.zh: 林奇自 2018 年起一直是美泰董事会成员（一直担任首席独立董事），他将辞去康泰纳仕集团首席执行官的职务。康泰纳仕集团是一家媒体公司，旗下拥有《Vogue》、《纽约客》、《名利场》和《连线》等品牌。这家出版巨头现任首席独立董事迈克·佩利斯(Mike Perlis)将担任临时首席执行官。

paras.en: “Together, we navigated a pandemic, enormous disruption across our industry, and a media landscape that seemed to change beneath our feet every year,” Lynch wrote in a memo to staff. “And yet, there is no doubt that we transformed Condé Nast for a new era. We brought our global businesses together, built a unified company, and strengthened our journalism and creative work.”
paras.zh: 林奇在给员工的备忘录中写道：“我们共同应对了一场流行病、整个行业的巨大混乱，以及我们脚下似乎每年都在发生变化的媒体格局。” “然而，毫无疑问，我们让康泰纳仕进入了一个新时代。我们将全球业务整合在一起，建立了一家统一的公司，并加强了我们的新闻和创意工作。”

paras.en: Both Mattel and Condé Nast announced the changes early Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: 美泰和康泰纳仕周三凌晨都宣布了这些变化。

paras.en: “Roger is a visionary leader with a track record of growing global companies at the forefront of changing industry and consumer trends,” said Mattel board member Judy Olian, who led the succession process, said in a statement. “Throughout his service on the Board, Roger has been an invaluable contributor to shaping the company’s direction in the midst of its expansion into entertainment and digital products. The Board is most grateful for Ynon’s eight years of transformational leadership, and wishes him every success in his new role. Ynon leaves an invaluable legacy of transitioning Mattel from a toy manufacturer to a leading IP-driven play and family entertainment company. Knowing Roger as we do, we are confident that he and the talented Mattel team will build on that powerful foundation, and continue to advance our strategy to leverage our iconic brand portfolio.”
paras.zh: 领导继任流程的美泰董事会成员朱迪·奥利安在一份声明中表示：“罗杰是一位富有远见的领导者，在不断发展的跨国公司中拥有走在行业和消费者趋势变化前沿的记录。” “罗杰在董事会任职期间，为公司向娱乐和数字产品领域扩张的方向做出了宝贵贡献。董事会非常感谢伊农八年来的变革性领导，并祝愿他在新职位上取得成功。伊农为美泰从玩具制造商转型为领先的 IP 驱动的游戏和家庭娱乐公司留下了宝贵的遗产。我们了解罗杰，我们相信他和才华横溢的美泰团队将继续发展下去。强大的基础，并继续推进我们的战略，利用我们标志性的品牌组合。”

paras.en: “I am honored by the Board’s confidence in me and couldn’t be more excited to lead the incredible team at Mattel,” added Lynch. “Throughout my years on the Board, I have admired Mattel’s brands, its talented people, and unique culture. I am especially grateful to Ynon for his many years of outstanding leadership and service to the company. During his tenure, Mattel has leveraged the power of its world-class brands, attracted exceptional entertainment partners, and strengthened its balance sheet. The company is well positioned for its next phase of profitable growth and its exciting new chapter.”
paras.zh: 林奇补充道：“董事会对我充满信心，我感到非常荣幸，能够领导美泰这支令人难以置信的团队，我感到非常兴奋。” “在我担任董事会的这些年里，我一直钦佩美泰的品牌、人才和独特的文化。我特别感谢 Ynon 多年来对公司的杰出领导和服务。在他任职期间，美泰利用了其世界级品牌的力量，吸引了杰出的娱乐合作伙伴，并增强了其资产负债表。公司已为下一阶段的盈利增长和激动人心的新篇章做好了准备。”

paras.en: Mattel owns brands like Barbie, American Girl, Hot Wheels, Thomas & Friends, Uno, Bob the Builder, and others, producing toys, games and other consumer products. It also has a robust entertainment business, with Kreiz pushing to get the toymaker further into that world in recent years. A Hot Wheels movie is in the works with Warner Bros. for example.
paras.zh: 美泰拥有芭比、美国女孩、风火轮、托马斯和朋友、Uno、鲍勃建造者等品牌，生产玩具、游戏和其他消费品。该公司还拥有强大的娱乐业务，近年来，Kreiz 一直在努力让这家玩具制造商进一步进入这个领域。例如，华纳兄弟正在制作一部风火轮电影。

paras.en: Lynch was mainly a technology executive before he joined Condé Nast seven and a half years ago, having run Pandora and Sling TV. He remains on the publisher’s board.
paras.zh: 林奇在七年半前加入康泰纳仕之前，主要担任技术高管，负责运营 Pandora 和 Sling TV。他仍留在出版商董事会。

paras.en: “It has been a privilege to lead Mattel, with a global team dedicated to its mission and purpose, and I am proud of all we have achieved together,” said Kreiz. “Mattel is in a position of strength, with a world-class brand portfolio, product offering, and global capabilities. I am grateful to the Board, management team, and entire Mattel organization for their commitment and collaboration during the past eight years, and I have every confidence the company will continue to thrive under Roger’s leadership.”
paras.zh: Kreiz 表示：“能够领导 Mattel 是我的荣幸，拥有一支致力于其使命和目标的全球团队，我为我们共同取得的一切成就感到自豪。” “美泰处于优势地位，拥有世界一流的品牌组合、产品供应和全球能力。我感谢董事会、管理团队和整个美泰组织在过去八年中的承诺和合作，我完全相信公司将在罗杰的领导下继续蓬勃发展。”

paras.en: Mattel says that Diana Ferguson will become the company’s lead independent director given Lynch’s new role.
paras.zh: 美泰表示，鉴于林奇的新角色，戴安娜·弗格森将成为公司的首席独立董事。

paras.en: At Condé, Perlis will step in to lead the company on an interim basis. Perlis is the former CEO of Ziff-Davis publishing, and the first non-family member to serve as CEO of Forbes.
paras.zh: 在Condé，玻璃市将临时介入并领导该公司。玻璃市是齐夫戴维斯出版公司的前首席执行官，也是第一位担任福布斯首席执行官的非家族成员。

paras.en: “Roger has led Condé Nast successfully through a period of enormous change,” said Steven Newhouse Co-President of Advance Publications, in a statement. “On behalf of our Board, we are grateful for his leadership, and pleased that he will continue to serve on the Board. Roger built a great team and positioned the business well for what comes next. With Mike stepping in alongside that team, we expect a seamless transition and look forward to building on the progress Roger has made.”
paras.zh: Advance Publications 联席总裁史蒂文·纽豪斯 (Steven Newhouse) 在一份声明中表示：“罗杰带领康泰纳仕成功地度过了一段巨大变革的时期。” “代表我们的董事会，我们感谢他的领导，并很高兴他将继续在董事会任职。罗杰建立了一支优秀的团队，并为接下来的业务做好了定位。随着迈克与该团队一起加入，我们期望实现无缝过渡，并期待在罗杰所取得的进展的基础上再接再厉。”

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Sets Super Bowl Night
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Dancing With the Stars is bringing the Super Bowl to the ballroom for a special theme night in honor of the big game.
paras.zh: 与星共舞将超级碗带到舞厅，举办一个特别的主题之夜，以纪念这场盛大的比赛。

paras.en: It was announced on Good Morning America Wednesday morning that the Tuesday, Oct. 13 episode of the reality series will officially be Super Bowl Night. Couples will dance to iconic songs performed in various former Super Bowl shows.
paras.zh: 《早安美国》周三上午宣布，真人秀节目 10 月 13 日星期二的剧集将正式成为超级碗之夜。情侣们将随着各种前超级碗表演中表演的标志性歌曲起舞。

paras.en: ABC did not announce which songs from former Super Bowl performers will be featured on DWTS Super Bowl Night, but it’s estimated that 11 couples will still be in the competition by the Oct. 13 episode.
paras.zh: ABC 并未宣布 DWTS 超级碗之夜将收录前超级碗表演者的哪些歌曲，但预计到 10 月 13 日这一集，仍有 11 对情侣将参加比赛。

paras.en: Super Bowl Night precedes Super Bowl LXI, which will air on ABC and ESPN Sunday, Feb. 14, 2027.
paras.zh: 超级碗之夜先于第 61 届超级碗，后者将于 2027 年 2 月 14 日星期日在 ABC 和 ESPN 上播出。

paras.en: Dancing With the Stars is no stranger to having NFL players on its cast; plenty of former players have appeared on the show, and four have won mirrorball trophies. Among those winners are Emmitt Smith (season three), Hines Ward (season 12), Donald Driver (season 14) and Rashad Jennings (season 24).
paras.zh: 《与星共舞》的演员阵容对于 NFL 球员来说并不陌生。许多前球员都出现在节目中，其中四人赢得了镜子球奖杯。这些获奖者包括埃米特·史密斯（第三季）、海因斯·沃德（第 12 季）、唐纳德·德赖弗（第 14 季）和拉沙德·詹宁斯（第 24 季）。

paras.en: Notably, when Andy Richter announced the theme nights for DWTS season 35, the Oct. 13 episode slot was left untitled, leaving much anticipation for Wednesday’s announcement. Super Bowl Night joins a list of upcoming theme nights including Mariah Carey Night, Dedication Night, Horror Movie Night, Disney Night and Grammy Night.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，当安迪·里希特 (Andy Richter) 宣布 DWTS 第 35 季的主题之夜时，10 月 13 日的剧集时段并未命名，这让人们对周三的宣布充满期待。超级碗之夜加入了一系列即将到来的主题之夜，包括玛丽亚凯莉之夜、奉献之夜、恐怖电影之夜、迪士尼之夜和格莱美之夜。

paras.en: During Tuesday night’s Yacht Rock-themed episode, Taylor Hanson and Britt Stewart were eliminated from the show. Amber Glenn and Harry Shum Jr. respectively became the first celebrities to earn eights from the judges, heating up the competition.
paras.zh: 在周二晚上的游艇摇滚主题节目中，泰勒·汉森和布里特·斯图尔特被淘汰出局。 Amber Glenn 和 Harry Shum Jr. 分别成为第一批获得评委打分的名人，使竞争更加激烈。

paras.en: Season 35 of Dancing With the Stars airs Tuesdays at 8 p.m., simulcasting across ABC and Disney+ and streaming the next day on Hulu. Check out all of The Hollywood Reporter‘s DWTS coverage here.
paras.zh: 《与星共舞》第 35 季每周二晚上 8 点在 ABC 和 Disney+ 同步播出，并于次日在 Hulu 上直播。请在此处查看《好莱坞报道》的所有 DWTS 报道。

articles.title: ‘Verity’ Review: Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett Try and Fail to Slink Their Way Through a Dumb Mystery
articles.author: Richard Lawson

paras.en: It’s been said that writing about music is like dancing about architecture. But what about writing about writing? That often seems even more impossible, and fruitless, than doing a tango to explain, say, the Guggenheim in Bilbao. Look to the most recent example, the new film Verity, in which Anne Hathaway plays a writer who is said to go to such dark places in her popular novels that one must assume she herself is some sort of wicked entity. Only, every time we see or hear that writing in the film, it’s about as banal as something James Patterson wrote on a cocktail napkin and sold for $10 million.
paras.zh: 有人说，写音乐就像跳舞建筑。但是关于写作的写作又如何呢？与用探戈来解释毕尔巴鄂的古根海姆美术馆相比，这往往显得更不可能，也更徒劳。看看最近的例子，新电影《真理》，安妮·海瑟薇在其中扮演一位作家，据说她在她的流行小说中陷入了如此黑暗的地方，以至于人们必须假设她本人是某种邪恶的实体。只是，每次我们在电影中看到或听到这样的文字时，它就像詹姆斯·帕特森在鸡尾酒餐巾纸上写下并以 1000 万美元出售的东西一样平庸。

paras.en: I suppose we shouldn’t be that surprised, considering the film’s source: Verity is based on a novel by the blockbuster queen of tortured romance Colleen Hoover, who took a turn into domestic thriller for this truth vs. fiction potboiler. Hoover has certainly found a way to strike a chord with readers the world over, but she’s not exactly an adept stylist. Nor, it turns out, is she very good at building a mystery. Verity is chock full of clunky reveals and “huh??”-inducing twists. It’s the palest of Gone Girl imitations, mixed with a tinge of Brontë gothic and that infamous 2005 Modern Love column about a writer (Ayelet Waldman) loving her husband more than her kids.
paras.zh: 考虑到这部电影的来源，我想我们不应该感到那么惊讶：《真实》是根据饱受折磨的浪漫爱情片女王科琳·胡佛的小说改编的，她因这部真与假的粗俗剧而转变为家庭惊悚片。胡佛当然找到了一种引起世界各地读者共鸣的方法，但她并不是一位熟练的造型师。事实证明，她也不擅长制造谜团。 《Verity》充满了笨拙的揭露和“嗯？？”引发的曲折。这是《消失的爱人》中最苍白的模仿，混合了勃朗特哥特式的色彩和臭名昭著的 2005 年《现代爱情》专栏，该专栏讲述了一位作家（阿耶莱特·沃尔德曼饰）爱丈夫胜过爱孩子的故事。

paras.en: Cast: Dakota Johnson, Anne Hathaway, Josh Hartnett
paras.zh: 主演：达科塔·约翰逊 安妮·海瑟薇 乔什·哈奈特

paras.en: Which sounds kinda fun, right? And indeed Verity — directed with straightforward competence and a faint wry smirk by Michael Showalter and adapted by screenwriter Nick Antosca (Apple TV’s Cape Fear series) — is a mild lark for its first hour. Dakota Johnson, deadened of voice and dewy of eye, plays Lowen (Hoover’s character names are among the silliest aspects of her work; there’s a kid named Crew in this movie), a published but under-read novelist who is drawn by money and curiosity to snowy Vermont to complete an odd task. She’ll help finish, or really ghostwrite, the final few novels of Hathaway’s Verity Crawford (again, dumb names), who is mute and paralyzed following a car accident.
paras.zh: 这听起来很有趣，对吧？事实上，《Verity》——由迈克尔·肖沃尔特 (Michael Showalter) 执导，编剧尼克·安托斯卡 (Nick Antosca)（Apple TV 的《开普恐惧》系列剧）改编，以直率的能力和略带苦笑的笑容，在第一个小时里表现得温和。达科塔·约翰逊（Dakota Johnson）声音迟钝，眼神湿润，饰演洛文（胡佛的角色名字是她作品中最愚蠢的部分之一；这部电影中有一个名叫克鲁的孩子），一位出版过作品但阅读量很少的小说家，她被金钱和好奇心吸引到白雪皑皑的佛蒙特州完成一项奇怪的任务。她将帮助完成，或者真正代笔，海瑟薇饰演的维里蒂·克劳福德（又是个愚蠢的名字）的最后几部小说，她在一场车祸后变得沉默寡言、瘫痪。

paras.en: Okay, Lowen may also have been lured in by the enticement of Verity’s hunky husband, Jeremy, played by a fine-wine Josh Hartnett. When sifting through Verity’s notes in her sleek home office, Lowen discovers a secret manuscript for a shocking autobiography (of sorts), in which Verity divulges perhaps the most sinister secret possible.
paras.zh: 好吧，洛文也可能是被维里蒂的帅气丈夫杰里米（由酒鬼乔什·哈奈特饰演）的诱惑所吸引。当洛文在她时尚的家庭办公室里仔细翻阅维里蒂的笔记时，发现了一份令人震惊的自传（某种程度）的秘密手稿，其中维里蒂泄露了也许是最险恶的秘密。

paras.en: So we’ve got a lavishly appointed modernist mansion, a smolderingly grieving husband, and some literary intrigue. That ought to all add up to something pulpy and propulsive, even if the excerpts of Verity’s prose read like Robert Langdon is about to jump out from behind a corner and yell “Symbology!”
paras.zh: 所以我们有一座布置豪华的现代主义豪宅，一个闷烧悲伤的丈夫，和一些文学阴谋。这些加起来应该是一种通俗而有推动力的东西，即使维里蒂散文的摘录读起来就像罗伯特·兰登即将从角落里跳出来大喊“符号学！”

paras.en: Perhaps keen to that silliness, Showalter fills the early stretch of the film with amusing details. There are cameos from the likes of Gayle King, Alex Cooper and Sean “Hot Ones” Evans, all of them interviewing Verity about her writing process. We see Lowen lying around and languidly pulling on her vape (she’s a JUUL user) instead of doing any writing, which will be all too relatable for many scribes in the audience. And then there are the smash cuts to Hathaway comatose and staring into the middle distance, gaunt and drawn as if we’ve just freeze-framed on Fantine mid-song.
paras.zh: 也许是对这种愚蠢的热衷，肖沃尔特在电影的早期部分充满了有趣的细节。盖尔·金 (Gayle King)、亚历克斯·库珀 (Alex Cooper) 和肖恩·埃文斯 (Sean “Hot Ones” Evans) 等人都客串了，他们都采访了 Verity，了解她的写作过程。我们看到洛文躺在那里，懒洋洋地抽着她的电子烟（她是 JUUL 用户），而不是做任何写作，这对于观众中的许多抄写员来说太有共鸣了。然后是海瑟薇昏迷不醒、凝视着中距离的精彩剪辑，她憔悴而憔悴，就好像我们刚刚在芳汀的歌曲中定格一样。

paras.en: It’s a gas, and Hartnett, Johnson and Hathaway (the latter in flashbacks) initially know just how to pitch the hot-and-bothered, creepy melodrama of it all. But alas, eventually all involved have to get down to business and actually contend with the plot beats of Hoover’s story, which is when the movie careens off a cliff, plumetting past so-bad-it’s-good and crashing on the rocks of agonizingly dumb.
paras.zh: 这是一种气体，哈内特、约翰逊和海瑟薇（后者在闪回中）最初知道如何演绎这一切令人紧张、令人毛骨悚然的情节剧。但可惜的是，最终所有参与者都必须开始做正事，真正应对胡佛故事的情节节奏，这就是当电影从悬崖上倾斜，从“糟糕”的“好”跌落到令人痛苦的愚蠢的岩石上时。

paras.en: I won’t spoil what’s actually going on in Jeremy and Verity’s Japandi-meets-’70s-coke-den house of horrors, but the revelations provoke so many logical questions that one leaves the theater stupefied and frustrated rather than giddy.
paras.zh: 我不想剧透 Jeremy 和 Verity 的日本人遇上 70 年代可乐屋的恐怖屋，但这些揭露引发了如此多的逻辑问题，以至于人们离开剧院时感到震惊和沮丧，而不是头晕。

paras.en: There’s a bad clash of intentions happening here. Showalter, who has undergone a surprising career shift from alt comedian to journeyman director of women’s pictures, clearly wants to try his hand at a lurid erotic thriller. Some of those trappings may be found in Hoover’s novel, but she ultimately seems more interested in delivering a shivery, sophisticated treatise on the manipulations of the writing craft, its ability to sell fact as fiction and fiction as fact. Those two impulses may have agreed with one another in something with a more polished pedigree; in Verity, though, their intersection loudly clanks. The movie is neither sexy nor smart, despite the objective hotness and intelligence of its performers.
paras.zh: 这里发生了严重的意图冲突。肖沃尔特经历了令人惊讶的职业转变，从另类喜剧演员转变为熟练的女性电影导演，他显然想尝试制作一部耸人听闻的色情惊悚片。其中一些装饰可能会在胡佛的小说中找到，但她最终似乎更感兴趣的是发表一篇关于写作技巧的令人颤栗的、复杂的论文，以及它把事实当作虚构和虚构当作事实的能力。这两种冲动可能在某种具有更精致血统的事物中彼此一致。然而，在维瑞蒂，他们的交汇处却发出响亮的叮当声。这部电影既不性感也不聪明，尽管客观上演员们很性感而且很聪明。

paras.en: Though, it perhaps must be said that Johnson’s glazed-over, murmuring style of line delivery does grow grating. I’ve long defended her particular technique, typically finding something subtle but dynamic rippling underneath her placid exterior. But this time around, one sadly has to disagree with Lowen when she says she isn’t actually bored, she just has “resting bored face.”
paras.zh: 不过，或许必须要说的是，约翰逊表情呆滞、低声说话的风格确实让人恼火。长期以来，我一直为她独特的技巧辩护，通常会在她平静的外表下发现一些微妙但充满活力的涟漪。但这一次，当洛文说她实际上并不无聊，她只是有一张“休息无聊的脸”时，人们不得不遗憾地不同意她的观点。

paras.en: Because Johnson seems genuinely checked out here, barely committing to anything in the movie — she even pretends to eat a slice of pizza like she couldn’t be bothered to figure out how real people eat pizza. That apathetic approach, which starts off pretty funny, becomes increasingly vexing, especially when the film takes a turn that requires some actual fire from Johnson’s performance.
paras.zh: 因为约翰逊在这里似乎真的很认真，几乎没有对电影中的任何事情做出承诺——她甚至假装吃一片披萨，就像她懒得去弄清楚真实的人们是如何吃披萨一样。这种冷漠的态度一开始很有趣，但后来变得越来越令人烦恼，尤其是当电影发生转折时，需要约翰逊的表演真正火力全开。

paras.en: Verity on the whole, with its shoulder-shrug of an ending, seems dismayingly uninterested in actually giving us a good story. Instead, it creates a few moments of effective mood and figures the job done well enough. Like Verity’s writing, the film simply bandies about a handful of clichés without giving them any original spin. It’s an airport novel you’d leave on the plane, an in-flight movie you’ll likely doze off to someday, borne aloft toward somewhere I hope is far more interesting than what’s wanly flickering in front of you.
paras.zh: 总体而言，《真实》的结局令人沮丧，似乎对真正给我们一个好故事不感兴趣。相反，它会创造一些有效情绪的时刻，并认为工作做得足够好。就像维里蒂的写作一样，这部电影只是简单地讲述了一些陈词滥调，而没有赋予它们任何原创的内容。这是一本你留在飞机上的机场小说，一部你可能有一天会打瞌睡的机上电影，飞向某个我希望比你面前苍白闪烁的东西更有趣的地方。

articles.title: Micron earnings hit Wall Street after the bell. Here's how options traders are positioned into the report

paras.en: In a free-wheeling press conference on the White House lawn on Tuesday, President Trump shared the microphone with at least $15 trillion worth of AI leaders including Jensen Huang, Sundar Pichai, Greg Brockman, Dario Amodei and Elon Musk, riffing on the future of what the President calls "super intelligence," promising an economic boom surpassing any in history.
paras.zh: 周二，在白宫草坪上举行的一场随心所欲的新闻发布会上，特朗普总统与黄仁勋、桑达尔·皮查伊、格雷格·布罗克曼、达里奥·阿莫迪和埃隆·马斯克等价值至少 15 万亿美元的人工智能领袖分享了麦克风，畅谈总统所说的“超级智能”的未来，并承诺经济将迎来前所未有的繁荣。

paras.en: In the near term, the market needs to get through Micron earnings. The good news is options traders think it could be a slam dunk.
paras.zh: 短期内，市场需要了解美光的财报。好消息是期权交易员认为这可能是一个灌篮。

paras.en: Market-makers are pricing a smaller 7% move for Micron Wednesday after the bell, which is slightly less than its four quarter average move of 8%.
paras.zh: 周三盘后，做市商对美光科技的定价为 7%，略低于其四个季度 8% 的平均涨幅。

paras.en: But for a stock that hit a screeching halt just three months ago when the blow-up of hedge fund Situational Awareness sent a chill through the AI bull market, a more measured rally might be just what traders want.
paras.zh: 但对于三个月前对冲基金态势感知的爆发给人工智能牛市带来寒意的股票来说，更加谨慎的上涨可能正是交易者想要的。

paras.en: Options flows in Micron leaned bullish Tuesday, with 61,000 calls likely bought versus 37,000 puts, and 75% of the total $1.6 billion of premium traded tied to calls, according to Cboe LiveVol and SpotGamma data. While call-selling was also prominent, it was mostly due to some big sellers of the 1,150-strike call in Micron, a bet the stock won't exceed its implied earnings move, rather than a bet against the company.
paras.zh: 根据 Cboe LiveVol 和 SpotGamma 的数据，周二美光的期权流倾向看涨，可能买入 61,000 份看涨期权，而买入 37,000 份看跌期权，总交易额 16 亿美元中的 75% 与看涨期权有关。虽然看涨期权抛售也很突出，但这主要是由于美光科技的一些大卖家对 1,150 次执行的看涨期权进行了押注，押注该股不会超过其隐含的盈利变动，而不是押注该公司。

paras.en: About an equal number of puts and call contracts were open as of the close Monday, near a one-year low for the put-to-call ratio for Micron, according to Barchart data.
paras.zh: 根据 Barchart 数据，截至周一收盘，未平仓看跌期权和看涨期权合约数量大约相同，美光的看跌期权与看涨期权比率接近一年来的最低点。

paras.en: "This, unlike some of Micron's prior earnings, is a more universally bullish dealer positioning," said Jason DeLorenzo, owner and founder of Volland, an options market-structure analytics platform. "They already have a lot of negative hedges that have to be unwound so I think we'll probably go up to what the straddle is pricing in."
paras.zh: 期权市场结构分析平台 Volland 的所有者兼创始人杰森·德洛伦佐 (Jason DeLorenzo) 表示：“与美光之前的一些盈利不同，这是一个更加普遍看涨的交易商定位。” “他们已经有很多必须解除的负面对冲，所以我认为我们可能会上涨到跨式期权定价的水平。”

paras.en: Open interest in puts between 980 and 1000 is high enough that should Micron disappoint on earnings, owners of those protective positions would take profits and provide support to the stock, according to DeLorenzo's analysis.
paras.zh: 根据 DeLorenzo 的分析，980 至 1000 美元之间的看跌期权未平仓合约足够高，如果美光的盈利令人失望，这些保护性头寸的所有者将获利了结并为该股提供支撑。

paras.en: Data from Opti-View, an options-trading analytics website, echo that analysis, showing 34,000 open puts at the 1,000 strike. The most popular strike for calls is at the 1,200 level.
paras.zh: 期权交易分析网站 Opti-View 的数据与该分析相呼应，显示在 1,000 个行使价下有 34,000 个未平仓看跌期权。最受欢迎的看涨期权行使价为 1,200 点。

paras.en: "If 1,150 breaks, 1,300 will not be far behind," DeLorenzo said.
paras.zh: “如果 1,150 次突破，1,300 次也不会落后太多，”德洛伦佐说。

paras.en: Bond prices are selling off at the fastest rate all year, according to 14-day RSI on the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT), and so in turn, rates are surging. Stock indexes outside of the small-caps have been able to shrug it off, but higher rates could eventually take their toll.
paras.zh: 根据 iShares 20+ 年期国债 ETF (TLT) 的 14 天 RSI，债券价格正以全年最快的速度抛售，因此利率也在飙升。小盘股以外的股指已经能够摆脱它，但更高的利率最终可能会造成损失。

paras.en: "Even the AI [trade] could get rocked by the bond market," said Don Kaufman, cofounder of TheoTrade.
paras.zh: TheoTrade 联合创始人唐·考夫曼 (Don Kaufman) 表示：“即使是人工智能（贸易）也可能受到债券市场的冲击。”

articles.title: Ken Griffin pledges $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University in 'historic' gift

paras.en: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin announced Wednesday that he has committed $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University, including $2 billion in funding to establish a new Miami campus.
paras.zh: Citadel 首席执行官肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 周三宣布，他已承诺向卡内基梅隆大学提供 30 亿美元的资金，其中包括用于建立迈阿密新校区的 20 亿美元资金。

paras.en: The $3 billion pledge is the "largest individual gift in higher education history," according to a statement from the university, which called the gift "historic." The previous record was a $2 billion gift by Nike co-founder Phil Knight and his wife Penny to Oregon Health & Science University in August 2025.
paras.zh: 根据该大学的一份声明，30 亿美元的承诺是“高等教育史上最大的个人捐赠”，并称这笔捐赠是“历史性的”。此前的纪录是耐克联合创始人菲尔·奈特 (Phil Knight) 和他的妻子佩妮 (Penny) 在 2025 年 8 月向俄勒冈健康与科学大学捐赠了 20 亿美元。

paras.en: Griffin, who is worth $57.5 billion by Bloomberg's estimate, will join Carnegie Mellon's board of trustees.
paras.zh: 据彭博社估计，格里芬的身价为 575 亿美元，他将加入卡内基梅隆大学董事会。

paras.en: "The opportunity to bring Carnegie Mellon to Miami places our city at the heart of humanistic and scientific advancement and amplifies the University's international reach and impact," Griffin said in a release. "CMU Miami will cultivate the talent, knowledge, and expertise to launch new enterprises, contribute to Miami's economy and community, and advance the prosperity of our nation."
paras.zh: 格里芬在一份新闻稿中表示：“将卡内基梅隆大学带到迈阿密的机会使我们的城市成为人文和科学进步的中心，并扩大了大学的国际影响力。” “卡耐基梅隆大学迈阿密分校将培养人才、知识和专业知识来创办新企业，为迈阿密的经济和社区做出贡献，并促进我们国家的繁荣。”

paras.en: Previously, the hedge fund billionaire's largest donation was $300 million to Harvard University, his alma mater, in 2023. Griffin also contributed $125 million to the University of Chicago in 2017 when Citadel was still headquartered in the Windy City.
paras.zh: 此前，这位对冲基金亿万富翁最大一笔捐款是2023年向母校哈佛大学捐款3亿美元。2017年，格里芬还向芝加哥大学捐款1.25亿美元，当时Citadel总部仍位于风城。

paras.en: Since he moved Citadel's headquarters to Miami in 2022, citing concerns about crime in Chicago, he has become a vocal Miami booster, touting Florida's business-friendly policies, low taxes, and quality of life.
paras.zh: 自从 2022 年他以对芝加哥犯罪问题的担忧为由将 Citadel 总部迁至迈阿密以来，他已成为迈阿密的直言不讳的支持者，宣传佛罗里达州的商业友好政策、低税收和生活质量。

paras.en: "It's a state that is prospering," he said at a CNBC conference in 2022. "It's really fun to be in an environment where people are embracing the future. They're hopeful about the future."
paras.zh: “这是一个正在繁荣的州，”他在 2022 年 CNBC 会议上说道。“生活在一个人们拥抱未来的环境中真的很有趣。他们对未来充满希望。”

paras.en: In the past four years, Griffin has become a prolific philanthropist in South Florida. He's made gifts of $50 million apiece to the University of Miami's cancer center, the Baptist Health Foundation's neuroscience institute, and Success Academy, to fund the charter school network's expansion to Miami.
paras.zh: 在过去的四年里，格里芬已成为南佛罗里达州一位多产的慈善家。他向迈阿密大学癌症中心、浸信会健康基金会神经科学研究所和成功学院各捐赠了 5000 万美元，以资助特许学校网络向迈阿密的扩张。

paras.en: Carnegie Mellon's new Miami campus will span 35 acres in Wynwood, a neighborhood known for its art scene. Construction is slated to begin in 2027. The university expects to start enrolling students in 2028 and to support more than 3,500 students once the campus is complete.
paras.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学的迈阿密新校区将占地 35 英亩，位于以艺术景观闻名的温伍德社区。建设计划于 2027 年开始。该大学预计于 2028 年开始招生，校园竣工后可容纳 3,500 多名学生。

paras.en: The new campus's academic program will be organized around addressing societal challenges such as climate resilience and national security rather than academic majors, according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，新校区的学术项目将围绕解决气候适应能力和国家安全等社会挑战来组织，而不是围绕学术专业。

paras.en: Griffin has been critical of leadership at elite universities, including his alma mater. In 2024, Griffin told CNBC's Leslie Picker that he had paused donations to Harvard over the university's response to antisemitism on campus and he also took verbal aim at top colleges.
paras.zh: 格里芬一直对精英大学的领导持批评态度，包括他的母校。 2024 年，格里芬告诉 CNBC 的莱斯利·皮克 (Leslie Picker)，由于哈佛大学对校园反犹太主义的反应，他已暂停向哈佛大学捐款，并且他还口头瞄准了顶尖大学。

paras.en: "Are we going to educate the future members of the House and the Senate and the leaders of IBM? Or are we going to educate a group of young men and women who are just caught up in a rhetoric of oppressor and oppressee and this is not fair and frankly just like whiny snowflakes?" Griffin said.
paras.zh: “我们是要教育未来的参众两院议员以及 IBM 的领导人吗？还是要教育一群刚刚陷入压迫者和被压迫者言论的年轻男女，这不公平，坦率地说，就像发牢骚的雪花一样？”格里芬说道。

articles.title: Mattel names Roger Lynch as CEO, replacing Ynon Kreiz

paras.en: Mattel on Wednesday named Roger Lynch as its new CEO and chairman, succeeding Ynon Kreiz.
paras.zh: 美泰周三任命罗杰·林奇 (Roger Lynch) 为新任首席执行官兼董事长，接替伊农·克雷兹 (Ynon Kreiz)。

paras.en: Lynch, who has been a member of Mattel's board since 2018, will take the reins as chairman on Oct. 2 and CEO by Nov. 2, according to the press release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，林奇自 2018 年起一直担任美泰董事会成员，将于 10 月 2 日出任董事长，并于 11 月 2 日出任首席执行官。

paras.en: Lynch is currently the CEO of Condé Nast, a position he has held since 2019. Mike Perlis will serve as Condé Nast's interim CEO while the board begins it search for Lynch's successor, according to a letter from Lynch.
paras.zh: 林奇自 2019 年起担任康泰纳仕集团现任首席执行官。根据林奇的一封信，迈克·佩利斯将担任康泰纳仕集团的临时首席执行官，同时董事会开始寻找林奇的继任者。

paras.en: "I am honored by the Board's confidence in me and couldn't be more excited to lead the incredible team at Mattel," Lynch said in the release. "Throughout my years on the Board, I have admired Mattel's brands, its talented people, and unique culture."
paras.zh: 林奇在新闻稿中表示：“董事会对我充满信心，我感到非常荣幸，能够领导美泰这支令人难以置信的团队，我感到非常兴奋。” “在我担任董事会的这些年里，我一直钦佩美泰的品牌、人才和独特的文化。”

paras.en: Kreiz will leave Mattel after more than eight years at the helm to take a senior leadership position at another public company.
paras.zh: 在执掌美泰八年多后，克雷兹将离开美泰，前往另一家上市公司担任高级领导职务。

paras.en: He has led the toymaker and entertainment company through major transformations, including the release of "Barbie," which became the highest-grossing domestic film release of 2023.
paras.zh: 他带领这家玩具制造商和娱乐公司实现了重大转型，其中包括《芭比娃娃》的上映，该片成为 2023 年票房最高的国内电影。

paras.en: "It has been a privilege to lead Mattel, with a global team dedicated to its mission and purpose, and I am proud of all we have achieved together," Kreiz said in a statement. "Mattel is in a position of strength, with a world-class brand portfolio, product offering, and global capabilities."
paras.zh: 克瑞兹在一份声明中表示：“能够领导美泰公司是一种荣幸，拥有一支致力于其使命和目标的全球团队，我为我们共同取得的一切成就感到自豪。” “美泰处于优势地位，拥有世界一流的品牌组合、产品供应和全球能力。”

paras.en: Mattel has been working on bolstering its iconic brands, with Hot Wheels as a notable strength. The company is also attempting break into the digital games space in a bid to match rival Hasbro. It acquired full control of its Mattel163 Mobile Games Studio earlier this year.
paras.zh: 美泰一直致力于增强其标志性品牌，其中风火轮是一个显着的优势。该公司还试图打入数字游戏领域，以与竞争对手孩之宝(Hasbro)匹敌。今年早些时候，它完全控制了 Mattel163 手机游戏工作室。

articles.title: Blockbuster retatrutide trial signals a ‘new high-water mark’ for weight-loss drugs

paras.en: Next-generation weight-loss drugs just hit a new milestone: In a phase 3 clinical trial, retatrutide helped people with type 2 diabetes lose an average of up to 49.6 pounds, or more than 20 percent of body weight—a first for the field—according to the drug’s maker, Eli Lilly.
paras.zh: 下一代减肥药刚刚达到了一个新的里程碑：根据该药物制造商礼来公司的说法，在一项 3 期临床试验中，瑞他鲁肽帮助 2 型糖尿病患者平均减掉了 49.6 磅体重，即体重的 20% 以上，这在该领域尚属首次。

paras.en: Importantly, trial participants also saw significant reductions in blood sugar, as well as lower cholesterol and blood pressure—both of which are risk factors for cardiovascular disease.
paras.zh: 重要的是，试验参与者还发现血糖显着降低，胆固醇和血压也降低——这两者都是心血管疾病的危险因素。

paras.en: “We achieved a new high-water mark for what’s possible in terms of weight loss,” says Daniel Skovronsky, chief scientific and product officer at Eli Lilly.
paras.zh: 礼来公司首席科学和产品官 Daniel Skovronsky 表示：“我们在减肥方面达到了新的最高水平。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Retatrutide is one of several experimental weight-loss drugs informally called GLP-3s. Existing glucagonlike peptide 1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist drugs such as semaglutide, sold as Ozempic and Wegovy, bind to GLP-1 hormone receptors in the brain, where the receptors help regulate hunger. Drugs such as tirzepatide, sold as Mounjaro and Zepbound, target two receptors: GLP-1 and glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP). Retatrutide targets three: GLP-1, GIP and glucagon. It’s the first such “triple agonist” to be put to the test in a phase 3 clinical trial—the gold standard test needed for the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to consider a drug for approval.
paras.zh: 瑞他鲁肽是几种实验性减肥药物之一，非正式名称为 GLP-3。现有的胰高血糖素样肽 1 (GLP-1) 受体激动剂药物，如索马鲁肽（以 Ozempic 和 Wegovy 出售），可与大脑中的 GLP-1 激素受体结合，从而帮助调节饥饿感。替泽帕肽（以 Mounjaro 和 Zepbound 的名称出售）等药物靶向两种受体：GLP-1 和葡萄糖依赖性促胰岛素多肽 (GIP)。瑞他鲁肽靶向三个：GLP-1、GIP 和胰高血糖素。这是第一个在三期临床试验中进行测试的此类“三重激动剂”，这是美国食品和药物管理局考虑批准药物所需的黄金标准测试。

paras.en: The trial, called TRIUMPH-2, took place over the course of 80 weeks and included 1,152 people with obesity and type 2 diabetes. Participants were given four milligrams, 9 mg, or 12 mg of retatrutide or a placebo. In the 4-mg group, participants lost an average of 29.8 pounds (13.5 kilograms); participants who took 9 mg lost an average of 45.4 pounds (20.6 kg); and those who were on the highest dose, 12 mg, lost an average of 49.6 pounds (22.5 kg), Eli Lilly said in a statement. The placebo group lost 9.3 pounds (4.2 kg) on average over the course of the study.
paras.zh: 这项名为 TRIUMPH-2 的试验历时 80 周，纳入了 1,152 名患有肥胖症和 2 型糖尿病的患者。参与者服用 4 毫克、9 毫克或 12 毫克瑞他鲁肽或安慰剂。在 4 毫克组中，参与者平均减重 29.8 磅（13.5 公斤）；服用 9 毫克的参与者平均减重 45.4 磅（20.6 公斤）；礼来公司在一份声明中表示，服用最高剂量 12 毫克的患者平均减重 49.6 磅（22.5 公斤）。在研究过程中，安慰剂组平均减重 9.3 磅（4.2 公斤）。

paras.en: Strikingly, at the end of 80 weeks, about six out of 10 participants in the 12-mg group were no longer considered to have obesity based on their body mass index, according to Eli Lilly. Between 28.4 and 40 percent of participants who received retatrutide saw normalized blood sugar levels by the study’s end, depending on the dose. These findings, as well as a broader statistical analysis of the trial, were published in the Lancet.
paras.zh: 引人注目的是，据礼来公司称，在 80 周结束时，12 毫克组的 10 名参与者中约有 6 人不再根据体重指数被认为患有肥胖症。在研究结束时，接受瑞他鲁肽治疗的参与者中有 28.4% 至 40% 的血糖水平恢复正常，具体取决于剂量。这些发现以及对该试验更广泛的统计分析发表在《柳叶刀》上。

paras.en: The results are particularly impressive because, in general, people with type 2 diabetes tend to lose less weight on GLP-1 drugs than people without diabetes do, says Randy Seeley, a professor of surgery, internal medicine and nutritional sciences at the University of Michigan. (Seeley has worked as a paid consultant in the past for Eli Lilly and other weight-loss drug makers but was not involved in TRIUMPH-2.)
paras.zh: 密歇根大学外科、内科和营养科学教授兰迪·西利 (Randy Seeley) 表示，这一结果尤其令人印象深刻，因为一般来说，2 型糖尿病患者服用 GLP-1 药物后体重减轻的程度往往比非糖尿病患者要少。 （西利过去曾担任礼来公司和其他减肥药物制造商的付费顾问，但没有参与 TRIUMPH-2。）

paras.en: A separate clinical trial, also funded by Eli Lilly, found that participants with obesity who were not diabetic saw an up to 25 percent loss in body weight over the course of 80 weeks when they received the same doses of retatrutide. The results of that trial, TRIUMPH-1, were published on Tuesday in the New England Journal of Medicine.
paras.zh: 同样由礼来公司 (Eli Lilly) 资助的另一项临床试验发现，非糖尿病的肥胖参与者在接受相同剂量的瑞他鲁肽后，在 80 周内体重减轻了 25%。该试验的结果 TRIUMPH-1 于周二发表在《新英格兰医学杂志》上。

paras.en: Retatrutide is not side-effect-free, however. Dosed participants in TRIUMPH-2 have reported diarrhea, constipation, nausea and vomiting. (Seven people died during the course of the study, the Lancet paper notes, but their deaths were determined to be unrelated to the treatment.)
paras.zh: 然而，瑞他鲁肽并非没有副作用。 TRIUMPH-2 的服用者报告有腹泻、便秘、恶心和呕吐。 （《柳叶刀》论文指出，有七人在研究过程中死亡，但他们的死亡被确定与治疗无关。）

paras.en: Anonymous study participants on retatrutide have also reported skipping doses as a result of side effects, as well as concerns about rapid rates of weight loss, according to reporting by STAT.
paras.zh: 据 STAT 报道，瑞他鲁肽的匿名研究参与者也报告了由于副作用而跳过剂量，以及对体重快速减轻的担忧。

paras.en: Intense weight loss can increase the risk of gallstones, as well as micronutrient deficiencies, Seeley says. “If you’re eating very few calories, it’s harder and harder to get all of the other things you need from your food,” he says.
paras.zh: 西利说，剧烈减肥会增加患胆结石和微量营养素缺乏的风险。 “如果你吃的卡路里很少，那么从食物中获取你需要的所有其他东西就会越来越难，”他说。

paras.en: If retatrutide, or reta, becomes widely available, people should work with their physicians to determine what dose—and which drug, if any—is right for them, Seeley says. “Particularly for reta, I think, a lot of these patients aren’t going to need to get to the maximum dose,” he says.
paras.zh: 西利说，如果瑞他鲁肽（retatrutide）或雷塔（reta）广泛使用，人们应该与他们的医生合作，确定适合他们的剂量以及哪种药物（如果有）。 “我认为，特别是对于雷塔，很多患者不需要达到最大剂量，”他说。

paras.en: Retatrutide is a sign of things to come—drugs targeting four and even five hormone receptors are in the works, too.
paras.zh: 瑞他鲁肽是未来的一个迹象——针对四种甚至五种激素受体的药物也在研发中。

paras.en: “The science is moving very, very fast,” Seeley says.
paras.zh: “科学发展得非常非常快，”西利说。

paras.en: Eli Lilly plans to submit the trial data to the FDA and to other health agencies around the world for approval “early next year,” Skovronsky says.
paras.zh: Skovronsky 表示，礼来公司计划“明年初”向 FDA 和世界各地的其他卫生机构提交试验数据以获得批准。

articles.title: IVF ‘add-ons’ offer hope to parents desperate for a baby. But are they backed by science?

paras.en: Alessandra Dowling always wanted a big family. As one of four siblings, she hoped for three little ones of her own. When she found out she was pregnant in December 2022, after months of struggling with fertility, she was thrilled—she pictured sharing the news with family, meeting her baby and bringing her newborn home.
paras.zh: 亚历山德拉·道林一直想要一个大家庭。作为四个兄弟姐妹之一，她希望自己有三个孩子。经过几个月的生育斗争后，当她于 2022 年 12 月发现自己怀孕时，她非常兴奋——她想象着与家人分享这个消息、见到她的孩子并将新生儿带回家的情景。

paras.en: Then, in January 2023, she miscarried. “I was devastated,” Dowling, now age 33, recalls. “I told myself it was probably just bad luck because miscarriages are unfortunately common.” Indeed, around one in five pregnancies end in miscarriage. She still wanted a big family.
paras.zh: 然后，2023 年 1 月，她流产了。 “我简直崩溃了，”现年 33 岁的道林回忆道。 “我告诉自己这可能只是运气不好，因为不幸的是流产很常见。”事实上，大约五分之一的怀孕以流产告终。她仍然想要一个大家庭。

paras.en: After a second miscarriage, “everything changed,” Dowling says. She stopped trusting her body. Every subsequent pregnancy test became associated with fear, not excitement. “I wasn’t just worried about getting pregnant anymore. I was terrified of losing another pregnancy,” she says.
paras.zh: 第二次流产后，“一切都改变了，”道林说。她不再相信自己的身体。随后的每一次妊娠试验都与恐惧而不是兴奋联系在一起。 “我不再只是担心怀孕了。我害怕再次怀孕，”她说。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Shortly after, she and her husband decided to turn to in vitro fertilization (IVF), a technique in which eggs are fertilized by sperm in a lab and then transferred to the uterus.
paras.zh: 不久之后，她和她的丈夫决定转向体外受精（IVF），这是一种在实验室中使卵子与精子受精然后转移到子宫的技术。

paras.en: Dowling’s first egg retrieval was in March 2023; it was the beginning of what would be a long—and expensive—process. Insurance generally doesn’t cover IVF. Dowling and her husband paid out-of-pocket for most of their IVF procedures, as well as several “add-on” treatments that would supposedly boost her chances of delivering a baby. These included preimplantation genetic testing for aneuploidy (PGT-A) to detect any abnormalities in the embryos’ chromosomes; injections of human growth hormone to stimulate the ovaries; ozone therapy, an experimental treatment advertised as improving the odds of pregnancy; and medications to prevent blood clots and regulate her immune system. Dowling also received—and paid for—acupuncture before and throughout her IVF experience.
paras.zh: 道林第一次取卵是在 2023 年 3 月；这是一个漫长且昂贵的过程的开始。保险通常不承保 IVF。道林和她的丈夫自掏腰包支付了大部分体外受精手术的费用，以及一些据称可以提高她生孩子机会的“附加”治疗费用。其中包括植入前非整倍体基因检测（PGT-A），以检测胚胎染色体的任何异常；注射人类生长激素以刺激卵巢；臭氧疗法，一种实验性疗法，宣传可以提高怀孕几率；以及预防血栓和调节免疫系统的药物。道林在试管受精之前和整个过程中还接受了针灸治疗并支付了费用。

paras.en: In all, she estimates she has spent close to $200,000 on fertility-related treatments.
paras.zh: 她估计她总共在与生育相关的治疗上花费了近 20 万美元。

paras.en: Dowling’s experience isn’t unusual. In the U.S., IVF often costs individuals tens of thousands of dollars. And add-ons like the ones Dowling used are common; surveys conducted in the U.K. and Australia indicate that at least three quarters of IVF patients have tried them at one point or another in the course of their treatment. Yet in many cases, these treatments just aren’t backed by science.
paras.zh: 道林的经历并不罕见。在美国，试管受精通常花费个人数万美元。像 Dowling 使用的那样的附加组件很常见。在英国和澳大利亚进行的调查表明，至少四分之三的体外受精患者在治疗过程中曾尝试过这些方法。但在许多情况下，这些治疗方法并没有科学支持。

paras.en: A recent meta-analysis of 10 popular add-on treatments found that three treatments—endometrial receptivity testing (basically, testing of the uterine lining), corticosteroids (a category of immune system drugs) and PGT-A—had little to no impact on the odds of a live birth. Four add-ons—acupuncture, intralipid infusion (fat injections intended to regulate the immune system) and platelet-rich-plasma (PRP), or blood injections, in the uterus and ovaries—had either mixed evidence or low quality data backing them up.
paras.zh: 最近对 10 种流行的附加治疗进行的荟萃分析发现，三种治疗——子宫内膜容受性测试（基本上是子宫内膜测试）、皮质类固醇（一类免疫系统药物）和 PGT-A——对活产几率几乎没有影响。四种附加疗法——针灸、脂肪注射（旨在调节免疫系统的脂肪注射）和富血小板血浆（PRP），或在子宫和卵巢中注射血液——要么有混合的证据，要么有低质量的数据支持它们。

paras.en: Just three procedures had any evidence of a possible benefit, according to the review: endometrial scratching, a procedure similar to a biopsy, physiological intracytoplasmic sperm injection (PICSI), a method of selecting sperm, and EmbryoGlue, a type of treatment to help embryos attach to the uterus.
paras.zh: 根据该评论，只有三种手术有任何可能有益的证据：子宫内膜刮擦，一种类似于活检的手术，生理胞浆内单精子注射（PICSI），一种选择精子的方法，以及 EmbryoGlue，一种帮助胚胎附着在子宫上的治疗方法。

paras.en: While the results don’t prove the treatments are ineffective, they reveal how many products are on the market with little to no evidence of helping people actually give birth to a baby. “Most add-ons are not proven to benefit patients going through IVF,” the study authors concluded.
paras.zh: 虽然结果并不能证明这些治疗方法无效，但它们揭示了市场上有多少产品几乎没有证据表明可以帮助人们真正生下婴儿。研究作者总结道：“大多数附加产品并未被证明对接受体外受精的患者有益。”

paras.en: That conclusion is no surprise to Dowling. She knew that many of the add-ons she used weren’t guaranteed to improve her chances of pregnancy or birth. Both she, a lawyer, and her husband, a physician, are data-oriented individuals, she says. They sifted through research repositories such as PubMed looking for clinical trials, consulted fertility experts and talked to other people who’d gone through the IVF process. Her doctors were transparent that some add-ons might help some people, while others, inexplicably, might see no benefit.
paras.zh: 对于道林来说，这个结论并不奇怪。她知道她使用的许多附加产品并不能保证提高她怀孕或分娩的机会。她说，她是一名律师，她的丈夫是一名医生，都是以数据为导向的人。他们筛选了 PubMed 等研究资料库来寻找临床试验，咨询了生育专家，并与其他经历过 IVF 过程的人进行了交谈。她的医生明确表示，一些附加产品可能对某些人有帮助，而另一些人可能会莫名其妙地看不到任何好处。

paras.en: But as she struggled with her fertility, Dowling’s logic shifted. Turning down something that might help, even if the odds were low or unknowable, felt “impossible,” she says.
paras.zh: 但当她与生育能力作斗争时，道林的逻辑发生了变化。她说，拒绝一些可能有帮助的事情，即使可能性很低或不可知，也感觉“不可能”。

paras.en: The add-ons helped her feel that she had “left no stone unturned,” she recalls. “By that point, I was very desperate to have a baby. We were willing to do anything and everything that might improve our chances.”
paras.zh: 她回忆道，这些附加组件让她感觉自己“不遗余力”。 “那时，我非常渴望有一个孩子。我们愿意做任何可能增加我们机会的事情。”

paras.en: The reason why so many unproven treatments are available in the U.S. to begin with is murky. For one thing, the U.S. National Institutes of Health has historically restricted studies on IVF, particularly anything to do with the embryo, says Marcelle Cedars, director of the Center for Reproductive Health at the University of California, San Francisco. As a result, research is being done outside of academia, where investigators rely on federal funding, and in an environment “much more driven by market forces,” she says.
paras.zh: 为什么美国有这么多未经证实的治疗方法，其原因尚不清楚。旧金山加利福尼亚大学生殖健康中心主任马塞尔·塞达斯说，一方面，美国国立卫生研究院历来限制体外受精研究，特别是与胚胎有关的研究。因此，研究是在学术界之外进行的，调查人员依赖联邦资助，并且是在“更多地由市场力量驱动”的环境中进行的，她说。

paras.en: That means IVF treatment may be motivated by profit, with clinics being forced to compete over their fertility offerings. And because IVF is generally not covered by insurance, patients aren’t necessarily eager to spend time signing up for clinical trials to test new treatments. Instead they want to pursue the “best” course of action, even if doctors aren’t sure what that looks like, Cedars says.
paras.zh: 这意味着体外受精治疗可能是受利润驱动的，诊所被迫在生育服务方面展开竞争。而且由于体外受精通常不在保险范围内，患者不一定愿意花时间报名参加临床试验来测试新疗法。相反，他们想要追求“最佳”的行动方案，即使医生不确定那是什么样子，西达斯说。

paras.en: Dowling had her first child, her son Joey, in August 2024 via IVF.
paras.zh: 道林于 2024 年 8 月通过试管受精生下了她的第一个孩子，她的儿子乔伊。

paras.en: Before that fateful round, she had consulted a reproductive immunologist and discovered that she had lupus anticoagulant, an antibody associated with abnormal blood clotting and recurrent pregnancy loss. Thinking this may be related to her fertility struggles, Dowling opted to add three medications to her IVF protocol: Lovenox to help reduce abnormal blood clotting; prednisone, a corticosteroid to suppress a negative immune response to an embryo; and an immune regulation medication called Neupogen. Doctors also discovered, and removed, excess tissue in her uterus called a uterine septum.
paras.zh: 在这一决定性的回合之前，她咨询了生殖免疫学家，发现她患有狼疮抗凝物，这是一种与异常凝血和反复流产有关的抗体。道林认为这可能与她的生育困难有关，因此选择在她的体外受精方案中添加三种药物：Lovenox，以帮助减少异常凝血；泼尼松，一种皮质类固醇，可抑制胚胎的负面免疫反应；以及一种名为 Neupogen 的免疫调节药物。医生还发现并切除了她子宫中多余的组织，称为子宫隔膜。

paras.en: The round of IVF worked—although Dowling isn’t entirely sure why. Less than a year after her son’s birth, Dowling tried to get pregnant again, opting for the same add-ons as before—with no luck. “Maybe it was the embryo itself,” she says, referring to her successful pregnancy. “Maybe it was simply chance. There’s just no way to know.”
paras.zh: 这轮试管受精成功了——尽管道林并不完全确定原因。儿子出生后不到一年，道林再次尝试怀孕，选择了与以前相同的附加产品，但没有成功。 “也许是胚胎本身，”她说，指的是她成功怀孕的情况。 “也许这只是偶然。没有办法知道。”

paras.en: After that unsuccessful round, Dowling found herself considering new add-ons, including platelet-rich plasma and EmbryoGlue, for the next time. Then she got pregnant, conceiving spontaneously without IVF. Her daughter, Gemma, was born in April 2026.
paras.zh: 在那一轮不成功之后，道林发现自己正在考虑下一次添加新的产品，包括富含血小板的血浆和 EmbryoGlue。然后她怀孕了，在没有试管受精的情况下自然受孕。她的女儿杰玛于 2026 年 4 月出生。

paras.en: Being a mom is better than Dowling hoped it would be. “It’s exhausting, but it is something that gives me so much happiness,” she says. “It was worth everything and then some.”
paras.zh: 成为一名母亲比道林希望的要好。 “这很累，但它给了我很多快乐，”她说。 “这一切都值得，而且还值得。”
